title: Program Manager
description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Program Manager’s function is to plan, organize and lead programs and the series of projects it entails to successful completion as required by company defined key initiatives. It is also expected for this function to participate in strategic planning for the programs this position may be leading.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Creates and manages long term goals and translates them into shorter projects to achieve the program success.
  • Prepares justification for the programs he/she is managing, such as ROI, etc., to achieve buy in from top management.
  • Plans, organizes and leads high scope projects.
  • Leads and organizes project reviews affecting the Mexicali site.
  • Prepares status reports for the projects and programs he/she is leading and be able to present at an executive level.
  • Maintains budget control for projects and programs.
  • Assures that proper documentation is prepared and updated to meet standards and regulations as required in a Medical device environment (FDA/ISO).
  • Ability to influence others to perform needed tasks in order to ensure project completion on time and within budget.
  • May require coaching other engineers in project management tools.
  • Ability to lead cross functional, multisite and multicultural (both US and MX) teams.
  • Create budget estimates for projects and programs.
  • Performs other duties as required.
  • Travel: Position may require 10-30% travel depending on the project, primarily within U.S.

Skill/Job Requirements:

Competency Requirements: (Competency is based on: education, training, skills and experience.)

In order to adequately perform the responsibilities of this position the individual must:

Required:

  • Be of high character and energy with regard for detail.
  • Schedule oriented and demonstrate results based on such schedules (Plans / Gantt charts)
  • Highly organized with his/her tasks and tasks related to his/her programs.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to communicate eloquently up, down, and sideways.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership skills to coordinate cross functional and/or multisite/multicultural teams for his/her program.
  • Demonstrate site bring up and site transfer knowledge and experience.
  • BS degree in an engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 4 years in a Project/Program Manager role or an engineering leading role.
  • Minimum 6 years mechanical, manufacturing or process engineering experience with Mid/high volume complex mechanism manufacturing.
  • Possess strong communication skills to interact with suppliers and other departments within the company (product development, planning, purchasing, regulatory, quality, etc…)

Preferred:

  • MS in an engineering or administration discipline.
  • Project Management Certification.
  • Prior responsibility for process, equipment or product validation/verification.
  • Prior experience with automated equipment, complex mechanism manufacturing, or robotics.
  • Experience in Just-In-Time, Demand Flow Technology, and Lean Manufacturing techniques.
  • Demonstrate equipment and process validation knowledge.
  • Prior experience working in an FDA/ISO regulated environment.

Language requirements:

  • High English Level (+ 90 %).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer ( SQL / BigQuery / Airflow / Terraform )

London / Hybrid

70-80k base plus super and equity

A fast-growing, data-driven organisation is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and workflows that power analytics and decision-making across the business. This role suits an engineer who’s passionate about data warehousing, data operations, and cloud infrastructure, with strong technical foundations and a focus on delivering robust, production-ready solutions.

This will suit an experienced Data Engineer with a passion for the modern tech stack and an appetite for AI, ideally from a start-up or Tech company background.

If you’re proactive, ambitious and ready to join a rocketship that’s well and truly taking off, this one is for you!

Day to day responsibilities for the Senior Data Engineer ( SQL / BigQuery / Airflow / Terraform ) include :

  • Build and maintain data pipelines and warehouse solutions using BigQuery (or similar cloud platforms).
  • Write high-performance SQL and implement data models optimised for analytics and scalability.
  • Use Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate deployments and manage cloud resources.
  • Orchestrate workflows with Airflow or Dagster, ensuring reliability and visibility across data pipelines.
  • Implement best practices in data governance, monitoring, and data quality.
  • Collaborate with analytics, product, and engineering teams to deliver clean, trusted data assets.

Required experience for the Senior Data Engineer ( SQL / BigQuery / Airflow / Terraform ) include :

  • 5+ years’ experience in data engineering or similar roles.
  • Strong skills in SQL, BigQuery, Terraform, and IaC principles.
  • Experience with orchestration tools like Airflow or Dagster.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, data ops, and cloud-based infrastructure.
  • Comfortable owning end-to-end workflows, with strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Experience working with dbt as an ELT

Why Join?

  • Work in a modern data environment with a high degree of autonomy and ownership.
  • Collaborate with a passionate, fast-moving team tackling complex data challenges.
  • Competitive salary, growth opportunities, and flexible working arrangements.

If you’re a hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data systems and enabling smarter business decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

Keywords: SQL / BigQuery / Airflow / Dagster / Terraform / IAC / DataOps / Infrastructure / Platform Engineer / Data Engineer

description:

The Developmental Consultant II (DC II) is responsible for coordinating family services for assigned clients within the Healthy Beginnings system of care.   • Conduct home visits and community-based appointments throughout Palm Beach County.

  • Engage families and support community outreach, networking events, trainings, and workshops.

  • Maintain accurate case documentation, program data, referrals, and service records while meeting program goals.

title: Project Manager Senior Lead
description:
Employment Type

Job Title

Project Manager Senior Lead

Job Summary

Job Description

We're Australia's leading telecommunications and technology company. With a global presence in more than 22 countries, we have a strong global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.


We are committed to making Telstra the best place to work and creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that works for everyone.


What We Offer

Performance-related pay
Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.

Focus of the Role

As a Project Manager Senior Lead, you play an integral role in planning and managing projects and programs ranging from small to complex. You are responsible for successful end-to-end delivery, including developing delivery roadmaps, improving processes to accelerate delivery, coordinating interconnected workstreams, and initiating appropriate interventions when gaps, risks, or issues are identified.

Our team leads complex, enterprise-wide initiatives that connect strategy with delivery across Telstra. We partner with product, technology, customer and delivery teams to create clear roadmaps, strengthen governance and deliver sustainable business and customer outcomes.


As Project Manager Senior Lead, you will shape and deliver high-impact projects and programs involving multiple product, technology, customer and delivery teams. You will set multi-year roadmaps and investment priorities, manage complex dependencies and create the clarity, momentum and governance needed to turn strategy into measurable outcomes.


You will take ownership of delivery from planning through to benefit realisation—leading governance, financial management, resourcing, risk management and executive reporting. Working with senior leaders, sponsors and cross-functional teams, you will influence decisions, remove barriers and continuously improve how complex work is delivered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex projects and programs from concept to completion, whether as standalone initiatives or as part of a broader portfolio.
  • Create and maintain multi-year delivery roadmaps that connect strategy, investment, milestones, dependencies and accountabilities.
  • Own delivery performance across scope, schedule, budget, quality and benefit realisation.
  • Establish effective governance and lead sponsor and Steering Committee forums with clear reporting, escalation and decision support.
  • Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, resolving competing priorities, risks and dependencies.
  • Manage budgets, forecasts, resources and delivery capacity to support sustainable outcomes.
  • Anticipate and manage risks, issues, dependencies and change, taking timely action to keep delivery on track.
  • Improve delivery methodologies, governance practices and ways of working based on evidence and lessons learned.
  • Coach and mentor delivery professionals, sharing practical expertise and strengthening capability across the community.

About You

  • Extensive experience leading complex projects or programs end-to-end in large, fast-moving organisations.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including hands-on responsibility for budgets, forecasts and financial performance.
  • A track record of influencing senior leaders, sponsors and governance forums to achieve timely decisions and shared outcomes.
  • Confident leadership in matrixed, cross-functional environments, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguity.
  • Excellent communication, governance and reporting skills, including the ability to translate complex information into clear executive insights.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile certifications will be highly regarded.
  • Background in telecommunications, technology or another complex service environment a definite advantage

If you are energised by complex challenges, enjoy bringing people together and want to see your leadership translate into meaningful business and customer outcomes, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and help shape the future of delivery with us!


When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders and disabilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Streams - Observability
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Observability Streams team at Elastic is building Elastic's unified data pipeline - the layer that connects where your data comes from to where it lands, with full control over how it's processed and routed along the way. Whether you're collecting metrics from cloud accounts, shipping logs from agents, or routing traces to different destinations, Streams is what ties it all together.
The Streams Backend team is responsible for the backend services powering this pipeline, ensuring data is routed, processed, and delivered efficiently and reliably at scale. We also own Logstash, the open-source streaming ETL tool (and the “L” in the “ELK stack”) trusted by enterprises worldwide to move and transform data, and we are regular contributors to the OpenTelemetry Collector.
As a Senior software engineer on the Streams Backend team,you will help drive the design and development of new features across the Streams Backend service and Logstash, contribute to the OpenTelemetry Collector, and support our users and enterprise customers.
Our team is distributed across the globe, and we communicate mostly through Slack, GitHub, email and Zoom.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing and implementing new features for Logstash and its plugins in Java and JRuby.
  • Designing, building, and operating core backend services for the Streams program in Golang.
  • Adding new features, and making contributions to the Open Telemetry Collector in Golang.
  • Solving hard distributed systems problems at scale.
  • Maintaining, updating and improving existing code and dependencies while ensuring automated test coverage.
  • Engaging with multiple public GitHub repositories and community forums.
  • Providing Pull Request reviews and guidance to your peers.
  • Collaborating with other teams to drive product goals.
  • Working together with the support organization to help our customers, which will also include participating in an on-call rotation.

What You Bring

  • Ability to work in a remote-first, highly distributed environment, with top-notch verbal and written communication.
  • Proficient analytical, problem solving, debugging skills and ability to find efficient solutions.
  • Critical thinking, positivity, autonomy and adaptability.
  • Expertise in at least one of Java, Golang and Ruby, and willingness to learn and work with the others and ability to adapt to regularly working in different codebases.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to work proficiently in a remote-first, highly distributed team.
  • A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with observability tools and concepts (tracing, metrics, logging), especially experience with or interest in OpenTelemetry
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • JRuby development
  • Open source software development
  • Knowledge of stream processing platforms (such as Kafka), database technologies (e.g., Postgres or MySQL) and network technologies (e.g., TCP, UDP and HTTP).
  • Exposure to the Elastic stack.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

307 800 zł—486 900 zł PLN

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

title: Buyer / Senior Buyer - Electronic Components
description:
About Stark

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road-legal VARG EX & SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

Headquartered in Barcelona and growing fast (77% year-on-year), our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.

The Role

We are building a new purchasing team in Chennai, India, and are looking for a Buyer or Senior Buyer for electronic components. This is a strategic role that needs a real understanding of the global electronics ecosystem: navigating semiconductor cycles, managing relationships with top-tier manufacturers, and spotting technical opportunities in our designs. You will report to the Electronics & Electromechanics Purchasing Manager and act as the bridge between Engineering and the market.

Open to All Levels

We are hiring at Buyer and Senior Buyer level. As a guide, Buyers bring 3+ years of sourcing experience, and Senior Buyers 7+ years with ownership of a commodity, supplier portfolio or major negotiations. Apply with the experience you have and we will shape the scope around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Navigate the global and Indian EMS, component manufacturer and distributor landscape to secure the best partners

  • Be the internal expert on semiconductor trends, memory market volatility and supply/demand shifts

  • Review designs and BOMs to find alternative components (pin-to-pin or functional equivalents) with better lead times or cost

  • Build strong relationships with major component manufacturers and global distributors

  • Run RFIs, RFPs and RFQs, and negotiate Master Purchase Agreements that protect our agility

  • Drive cost reduction and total-cost-of-ownership models without compromising technical integrity

  • Support Engineering early in design to ensure design-for-availability

What You Will Bring

  • 3+ years of sourcing electronic components and assemblies, ideally in automotive or two-wheelers (7+ for Senior Buyer)

  • An electronics engineering or technical degree, or strong electronics manufacturing experience

  • Knowledge of global semiconductor players (TI, ST, NXP, Analog Devices, Rohm, Infineon, Murata and others) and distribution

  • Ability to read a schematic or BOM and spot diversification or optimisation opportunities

  • Strong negotiation skills, from NRE costs to volume rebates and buffer stock agreements

  • Fluent English is a must

Why Work With Us?

  • A product people are genuinely passionate about, and a company with real momentum

  • The chance to help build our Chennai purchasing team from the ground up

  • A creative, international team across Europe, Asia and the Americas

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

At Stark, we celebrate difference. We are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging, and we encourage applications from underrepresented groups. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, contact HR@starkfuture.com.

description:
It's more than a career, it's a calling

MO-SSM Health St. Mary's Hospital - St. Louis

Worker Type:

Regular

Job Highlights:

Join a team where your work matters—every moment, every patient, every community. At SSM Health, you’ll be empowered to grow, supported to thrive, and inspired to make a lasting impact.

In this role, you will provide hands-on support in a fast-paced care environment where every shift makes a direct impact on patients and families. Your attention to detail, compassion, and ability to work closely with clinical teams will help create safer, smoother care experience. If you enjoy interacting with patients and want to grow in a collaborative care setting, this role is perfect for you.

Department: Emergency Services Technician- SSM Health St. Mary's Hospital - St. Louis

Schedule: This is a full-time night-shift position working three 12-hour shifts per week with a weekend and holiday rotation. The shift is from 7pm-7:30am

Apply today. SSM Health – We bring out the incredible in you, every day.

Job Summary:

Provides direct and/or indirect duties necessary to provide quality patient care.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assists in collection of labs, coordinating patient flow with radiology to assist with turn around times. Performs visual acuity.
  • Responds to patients' requests for assistance and answers call lights promptly. Assists with transfer and transportation of patients. Assists the Registered Nurse with the taking and/or recording of patient's temperature, pulse, respiration, blood pressure, weight and fluid status and bedside glucose and notifies Registered Nurse of significant findings. Assists physicians by placing calls to other physicians as needed. Assists provider with gynecology exams and specimen collection. Collects voided urine samples. Turns over rooms by cleaning and restocking.

  • Performs messenger service and delivers equipment to departments. Orders and stocks supplies as needed. Performs routine cleaning duties.
  • Answers phones, takes and relays messages.
  • Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION

  • High School diploma/GED or 10 years of work experience OR Certified Nurse Assistant OR EMT Basic OR nursing student with completion of fundamentals course

EXPERIENCE

  • No experience required

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Constant standing and walking.
  • Frequent use of hearing and speech to share information through oral communication.
  • Frequent use of hearing to distinguish body sounds and/or hear alarms, malfunctioning machinery, etc.
  • Frequent lifting/carrying and pushing/pulling objects weighing 0-25 lbs.
  • Frequent reaching, gripping, and keyboard use/data entry.
  • Frequent use of vision for distances near (20 inches or less) and far (20 feet or more) and to identify and distinguish colors.
  • Occasional bending, stooping, crawling, kneeling, sitting, squatting and repetitive foot/leg and hand/arm movements.
  • Occasional use of vision to judge distances and spatial relationships.
  • Occasional lifting/carrying and pushing/pulling objects weighing 25-50 lbs.
  • Occasional lifting/moving patients.
  • Occasional use of smell to detect/recognize odors.

title: Complex Claims Examiner - FAIRCO
description:
About Us

Since 1977 we have delivered first class solutions to insurers worldwide, by combining global reach with local decision making. We have built customer & broker relationships on years of trust, experience and execution. Through our people, our products and our partnerships, we deliver the capacity and expertise necessary to contribute to the sustainable growth of prosperous communities worldwide. To do so, our colleagues work with:

Integrity Work honestly, to enhance TransRe’s reputation

Respect Value all colleagues. Collaborate actively.

Performance We reward excellence. Be accountable, manage risk and deliver TransRe’s strengths

Entrepreneurship Seize opportunities. Innovate for and with customers.

Customer Focus Anticipate their priorities. Exceed their expectations.


We have the following job opportunity in our New York City office:


Description

We seek an experienced claims professional to join our growing FAIRCO team in our New York City office. FAIRCO is a subsidiary of TransRe Holdings, a Berkshire Hathaway company. As a member of FAIRCO, the Complex Claims Examiner will be responsible for adjusting Professional & Management Liability claims, particularly Lawyers Professional Indemnity claims, with opportunities for experiences with other FAIRCO programs. Responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Managing and adjusting Professional & Management Liability claims, including , lawyers liability, private and public company Directors and Officers, accountants liability, financial institutions, cyber, employment practices and miscellaneous professional liability.
  • Proactively handling claims throughout the entire claim lifecycle.
  • Collaborating with underwriters, brokers, program partners, and insureds to ensure seamless claims resolution.
  • Analyzing policy coverage and drafting coverage analyses based on contract terms and claim details.
  • Traveling to and attending claims mediations and conferences, as required.
  • Developing and implementing claims handling strategies to mitigate risk and reduce overall claim expenses.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience litigating or handling issues pertaining to complex Professional & Management Liability issues, with a focus on Legal Malpractice coverage.
  • Experience leading mediations for Professional & Management Liability claims.
  • Experience writing coverage analyses.
  • Juris Doctorate preferred.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for mediations, industry conferences, and client meetings.
  • Possession of, or willingness to obtain, a New York and other state adjuster’s licenses.

Work Schedule

TransRe is supportive of an agile work schedule, which may differ based on individual roles, your local office’s practices and preferences, marketplace trends, and TransRe’s business objectives. This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in the office per week, and 2 days remote.

Compensation

In addition to base salary, for this position, TransRe offers a comprehensive benefits package, paid time off, and incentive pay opportunity. The anticipated annual base salary range in New York for this position, exclusive of benefits, paid time off, and incentive pay opportunity is $140,000 – $180,000. This range is an estimate, and the actual base salary offered for this position will be determined based on certain factors, including the applicant’s specific skill set and level of experience.

title: Industry Technology Specialist (Brewing), SEA
description:
Interested in a career that matters?




Are you excited by the opportunity to turn BioSolutions science into practical solutions for the food and beverage industry? Join our SEA Food & Beverage Technical Service team and work closely with customers, account managers, marketing colleagues, laboratory teams, and regional and global experts.

You will become part of an energetic, science-driven, and collaborative environment where colleagues support one another and work together to create meaningful customer and business impact.


The role & your impact

As Industry Technology Specialist for Brewing, you will help customers, particularly breweries, optimize the use of BioSolutions through application guidance, technical trials, troubleshooting, and process improvement.

Working with a high degree of independence, you will translate complex brewing and beverage challenges into practical technical projects. Your work will influence customer value creation, product quality, process efficiency, project conversion, innovation development, and the growth of our regional beverage business.


Your key responsibilities in this role

  • Partner with brewing customers to provide application guidance, troubleshoot production challenges, conduct trials, and identify process improvements.
  • Independently plan and execute customer and internal projects, including experimental design, data interpretation, reporting, verification, and commercialization support.
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing colleagues to identify industry challenges and develop high-value technical opportunities.
  • Evaluate new brewing concepts, lead early proof-of-concept studies, and provide technical input to the regional and global innovation pipeline.
  • Collaborate with global brewing experts and share knowledge about relevant technologies and applications.
  • Guide laboratory colleagues and help ensure reliable results in accordance with quality, safety, and documentation requirements.

What you’ll need to be successful in this role

  • A diploma, bachelor’s degree, or master’s degree in Brewing Science, Food Science, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least three years of experience in brewing or the beverage industry.
  • Practical knowledge of fermentation, brewing processes, technical service, product development, or process optimization.
  • The ability to design and execute trials, diagnose production issues, interpret experimental results, and recommend scientifically sound and practical solutions.
  • Experience managing technical projects through verification and commercialization.
  • Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A strong customer focus and a consistent commitment to delivering value.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to make evidence-based recommendations.
  • Effective collaboration and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • The ability to take ownership of projects and communicate progress clearly.

Additional skills & interests we value

The following would be advantageous but are not mandatory:

  • Experience working with enzymes or other BioSolutions.
  • Previous experience providing technical advice directly to customers.
  • Knowledge of emerging brewing and beverage technologies and applications.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for testing new concepts and contributing fresh ideas.
  • An adaptable mindset and an interest in working across functions, cultures, and markets.

What we offer you

You will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise across brewing applications while contributing to broader SEA and global capability development.

You will work in a supportive, collaborative environment and gain exposure to customers, commercial teams, R&D, regulatory colleagues, laboratory teams, and global specialists. The role provides an opportunity to transform real industry challenges into technical projects, proof-of-concept studies, and commercially relevant solutions.


Working conditions

The role is anchored in a regional technical service and laboratory environment. You will combine laboratory work, office-based collaboration, customer-site support, and virtual engagement with regional and global colleagues.

You will plan your work flexibly around customer needs and project priorities. Frequent travel within Southeast Asia is required to support customer trials, troubleshoot processes, and collaborate with local commercial teams.

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

Opportunities for everyone

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Billing & Integrations
description:
At , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Billing & Integrations, the team behind usage metering, plans and subscriptions, spend controls, invoices, and selected partner integrations. Your team makes it possible for us to launch billable capabilities and to run routine billing through reliable APIs and tools. You’ll also keep our integrations dependable and current.

Leading a team at Sanity means owning strategy, roadmap, and execution alongside your product partner. This is a player-coach role: most of your time will go to people, priorities, and delivery, while you stay close enough to the code to review designs, unblock difficult problems, and guide technical decisions.

What you will do:

  • Lead delivery of a reliable monetization platform

    • Own the engineering roadmap with Product, balancing new billing capabilities, customer-facing improvements, reliability, and reducing manual work.

    • Guide the usage-to-invoice architecture: metering correctness, subscription lifecycle, reconciliation, and dependable budget and limit enforcement.

    • Turn recurring plan, coupon, credit, and invoicing requests into documented APIs and self-service tools that other teams can operate independently.

  • Coach and develop the engineering team

    • Develop engineers through clear feedback, meaningful ownership, career support, and hiring as the team’s needs evolve.

    • Stay technically engaged through architecture reviews, pairing, and code where it helps the team most; strengthen testing, observability, incident response, and safe migration practices.

  • Partner across Sanity

    • Work with Product, Growth, Finance, RevOps, Support, and engineering teams to make pricing and billing requirements clear, surface trade-offs early, and protect customer trust.

    • Keep existing partner integrations reliable and aligned with upstream API changes. Measure impact through billing accuracy, self-service adoption, commercial lead time, and operational health.


About you:

  • Based in Oslo, Norway, or London, UK.

  • You communicate technical designs and trade-offs clearly, in writing and in conversation, with both engineers and non-technical partners.

  • You have proven experience managing engineers and delivering software at a product or SaaS company, backed by a substantial hands-on engineering background.

  • You’ve led backend or platform systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience in billing, payments, usage metering, subscriptions, or entitlements is especially useful.

title: Material Handling Associate - Grinder Night Shift
description:
Walk-In Interviews Every Tuesday and Wednesday 6AM - 8AM CDT

On-Demand Pay Program (access to your pay when you need it)

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Associate grinds scrap material for reuse in later product runs. Associate also ensures proper labeling of gaylords, color consistency of grinding runs, and safe operation of grinder(s).

  • Manually feed scrap materials, punch-outs and knockouts into grinder pit(s), monitoring grinder operations to prevent overloads.
  • Ensure all scrap racks and flowbins are properly stacked in the correct location.
  • Ensure that product feeds are consistent in color.

  • Perform safety checks on flow bins and racks for all defects.
  • Collect and weigh vinyl scrap from production lines.
  • Check daily grinding runs for proper mix and consistency; ensure proper handling, packaging, and weight of gaylords; complete regrind report.
  • Segregate acceptable from unacceptable scrap.
  • Assist with the production of pulverized material.
  • Ensure housekeeping standards are maintained at all times, and perform daily cleaning of grinding pit.
  • Assist Maintenance with grinder maintenance.
  • Complete daily forklift safety/damage inspection checks.
  • Perform other related duties and assignments as required.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:

  • Train new associates, if necessary.
  • Actively participate in all plant safety programs, depending on location.
  • Relieve Extrusion Associate 1s and 2s as needed.

Experience

  • No experience required. Prior manufacturing experience strongly preferred

Knowledge

  • Must be able to read, write and perform basic math skills as job duties require

Mental/Physical/Visual Demands: Prefer ability to learn to work with computer systems. Must have good manual dexterity. Must be accurate in keeping colors separate, and recording weights. Must be able to learn to safely operate forklift equipment. Prefer ability to safely operate multi-directional forklift. Must have good communication skills and be able to interact with people. Must be able to lift 86 pounds maximum individually. Must be able to move 87-100 pounds with assistance. Must be mechanically inclined.

Working Conditions: Manufacturing plant environment with exposure to constant loud noise, temperature extremes, and dust. Position requires continual walking, standing, periodic pulling, heavy lifting, bending, reaching, and pushing.

Equipment/Tools Used: Blue bins; digital scale; forklift; split tail; scrap racks; safety glasses; hearing protection; gloves; calculator.

Safety: Safe work performance is required from each Associate at all times. Perform all duties and responsibilities in a safe manner in accordance with applicable Health and Safety Manuals. Required to wear or use personal protective equipment as applicable and to immediately report unsafe working conditions. Comply with all legislative requirements as outlined by Occupational Health and Safety Act and regulations. IT STARTS HERE


Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.


This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.



THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE


Santander is looking for a Customer Experience Advisor based out of Bedford Branch, working 31.5 hours per week, on a rota’d basis Monday to Saturday, between 8am & 6pm.


This is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract.


For our customers, you’ll be more than just the friendly face and voice of Santander. You’ll be a listener and problem solver. Whether you’re helping someone with a simple cash transaction, aiding them with technology in the banking hall, transacting with them over the phone or protecting your customers against fraud and scams, you’ll never know what the next challenge will be.


What’s not in doubt is that you’ll have plenty of support. Life in a branch can be busy, varied and challenging, so we’re a close-knit team.


You’ll be totally flexible in your approach and comfortable in undertaking a broad range of activities. This means not limiting your time and focus on one particular element of your role. You’ll thrive on the variety this gives you and take satisfaction for operating in a multi-skilled environment. You’re the eyes and ears of our business after all.


We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


  • Acting as the first point of contact for customers in branch or over the phone
  • Assisting with day-to-day transactions, queries and servicing
  • Answering customer calls into our contact centre
  • Building relationships and finding solutions
  • Developing your knowledge of services and products to help our customers
  • Identifying new ways to improve the customer experience

WHAT YOU’LL BRING


Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.

  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.

  • As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services
  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.

Lyman Beecher Brooks Library

This position reports to the Dean of Library Services and works in consultation and collaboration with the University’s Office of Information Technology (OIT).

title: Head of Digital Security, Risk & Governance
description:
An exciting new opportunity for a Head of Digital Security, Risk & Governance to be based in Preston.

What if you could take ownership of the security, risk and governance agenda for a £1.5bn global infrastructure business and build a function recognised as genuinely world-class?

With circa 6,000 colleagues, 125+ sites and operations spanning the UK, ANZ and India, our business is growing, evolving and becoming increasingly digital. We are looking for a Head of Digital Security, Risk & Governance to make sure our security capability grows with it.

This is a role with genuine scope and influence. You’ll lead the strategy that protects our people, data, technology and physical estate, while building the governance, assurance and digital trust capability that gives our customers, regulators and partners confidence in OCU.

In simple terms you will own the Health & Safety of our digital world UK and global.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Digital Technology Director, you’ll lead four senior managers across:
  • Security Operations
  • Cyber Security
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Digital Trust
Through these leaders, you’ll shape a wider team of around 20 security professionals covering cyber operations, identity, governance, risk, compliance, assurance and digital trust.

You’ll also hold the strategic relationship with our 24x7 managed SOC partner, work closely with our Digital Engineering and Digital Transformation leaders, and bring digital and physical security together into one coherent capability.

We’re looking for someone who is curious, driven and positively dissatisfied someone who sees an alert as the start of a question, not the end of an investigation; who doesn’t close an audit finding until the underlying problem is genuinely fixed; and who continually challenges themselves, their teams and their partners to raise the bar.

  • Lead our security strategy and advise Executive and Board-level stakeholders on cyber and information risk.
  • Oversee our 24x7 managed SOC and major security incident response.
  • Drive our Digital Trust, governance, risk, compliance and assurance agenda.
  • Champion secure-by-design across Digital Engineering and Transformation.
  • Lead strategic relationships with key security suppliers and major clients.
  • Build a high-performing, accountable and forward-thinking security culture.
  • Support our international growth and M&A activity.
We are looking for a proven senior security leader with experience in a large, complex, multi-region organisation. You’ll have a strong understanding of security operations, identity, risk, governance and assurance, alongside experience leading teams and major security suppliers.

  • Knowledge of frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIS2, CAF and Cyber Essentials Plus is important, as is the ability to translate technical risk into clear business and Board-level decisions.
  • Leading manager-level reports and developing high-performing teams
  • Managing 24x7 SOC, MDR or other major security suppliers
  • Major incident response and executive/client/regulator communications
    ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 22301, NIST CSF, NIS2, CAF and Cyber Essentials Plus
  • Translating technical risk into clear business and Board-level decisions Operating across multiple countries, cultures and business functions
    Working collaboratively across engineering, transformation and operational teams

At OCU, we believe that meaningful work should come with meaningful support. That's the principle behind Careers with Purpose, our commitment to ensuring every person at OCU feels supported, developed, and valued, not just in their role today, but throughout their career with us.

Alongside the opportunity to work on some of the UK's most significant infrastructure projects, we offer a benefits package that we are continuing to develop as we grow, and the kind of career acceleration that only comes from being inside a business moving at this pace.

As a rapidly growing organisation, there are genuine opportunities to progress, broaden your experience, and build a long-term career within OCU Group.

For a confidential conversation about this opportunity, please contact Hayley Hufton at hayley.hufton@ocugroup.com

Our vacancies are typically advertised for two weeks; however, we reserve the right to close applications early should we receive a sufficient number of suitable candidates. We therefore encourage early applications.

title: Sr Software Quality and Regulatory Analyst (Leader)
description:
Senior Quality and Regulatory (Leader) – Hybrid, Cary, NC

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence – and questions into answers.

If you’re looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you’ll find it here. We’re recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

About the job

The SAS Health and Life Sciences Research & Development team is looking for an experienced analyst to manage the software quality management system across the portfolio including delivery and deployment, into regulated and non-regulated industries. This leadership role will drive modern quality engineering practices into the end-to-end software development cycle including ensuring standard operating procedures are documented, executed and auditable (ie 21CFR 11) by internal and external stakeholders. When executed well, this role will have a direct, positive impact on enhancing life sciences and healthcare clients to deliver lifesaving medications and services to their clients.

As a Quality and Regulatory Leader, you will:

  • Establish, own, and continuously improve the organization’s Quality Management System (QMS), scaled appropriately for a software vendor serving healthcare and regulated clinical trial customers.
  • Ensure the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) produces objective evidence suitable both for internal release decisions and for customer validation packages: requirements specifications, risk assessments, traceability matrices, test protocols and results, and validation summary reports.
  • Translate 21 CFR Part 11 requirements into concrete product requirements: audit trails, electronic signatures, access controls, record retention and export, and time synchronization.
  • Own document control for controlled records: SOPs, work instructions, templates, and quality records across engineering, product, and support.
  • Balance high-velocity modern engineering practices with the documentation and traceability rigor required for regulated releases, so both regulated and non-regulated products benefit from the same quality foundation.
  • Define and track quality engineering metrics to prioritize tooling and process investment.
  • Own the validation/qualification package provided to clients so they can validate the system for their own regulated use.
  • Lead internal and external audit programs including preparations, execution and reporting and associated actions.
  • Embrace collaboration, curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, computer science, or a related field (advanced degree a plus).
  • Experience running a Quality Management Systems for commercial software at scale
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in quality and/or regulatory roles within software organizations supporting regulated industries
  • Demonstrated in depth knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 principles and other relevant standards
  • Experience supporting client audits and vendor due-diligence processes in regulated industries
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into engineering and product language, and vice versa.

Additional competencies, knowledge and skills

  • Prior experience building or scaling a quality/regulatory function
  • Familiarity with healthcare-relevant, non-regulated frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2) for non-GxP products.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing shift-left quality practices, test-driven development, and CI/CD-integrated test automation at scale and other modern best practices
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter, Gatling) and observability platforms.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the value in deploying AI-assisted testing tools (test case generation, synthetic test data, automated results validation) with appropriate governance.

World-class benefits

Highlights include...

  • Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental and vision plans.
  • Medical plan options include:
    • PPO with low annual deductible and copays.
    • HDHP combined with a health savings account with a contribution from SAS (no access to on-site health care center).
  • Onsite Health Care Center (HQ) that’s free to employees and family members enrolled in the PPO plan. There's a pharmacy too! Not local to HQ? The pharmacy will ship prescriptions for no additional charge!
  • An industry-leading 401k plan.
  • Tuition Assistance Program and programs and resources to support your development
  • Generous time away including vacation time, a variety of paid holidays, and our much-loved U.S. Winter Wellness Break between December 25 and January 1.
  • Volunteer Time Off, parental leave and unlimited paid sick days.
  • Generous childcare benefits for all full-time employees.

You are welcome here.

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

Additional Information:

To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. SAS is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. Read more: Know Your Rights.

Resumes may be considered in the order they are received. SAS employees performing certain job functions may require access to technology or software subject to export or import regulations. To comply with these regulations, SAS may obtain nationality or citizenship information from applicants for employment. SAS collects this information solely for trade law compliance purposes and does not use it to discriminate unfairly in the hiring process.

SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com.

title: Life Actuary
description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

What you will do:

  • Performs complex work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management.
  • Reviews laws and regulations to ensure all processes are compliant; and provides recommendations for improvements and monitors industry communications regarding potential changes to existing laws and regulations.
  • Runs models, generates reports, and presents recommendations and detailed analysis of all model runs to Actuarial Leadership.
  • May make recommendations for model adjustments and improvements, when appropriate.
  • Shares knowledge with team members and serves as a resource to team on escalated issues and navigates obstacles to deliver work product.
  • Leads or participates as a key resource on moderately complex projects through concept, planning, execution, and implementation phases with minimal guidance, involving cross functional actuarial areas.
  • Develops exhibits and reports that help explain proposals/findings and provides information in an understandable and usable format for stakeholders.
  • Identifies and provides recommended solutions to business problems independently, often presenting recommendation to leadership.
  • Maintains proper price level, price structure, data availability and other requirements to achieve profitability and competitive goals.
  • Identifies critical assumptions to monitor and suggest timely remedies to correct or prevent unfavorable trends.
  • Tests impact of assumptions by identifying sources of gain and loss, the appropriate premiums, interest margins, reserves, and cash values for profitability and viability of new and existing products.
  • Advises management on issues and serves as a primary resource for their individual team members on escalated issues.
  • Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.



What you have:


  • Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of related experience (in addition to the minimum years of experience required) may be substituted in lieu of degree.
  • 4 years relevant actuarial or analytical experience and attainment of Fellow within the Society of Actuaries; OR 8 years relevant actuarial experience and attainment of Associate within the Society of Actuaries.
  • Experience performing complex work assignments utilizing actuarial modeling software driven models for pricing, valuation, and/or risk management.
  • Demonstrated experience communicating complex actuarial analysis and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.



What sets you apart:


  • 5+ years of Moody’s AXIS experience
  • Advanced degree
  • US military experience through military service or a military spouse/domestic partner

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $127,310-$243,340

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

title: Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description

Akara are currently hiring for a Full Stack Engineer to join their team.

About The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design and build the interfaces, services, and infrastructure behind Akara’s products.

This is a senior, broad-scope role. You’ll work across the stack – user-facing frontend, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and edge deployment – and you’ll be a technical anchor for the wider engineering team, helping others ship code reliably into live clinical environments. You’ll report into the software leadership team and work closely with engineers across ML, infrastructure, and internal tooling.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving practical problems, and working in a fast-moving environment where their contribution will have a visible impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting Akara’s products.

Develop user-facing web applications and interfaces for real-time hospital data.

Build and maintain systems for moving data reliably between edge devices, cloud services, databases, and frontend applications.

Develop infrastructure for managing deployed devices, including configuration, software updates, monitoring, and model management.

Design and maintain scalable databases and data pipelines capable of supporting increasing deployment volumes and healthcare integrations.

Help develop integrations with hospital systems, including EHR platforms such as Epic.

Build and maintain cloud infrastructure and services, primarily within AWS.

Support the development of infrastructure for Akara’s AI agent, computer vision, ML and training architectures.

Improve how we deploy, monitor, test, and operate software across cloud and edge environments.

Build internal tools that allow our AI and operations teams to inspect, manage, and work with data more efficiently.

Contribute to containerisation, CI/CD, code review, testing, observability, and engineering standards.

Work closely with engineers across AI, robotics, computer vision, and product to move new capabilities from prototype to production.

Review code and help improve engineering quality across the team.

Use data and customer feedback to inform decisions.

Identify risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

Communicate progress, priorities, and results clearly.

Contribute to the broader development and growth of Akara.

What success looks like in the first 12 months, you will:

Have shipped and be operating production features across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure in live clinical deployments.

Be a trusted reviewer and technical resource for other engineers moving code to deployment.

Have strengthened Akara’s deployment, CI/CD, and ML devops practices in ways the rest of the team can see and rely on.

Key Requirements:

Significant industry experience as a professional software engineer (excluding internships and not purely academic or research background).

Strong professional experience across the full stack, with proficiency in Python, React, and Node.js.

Proven experience designing and building production, backend services, APIs, and databases.

Experience with cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS.

Experience with containerised deployments.

Good understanding of software architecture, testing, code review, and deployment practices.

Comfortable working close to hardware/edge constraints on-device model management, edge processing, or similar.

Strong system design judgement – able to make and defend architectural trade-offs, not just implement a spec.

Ability to work independently in a fast-moving startup environment, and to support and unblock other engineers.

Eligibility to work in Ireland without requiring visa sponsorship.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

How We Work:

Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Customer understanding: We take time to understand hospital workflows and the people using our technology.

Ambition: We are building technology that can meaningfully improve healthcare delivery at scale.

Why Join Akara:

Work on technology with a direct and measurable impact on healthcare.

  • Join a highly experienced team working across AI, robotics, software, and hospital operations.
  • Take meaningful ownership from an early stage.
  • Work directly with healthcare providers and leading hospital systems.
  • Help shape products, processes, and company strategy as Akara grows.
  • Report directly to the CTO.
  • Develop your career within a rapidly scaling international company.
Compensation and Benefits:
  • Competitive compensation
  • Annual leave: 20 Days
  • Pension or retirement contribution: 3% employer matching PRSA contribution
  • Potential to work remote for periods of time
  • Professional development in a fast paced startup environment with the opportunity to move up as the company grows
About Akara:

Akara is a fast-growing international healthtech startup on a mission to build the intelligence layer for the modern hospital – using AI to help hospitals understand what is happening in real time and deliver more care with the resources they already have. A spin-out from Trinity College Dublin, Akara builds on more than a decade of research in AI and robotics. Our technology is deployed across the US, Ireland, and the UK, and an Akara device was named one of TIME Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025. With offices in Los Angeles and Dublin, we are scaling quickly and building an ambitious international team across AI, robotics, software, and healthcare.

title: Customer Experience Consultant | S1 | Retail Banking | Bromsgrove
description:
Customer Experience Consultant | S1 | Retail Banking | BromsgroveCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE


Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.


This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.


THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE


Santander is looking for a Customer Experience Consultant based out of Bromsgrove Branch, working 35 hours per week, on a rota’d basis Monday to Saturday, between 8am & 6pm.


For our customers, you’ll be more than just the friendly face and voice of Santander. You’ll be a listener and problem solver. Whether you’re helping someone with a simple cash transaction, aiding them with technology in the banking hall, transacting with them over the phone or protecting your customers against fraud and scams, you’ll never know what the next challenge will be.


What’s not in doubt is that you’ll have plenty of support. Life in a branch can be busy, varied and challenging, so we’re a close-knit team.


You’ll be totally flexible in your approach and comfortable in undertaking a broad range of activities. This means not limiting your time and focus on one particular element of your role. You’ll thrive on the variety this gives you and take satisfaction for operating in a multi-skilled environment. You’re the eyes and ears of our business after all.


We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


  • Listening to, understanding and anticipating customers financial needs
  • Presenting options and solutions across a range of products and services with a primary focus on digital first
  • Answering customer calls into our contact centre
  • Developing meaningful relationships with customers, and working with colleagues to look after their day-to-day and long-term needs
  • Helping us be a bank that’s simple for colleagues and customers to deal with

WHAT YOU’LL BRING


Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Professional Experience


  • Listening to, understanding and anticipating customers financial needs (Required)
  • Presenting options and solutions across a range of products and services with a primary focus on digital first (Required)
  • Answering customer calls into our contact centre (Required)
  • Developing meaningful relationships with customers, and working with colleagues to look after their day-to-day and long-term needs (Required)
  • Helping us be a bank that’s simple for colleagues and customers to deal with (Required)
  • A real desire to go above-and-beyond for customers (Preferred)
  • Effective team working skills with a flexible, can-do approach to work (Preferred)
  • Openness to a broad range of activities, even if outside of business expectations (Preferred)
  • Ability to grow, adapt and change accommodating business needs and priorities (Preferred)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT


At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.


  • The starting salary is £25,158.00 together with a £500 flexible benefit allowance and the opportunity to earn a discretionary performance-related bonus of 8% of salary.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 26 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.
  • Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates. Including: medical insurance, dental insurance, and health assessments
  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.
  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.
  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans.
  • As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services
  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.


LOCAL COMPLIANCE


At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.


We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen Branch location.

Right to work in the UK


  • All candidates must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander.

WHAT TO DO NEXT


If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.


If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk

Role: Radiotherapy Senior Radiographer
Location: London, London Bridge Hospital and Private Care at Guy’s
Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week
Shifts: 8 hour shift between 0800-1730, Monday-Friday
Contract Type: Temporary role to cover maternity leave until August 2027
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience, plus excellent benefits, including private healthcare.


We have an exciting opportunity for a Radiotherapy Senior Radiographer to join our Radiotherapy team at Private Care at Guy’s, part of London Bridge Hospital Campus, currently rated "outstanding" by CQC.


Located just moments from London Bridge Station, our radiotherapy service at Private Care at Guys provides fast access to private radiotherapy for patients across London, the City, Kent and the Home Counties. All planning and treatment is delivered on one site, supported by advanced technology including two Varian TrueBeam linear accelerators, a dedicated GE CT scanner, Eclipse treatment planning and AlignRT surface guidance. This is a department where technical excellence, teamwork and compassionate care come together every day.


As a Radiotherapy Senior Radiographer within our rotational service, you’ll play a key role across both treatment and pre‑treatment areas, working as part of a large and highly collaborative multidisciplinary team. Your focus will be on delivering accurate, safe and patient‑centred radiotherapy using a wide range of advanced techniques including SABR, VMAT and breath‑hold treatments.


Alongside your clinical practice, you’ll support the development of colleagues, contribute to service improvement and quality assurance activity, and work closely with consultants and peers to ensure every patient receives consistent, high‑quality care. This is a role that offers variety, responsibility and the opportunity to build on your expertise in a well‑resourced, supportive environment.


At HCA UK we care about what you care about. We care that you want to deliver the very best care. We care that you want a career you can be proud of. We care that you want working conditions that support your health and wellbeing. Let us care for you and your career, the same way you do for others.


What you’ll bring:

  • BSc or DCR(T) in Therapeutic Radiography or equivalent
  • HCPC registration
  • Demonstratable post-qualification experience within Radiotherapy
  • Strong communication skills and a compassionate, patient‑focused approach
  • A collaborative mindset, with the confidence to support others and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team

Why HCA UK?
Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.


We believe that by caring for our colleagues, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Radiotherapy Senior Radiographer in Radiotherapy you’ll be eligible for:


  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values
At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.


Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:


  • Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
  • Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
  • Honesty, integrity and fairness: We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
  • Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments

As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

description:

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site four days per week.


What you'll do:

What sets you apart:

  • Strong knowledge of P&C digital and contact center operations, including the transactional, behavioral, operational, and performance data used to measure and improve those operations.

  • Experience developing or prototyping new analytical capabilities, data sources, or tools and transitioning successful concepts into scalable, sustainable solutions.
  • Experience applying generative AI, coding assistants, analytical agents, or automation tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to improve data discovery, analysis, code development, quality assurance, documentation, or insight generation.
  • US military experience gained through military service or gained as a military spouse / domestic partner
