title: Kynsiteknikko
description:
Haussa kynsiteknikoita uuteen hyvinvointikeskukseen!

Etsimme joukkoomme ammattitaitoisia kynsiteknikoita uuteen avattavaan hyvinvointikeskukseen Joutsensillalle.

Oletko sinä:

  • kokenut rakenne- ja geelikynsien tekijä

  • ammattitaitoinen ja hyvä ihmisten kohtaamisessa

  • hyvä työkaveri

Meillä pääset:

  • mukaan rakentamaan laadukasta hyvinvointikeskusta

  • työskentelemään viihtyisässä ja arvostavassa työyhteisössä, jossa jokainen saa kokea olevansa tärkeä osa yhteisöämme

  • osaksi henkilöstömme jatkuvaa jatkokoulutusta - haluamme, että meillä työskentelee alan osaavimmat ja ammattitaitoisimmat tekijät

  • suunnittelemaan työaikasi joustavasti ammatinharjoittajana

Toimit meillä itsenäisenä ammatinharjoittajana, ja ansaintasi muodostuu tekemistäsi asiakastöistä. Jokaisen asiakaskäynnin tuotosta suurin osa kuuluu sinulle ja sovittu osuus meille.

Meidän tehtävämme on tehdä sinun työstäsi mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Huolehdimme tiloista, ajanvarauksesta, myynnistä ja markkinoinnista sekä monista niistä käytännön asioista, joita toimivan hyvinvointikeskuksen arki vaatii. Järjestämme tarvittavat välineet ja tarvikkeet, huolehdimme asiakaskokemuksen ympärillä olevista käytännön järjestelyistä ja teemme töitä sen eteen, että kalenterissasi riittää asiakkaita.

Haluamme myös, että meillä työskentelevillä ammattilaisilla on mahdollisuus kehittyä ja pysyä alansa huipulla. Siksi panostamme aktiivisesti osaamisen kehittämiseen ja koulutuksiin.

Ajatus on yksinkertainen: sinä saat keskittyä siihen, minkä osaat parhaiten – asiakkaiden kohtaamiseen ja upeisiin kynsiin. Me puolestamme hoidamme ympärillä olevan kokonaisuuden ja rakennamme yhdessä edellytykset sille, että sinun on hyvä tehdä työtäsi.

Mikäli yrittäjänä/ammatinharjoittajana toimiminen on sinulle uutta tai vierasta, niin autamme sinua kädestä pitäen oman yrityksesi perustamisessa ja toiminnan aloittamisessa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille napakka videohakemus, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, osaamisestasi ja siitä, mitä toisit joukkoomme. Mikäli videohakemuksen lähettäminen ei ole sinulle mahdollista, voit lähettää hakemuksen ja CV:n.

Tartu rohkeasti toimeen ja lähetä meille hakemus.

Odotamme, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun!

  • Drive the implementation of global SCM initiatives and monitor performance and global SCM Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Supplier / Material Identification and selection and support the development and implementation of regional/global sourcing strategies in alignment with regional/global Category Managers.
  • Develop SCM sourcing concepts, including number and type of suppliers needed, make-or-buy comparisons, cost scenarios, and new materials.
  • Share sourcing concepts with relevant stakeholders, agree on actions, responsibilities, and deadlines.
  • Work with Category Managers and Supplier Quality Engineers for supplier selection.
  • Identify the need for new supplier developments for critical materials.
  • Coordinate and implement sourcing strategies to identify, analyze, evaluate, audit, and monitor suppliers.
  • Conduct all SCM activities for goods and services in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Contract management and adapt the corporate contractual framework to local business needs.
  • Recommend frame agreements to management and execute upon approval.
  • Bid and Proposal support bid and proposal teams by providing relevant market information.
  • Strategic sourcing activities and Plan, initialize, and monitor strategic sourcing activities for projects, new product developments, early involvement of key suppliers, and design to cost aspects.

  • Internal Stakeholder Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as engineering, planning, and fulfillment to secure material availability in production. Apply standards on health, safety, environment, and business ethics within operational work, contract management, and negotiations.

Your background

  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills.
  • Results orientation with proven implementation skills.

  • Compliance and ethics oriented.

title: Receiver
description:
Overview

To effectively, efficiently and professionally manage the Retalix system by accurately receiving vendor delivered merchandise in the store’s receiving area. The Receiver will direct vendors in placing their merchandise for storage in the store’s back room or other appropriate designated area while maintaining great customer service.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age.
  • Complete training in the grocery or receiving operation.
  • Ability to prioritize work load and have sense of urgency.
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English, with the ability to follow instructions.
  • Ability to work a scheduled based on the business needs of the store location.
  • Authorized to work within the U.S.

Responsibilities

The list of essential functions is not exhaustive and may be supplemented as necessary by the company.

  • Greet, assist and thank customers in a prompt, courteous, friendly and business-like manner.
  • Commit to the “Golden Rule” and work with other associated to build a strong grocery team.
  • Achieve the highest associate morale in the industry by working in a style that is Respectful, Supportive and Totally Team Oriented (RSTO).
  • Ensure that all grocery deliveries are properly received and stored safely.
  • Oversee direct store deliveries for invoice accuracy and product authorization.
  • Verify the accuracy of merchandise declared on the vendor’s invoices by physically counting/inspecting the units; check for quantity, cost, or damaged products.
  • Report price discrepancies or problems to the department manager or store manager.
  • Inspect all merchandise containers coming in or leaving the store for merchandise.
  • Maintain security at the receiving door and keep door closed and locked while away; for authorized entry only (vendor deliveries/pickups).
  • Ensure vendors handle merchandise carefully to avoid damages and losses that could affect shrink.
  • Control Retalix system, receiving paperwork.
  • Maintain accurate entries and proper maintenance of Retalix computer equipment; have timely submission of invoices.
  • Notify management of potential shrink problems, product availability problems, or potential security problems.
  • Practice the “Cleaner’s Creed” and proper sanitation procedures.
  • Keep work area swept clean, orderly, and free from safety hazards; report hazards to management.
  • Exercise proper safety practices when lifting or moving deliveries, and ability to operate and clean equipment and tools.

Secondary Job Functions:

  • Resolve minor customer complaints and refer major complaints to management.
  • Keep the receiving area and back room organized before and after deliveries, and properly dispose of trash.
  • Maintain a professional, honest working relationship with all suppliers/vendors.
  • Present favorable impression in dress, personal hygiene and business attitude.
  • Notify management of associate theft, customer shoplifting, unauthorized mark downs or property defacement.
  • Successful completion of the onboarding/e-learnings and checklist within 30 days of hire/entering the department.
  • Other duties assigned by management.

Physical Demands: (per work day)

The physical demands and safety risk factors of the job listed below may occur during each work shift and are listed according to their frequency.

Physical Demands

Frequency

Sitting, carrying up to 50 lbs, pushing and pulling up to 500 lbs, climbing up to 15 feet, kneeling, crouching, balancing, crawling, reaching at waist or overhead, and smelling.

1-33% (O) Occasionally

Lifting up to 50 lbs, bending, and feeling.

34-66% (F) Frequently

Standing and walking on title or concrete, stooping, handling, fingering, talking, seeing, and hearing.

67-100% (C) Continuously

Safety Risk Factors

Frequency

Loud noise, slipper or cluttered floor, contact with sharp objects and skin irritants, toxic exposure (see material safety data sheet) nuisance dust, fumes, and sprays, hazardous cleaning solutions, hazardous equipment (mechanical moving parts), and twisting of back and neck.

1-33% (O) Occasionally

Machines, tools, and equipment utilized:

Ordering equipment, scanners, pallets, pallet jacks, power jack, u-boats, transport dollies, pricing gun, case cutter, trash compactor, approved cleaning supplies.

Repetitive Action:

Continuous movement of entire body.

Working Conditions: Working environment is inside and outside, and may include exposure to cold and hot temperatures.

Hiring Range: In accordance with MA Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the hiring range for this position. At Roche Bros., we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to education, experience, qualifications, and internal equity. The hiring range for this position is $17.30 - $22.50 per hour.

title: Groomer
description:
Overview

Does your dog have a closet full of clothes? Is your cat so cool he needs to wear shades? We call that “petcentricity”! If you enjoy making pets look adorable and smell irresistible, we are looking for Experienced Groomers to join our pack!

*$1,500 sign-on bonus for New Groomer hires with 1+ years of experience!*

Responsibilities/Qualifications

As an experienced Groomer at Pet Supplies Plus, you’re pawsitively passionate about people and their pets. Providing exceptional, neighborly service at every opportunity during your workday, you will:

  • get nose kisses from a neighbor’s wet golden retriever
  • see excitement and opportunity when you look into a shih tzu’s ear canal
  • make a former shelter resident look like a dashing, dapper schnauzer again
  • help a terrier look like a poodle because that’s what the neighbor asked for

…all while engaging with our neighbors and smiling in the face of puppy breath. Are you a superhero with a flea comb and a slicker brush? No, you are more than that. You are PAWsome!

Groomer key responsibilities include:

  • Delighting neighbors and pets with grooming services, like brushing, bathing, and conditioning.
  • Grooming and styling pets per owners’ instruction and/or according to breed standards.
  • Always ensuring the wellness and safety of furry patrons.
  • Developing long-term relationships with pet parents by understanding their needs and recommending products and services that will keep their pet healthy and happy.
  • Community outreach to attract new neighbors into our store.
  • Successfully completing Safety Training certification.
  • Performing routine cleaning to keep the grooming environment fun and inviting.
  • Assisting store team members during grooming downtime.
  • Continuing to develop skills and pet grooming techniques while growing your career

PAWsome Groomer candidates will have:

  • A High school diploma or GED.
  • At least 1-year or more of grooming experience with formal training certification and/or experience under an established certified groomer.
  • Ability to move or lift merchandise, equipment or pets weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, bend or stoop for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to provide your own equipment (clippers/blades/scissors/etc.)
  • Flexibility in working evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • Candidates must pass the drug screening (in applicable states) and be 18 years or older.

Why Us:

  • $1,500 Sign-On Bonus
  • Commission Based Pay w/Guaranteed Minimum
  • Training & Career Growth
  • Paid Time Off (Full-Time)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Plans (Full-Time)
  • Health Savings & Flexible Spending Accounts (Full-Time)
  • Employee Discounts

This is a commission-based role. Maximum pay may vary based on hours worked and weekly completed grooming services.

If you are interested in starting a new career in Grooming apply for our Bather/student groomer (Groom Tech) role and find out more about our Paragon training program: https://careers-petsuppliesplus.icims.com/jobs

About Company

Pet Supplies Plus is focused on making it easier to get better products for your pet. With 770+ locations in 44 states, the stores have a streamlined design making it easy to navigate a wide assortment of natural foods, hard goods and pet services. Friendly, knowledgeable staff get to know each pet and their owner by name and provide playful store experiences to remind them just how fun it is to own a pet. Pet Supplies Plus stores are large enough to house an incredible variety of food and equipment, yet small enough to still feel neighborly.Pet Supplies Plus is ranked No. 31 overall in Entrepreneur Magazine's 2026 Franchise 500® list and is the Top Full-Service Pet Supplies Franchise for its exceptional performance in areas including financial strength and stability, growth rate and system size. For more information, please visit www.petsuppliesplus.com.

EOE STATEMENT

In addition to federal law requirements, the company complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

title: Sanitation Supervisor
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

· Ensure all sanitation activities are performed safely, effectively, and in compliance with company policies, GMPs, HACCP requirements, and regulatory standards.

· Develop, implement, and maintain sanitation programs that support food safety, product quality, and operational excellence.

title: Culinary Assistant - Retail
description:
At Holy Cross, we are focused on creating a world-class workforce by attracting and retaining employees dedicated to fostering a culture of professionalism, pride, mutual trust, and respect—one that values appreciation and recognition, empowering each of us to flourish both individually and collectively. We seek candidates who are inspired by our mission and values, and who are eager to make a meaningful difference on our campus. Learn more about Life at Holy Cross here.

At Holy Cross Dining, you are part of more than a food-service operation—you are an essential part of the student experience and the broader College community. Our culinary team plays an important role in creating a welcoming, connected, and enjoyable campus experience by providing high-quality meals and exceptional service to students, faculty, staff, and guests.
As a Culinary Assistant, you will contribute to an environment where every meal and interaction is an opportunity to make someone feel welcomed, valued, and connected to the Holy Cross community. You will help prepare and serve quality food while supporting a positive dining experience through hospitality, teamwork, inclusion, and service.
We are looking for team members who take pride in their work, enjoy working collaboratively, and understand that great hospitality extends beyond the food—it is about the experience we create for every member of our community.

Job Description

DAYS & HOURS:

Holy Cross Dining staff are considered Emergency Essential Personnel and are required to report to work during times of inclement weather. Flexibility is required, and schedules may change based on departmental needs, the academic calendar, campus events, and operational requirements.

CURRENT SCHEDULE: Monday - Friday / 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM


MAJOR AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY FOR THIS POSITION

  • Prepare and cook food items to order, ensuring adherence to established standards and specifications.
  • Follow menu and recipe guidelines precisely to maintain consistency and quality across all food items.
  • Ensure all menu items are consistently prepared, properly portioned, of the highest quality, and served at the correct temperatures. Fill out the temperature log book charts.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and fully functional work area that is adequately stocked, properly rotated, and organized at all times.
  • Supervise on-call staff, student captains/workers, and temporary employees, providing direction on routine tasks to ensure smooth operations.
  • Be adaptable and capable of working in various areas of the servery as assigned by management.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by serving guests in a friendly, professional, and attentive manner when required.
  • Assist with the setup, service, and cleanup of catered events, ensuring all operational standards are met.
  • Accurately complete service records and inventory data within the FoodPro system to ensure proper tracking and reporting.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in accommodating students with special dietary restrictions, ensuring their needs are met with care. Seek guidance from management with questions.
  • Understand and apply food waste management practices, utilizing FIFO (First In, First Out) to minimize waste and maintain inventory efficiency.
  • Adhere to all state and local food safety regulations to ensure compliance and uphold the highest standards of food safety.
  • Perform other similar or related duties as required or requested.

RESPONSIBILITIES FOR ALL HOSPITALITY EMPLOYEES

  • All documentation is recorded accurately and timely.
  • Follow all chemical guidelines according to the Material Safety Data Sheets.
  • Superior customer service and communications skills are needed to provide a welcoming, friendly and professional manner to all of our guests.
  • Offer training/support to co-workers, staff and students where applicable.
  • Follow all verbal and written instructions from managers/supervisors.
  • Have the ability to frequently lift up to 25 pounds, occasionally lift up to 50 pounds and 100 with assistance.
  • All staff are considered to be emergency essential personnel and are required to report during times of inclement weather.
  • Schedule flexibility is important, you need to be aware of the academic calendar and special event dates. We will/may adjust schedules due to events on campus.
  • Be innovative as it pertains to your position.
  • Be comfortable sharing your suggestions and ideas for process or work improvements.
  • Comply with all safety and risk management practices, policies and procedures.
  • Ability to succeed in a high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to communicate with guests, co-workers and other members of the college community with professionalism and respect.
  • Be sure to know and come to work each day with our department’s core values in mind.
  • Must adhere to the uniform standard as it applies to your position.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS FOR THIS POSITION

  • Up to two years related work experience is preferred.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Ability to frequently lift up to 25 pounds, occasionally lift up to 50 pounds and 100 with assistance
  • ServSafe Food Safety Certification or training is required. If training is not up-to-date, training/certification must be completed upon 3-6 months from date of hire.
  • Food allergy training is essential and prior experience in special food allergy meal preparation is preferred. If a candidate does not have prior experience, the necessary training must be completed upon hiring. Initial training will include a review of information, departmental responsibilities and a recap of the Food Allergy Program.
  • Excellent customer service and appropriate communication skills are needed in order to provide a welcoming, professional and safe environment for students and guests. Upon hiring the following additional training must be completed on a yearly basis: Title IX harassment training, Security awareness training.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Inclusion: Actively engaging with the values of the College by promoting a work environment that embraces diversity and demonstrating respect for the opinions and beliefs of others.
  • Innovation: Performing one’s job with creativity and proactivity, improving procedures and problem-solving.
  • Mission/Service Orientation: Focusing on service to others and contributing to the College’s collective mission.
  • Responsibility: Taking ownership of one’s actions and accountability for one’s tasks and duties.
  • Collaboration: Exchanging information, ideas, and thoughts with others in a manner that is proactive and enhances partnerships.

DISCLAIMER

The description above represents the most significant duties of this position but does not exclude other occasional work assignments not mentioned, the inclusion of which would be in conformity with the factor degrees assigned.

40

For all other positions, resume and cover letters are optional, but your most up-to-date work experience and educational background are required.

title: QA/QC Specialist
description:
Job Description:

The purpose of your role as a QA/QC Specialist


As a QA/QC Specialist, you will manage QA/QC for the regional construction team to ensure Harris QA/QC processes and procedures are adhered to. You'll ork collaboratively with internal and external teams throughout the preconstruction process to add value through design and equipment selections.


The QA/QC Specialist will provide project management support during all phases of HVAC construction to ensure project standards, budget, deadlines and communications are maintained.



Safety

  • Perform site walkthroughs and inspections.
  • Assist in site safety compliance.
  • Ensure all safety requirements are being performed - this includes site specific safety plans, audits, tool box talks, pre-task planning and being proficient in using Industry Safe.

Pre-construction

  • Evaluate construction drawings for unique opportunities to value engineer and improve upon the mechanical systems. Partner with project management and design teams to implement solutions.
  • Analyze equipment options and make selections that add value and support project goals.
  • Partner with General Manager to implement preconstruction strategies that differentiate Harris and lead to increase growth/gross margin opportunities.

QA/QC

  • Partner with QA/QC Manager to create quality control processes, forms, and systems for tracking
  • Create QA/QC training for Project Management team and foreman
  • Perform site visits to inspect QA/QC processes
  • Partner with QA/QC teams from General Contractor and Subcontractors to ensure Harris quality controls procedures are being adhered to.
  • Partner with fabrication team to ensure materials and fabrication methods align with specifications
  • Manage multi-rack coordination of fabricated materials, including storage logistics and collaboration with other trades.
  • Coordinate the testing and inspection activities of any independent testing and inspection agencies to ensure that all necessary testing and inspections are properly and consistently performed.
  • Participate in all applicable inspections and tests. Also perform follow-up inspections and examinations as necessary to ensure continued compliance with the requirements of the contract documents.
  • Work with subcontractors and suppliers so they are aware of the subcontract requirements and all project processes and procedures that have been established to ensure the required standards of quality are met.

Project Management

  • Review, process, organize, log and distribute Contract Documents (drawings, specifications, schedules, RFIs, Construction Bulletins, etc.) and shop drawings/submittals to appropriate team members (e.g. Harris project team, subcontractors, fab shop and vendors).
  • Distribute and log all of the above activities for the team.
  • Assist in drafting, submitting and tracking RFIs and their corresponding responses.
  • Attend field coordination meetings & distribute meeting notes
  • Assist in the administration of project specific quality control program and compile documentation.
  • Administer/update progress drawings and as-built drawings.
  • Administer project closeout documentation including Operation and Maintenance manuals, spare parts, startup reports, owner training and punch lists.
  • Assist in the identification, tracking and reporting of changes to original scope of work.
  • Maintain equipment procurement logs.
  • Assist in management and tracking of tool and equipment rentals.
  • Order Equipment and coordinate shipping schedules with Purchasing Department.
  • Assist project manager and field foreman to track labor productivity in accounting software.

Estimation

  • Coordinate with suppliers/vendors to estimate projects.
  • Perform basic estimating skills utilizing estimating software.
  • Attend pre-bid, page turn, project turnover and preplanning meetings as required.
  • Assist in producing and populating scope/proposal letter.
  • Other tasks and duties may be necessary due to project specific conditions, and as directed.



What we're looking for in you

  • Bachelors degree in industrial, mechanical, or construction engineering preferred
  • Must be able to work outside and work at heights. Job requires, walking, climbing, crawling and competent operation of a torque wrench.
  • 5+ years of QA/QC experience required
  • 2+ years of business administration and management principals experience
  • 2+ years of knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles.
  • 2+ years of knowledge of fabrication/manufacturing quality control processes and procedures
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems
  • Ability to read and comprehend construction documents

Your life at Harris

As one of the country's leading mechanical contractors, Harris offers you the best of both worlds: the stability, resources and opportunities of a national company, and the team culture, creative spirit and customer loyalty of a local business. If you thrive on variety and new challenges, we want to meet you!

From stadiums to manufacturing facilities, power plants to hospitals, concert halls to classrooms, we handle projects of all sizes and complexity from multiple regional locations across the country.

Harris Benefits + Compensation

• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

• 401K with company match

• Vacation time, sick time, and paid holidays

• Paid Parental leave

• Short-Term Incentive Plan

Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF

At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

Context & mission

Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).

The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centres.

La position a pour but de déployer et maintenir une architecture documentaire institutionnelle harmonisée, adaptée aux réalités opérationnelles de MSF-Suisse permettant :


  • La continuité des activités malgré l’instabilité (sécurité, turnover, urgences)
  • La réduction des risques de perte d’information critique
  • La traçabilité, la redevabilité et la mémoire institutionnelle
  • L’adaptabilité aux contextes terrain hétérogènes

Principales responsabilités

  • Maintient et adapte le cycle de vie des documents, tant papier que digital, de MSF-Suisse, en tenant compte des contextes des missions
  • Garantit l’application des obligations légales de conservation en lien avec le RGPD et les normes archivistiques
  • Mitige les risques de perte d’information
  • Assure la collecte, le traitement, la description, la conservation, la communication et la destruction sécurisée des documents
  • Conçoit et met à jour des référentiels et outils pour favoriser la gestion des documents, tant au niveau des missions que du Siège
  • Assure la continuité des activités de l’unité ADOC lors de l’absence de ses collègues (documentaliste-archives digitales)

Profil recherché

Education

  • Degré tertiaire ou équivalent en Sciences de l’Information ou en Histoire
  • Expérience forte en environnement complexe/ international un atout

Expérience

  • Expérience avérée en gestion d’archives papier et en cycle de vie de documents
  • Expérience dans l’humanitaire un plus

Compétences Techniques

  • Maîtrise des normes et réglementations liées aux archives et à la protection des données
  • Connaissance des outils de gestion d’archives et de gestion de l’information
  • Compétence en modélisation du cycle de vie documentaire
  • Intérêts pour les enjeux géopolitiques
  • Connaissances en outils bureautique et de collaboration courants (Microsoft 365)
  • Connaissance d’Atom est un atout

Langues

  • Le Français et l’Anglais sont les langues de travail à MSF-Suisse et nécessaire pour la position
  • Toute autre langue bienvenue

Qualités personnelles

  • Capacités d’analyse, d’organisation et de structuration
  • Aptitude à la pédagogie, au sens du service et au travail transversal
  • Capacité à travailler dans un univers multiculturel
  • Aptitude à la flexibilité et à la gestion du stress

Conditions de travail

  • Poste à temps partiel 80% (32h/semaine)
  • Contrat à durée indéterminée
  • Lieu de travail : Genève
  • Date de début idéale : Dès que possible
  • Salaire annuel brut (à 80%) : de CHF 69’897.- à CHF 80’486.- (salaire en fonction de l'expérience équivalente et de la grille salariale interne).
  • Vacances payées : 25 jours par an, pro rata temporis, plus les jours fériés suisses tombant pendant la durée du contrat.
  • Caisse de pension : contribution à la caisse de pension (2e pilier-LPP) couverte à raison de 3/4 par MSF et 1/4 par l’employé.
  • Aide à la relocalisation en cas de déménagement d'un autre pays vers la Suisse.

Comment postuler

Les candidats sont invités à soumettre leur candidature via uniquement notre plateforme de recrutement en respectant les conditions suivantes.

  • CV (maximum 2 pages)

2026-10-18

All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: Designer
description:

We are currently seeking an experienced Packaging Designer to join our Creative Services Division.

This is a hands-on role with multiple types of projects that include:

  • Prepare production ready packaging files for print
  • Design & conceptualize innovative packaging for licensed and in-house consumer products under the direction of the Director.
  • Design logos, branding, retail & trade show displays, advertising, websites and other related marketing and sales materials.
  • Coordinate with art director, marketing, and product teams for completion of sale sample requests.
  • Post final mechanical art to the Hong Kong team or domestic vendors.

Responsibilities include:

  • Maintenance and adherence to existing branding and style guides through different medias
  • Create or adjust dielines for package and POP structures
  • Meet targeted deadlines
  • Create package comps/ mock-ups for presentations and production
  • Must have good mechanical/production skills with excellent use of typography, layout and design


Requirements:

  • 2-3 years graphic design/packaging development experience within the consumer product or (preferably) the toy industries.
  • Degree Packaging/Graphic Design, Illustration or related field.
  • Expert in Adobe CS Photoshop & Illustrator. Microsoft office.
  • Hands on skills with ability to work with cutting tools to create mock-up samples.
  • Illustration a plus.
  • Knowledge of offset printing and packaging materials.
  • Flexibility, creativity, enthusiasm for, and love of, the creative process.
  • Works well as part of a team (an absolute MUST).
  • Self-starting, self-motivating, and self-managing; a solid team player.
  • Strong organizational skills are necessary, no exception.
  • Excellent creative problem solving skills.
  • Ability to work against strict deadlines and rapid changes in regards to direction and priorities.


Our Benefits:

  • Health and Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, disability, life & accident insurance and employee assistance program
  • Savings: 401K matching, pre-tax spending accounts, and employee discount programs
  • Compensation: JAKKS Pacific offers a competitive salary. Compensation for this role commensurate with experience, qualifications, location, and education and typically ranges from $70,304 - $75,000.


Company Overview

A leading designer and marketer of children’s toys and consumer products, JAKKS Pacific® is always on the lookout for talented, bright and creative individuals to join our ever-growing team.


Best known for our toy and entertainment products, JAKKS produces impressive and innovative products across multiple categories spanning from action figures, collectibles, and dolls, to high performance activity toys and vehicles, and let’s not forget our deep portfolios of beloved licensed characters. In other words, we work hard to make play more fun, and we believe it has paid off.


Included in Fortune’s 100 Fastest Growing Companies for four years in a row, and Forbes’ 100 Best Small Companies for three years, JAKKS is an aggressive and passionate company, with a commitment to customers and a dedication to growing our business.


Our goal is to continuously cultivate a talented and diverse workforce while providing a safe and productive work environment and an excellent career growth opportunity while working with a dynamic team who loves what they do and for a Company that ultimately makes children smile, play and succeed!


Jakks Pacific, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) - MedTech
description:
Company Overview

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

Position Description

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and experienced Senior QA Engineer to join our MedTech team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, safety, and compliance of our healthcare and medical technology software solutions.

Beyond hands-on manual and automated testing, a critical focus of this role involves rigorous documentation validation, process compliance, and adherence to GxP standards and medical device quality frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Quality Assurance & Compliance (GxP Focus)
    • Perform thorough validation and review of technical documentation, test plans, requirements trace matrices (RTM), and validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ) in accordance with GxP (GCP, GMP, GLP) standards.
    • Ensure all software development and testing activities comply with healthcare regulatory standards (such as FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and HIPAA).
    • Participate in regulatory compliance reviews, quality audits, and verification of standard operating procedures (SOPs).
    • Maintain comprehensive audit-ready documentation for all testing phases and defect lifecycles.
  • Manual & Automated Testing
    • Design, develop, and execute end-to-end test strategies, test suites, and test cases for complex MedTech applications.
    • Establish and maintain maintainable, scalable automated test frameworks for API and UI testing (e.g., Cypress, Selenium, Playwright, or Postman).
    • Execute manual functional, non-functional, regression, integration, and risk-based testing where automated testing is not applicable or compliant.
    • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects, ensuring root-cause analysis is performed in line with compliance procedures.
  • Collaboration & Leadership
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams including Software Engineers, Product Managers, Regulatory Affairs, and Quality Assurance Managers.
    • Mentor junior QA engineers and advocate for quality-first, compliance-driven engineering practices across the team.
    • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies while maintaining the necessary balance between agile agility and strict regulatory documentation.

Workplace: Remote / Hybrid role in LATAM, preferably in Argentina

Must Have Skills:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Quality Assurance Engineer, with a proven track record in both manual and automated testing within regulated environments
  • Domain Knowledge: Solid background in the MedTech, HealthTech, Biotech, or Pharmaceutical industry
  • GxP & Regulatory Expertise: Strong hands-on experience validating documentation and software under GxP guidelines, ISO standards (13485 / 14971), or FDA compliance regulations
  • English Proficiency: Advanced to Fluent English (written and spoken). Seeking level C1/C2 level fluency. Ability to write clear, compliant technical documentation and articulate QA/regulatory concepts effectively to international stakeholders
  • Automation Skills: Proven experience with modern test automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured)
  • Documentation & Traceability: Exceptional skill in writing structured test plans, test cases, execution reports, and maintaining traceability matrices
  • Tools: Experience using issue-tracking and QA management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar

Professional Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Ability to Lead and Guide Discussions with Business Partners
  • Confident and Proactive Nature
  • Ability to understand scope and ask the right questions
  • Organized, detail and process oriented
  • Proven ability to build, manage and foster a team-oriented environment

title: Sr. Director, Financial Analysis
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Overview:

The Senior Director, CEMEA Planning Center of Excellence Lead is a key leadership position within our Planning Center of Excellence (COE), reporting to the VP of Planning COE. This role is responsible for driving strategic direction and operational excellence in regional financial planning processes across the organization. The successful candidate will help develop and adopt a set of common practices across all regional teams. They will both advocate for and gather business requirements for their region AND help shape the unified solution.


The CEMEA Planning COE Lead will be responsible for overseeing critical partnership activities, driving consistency (with respect for regional nuance) in expense and revenue strategy, driver analysis, quality control, process governance, and analytics. This position requires a strategic thinker with strong leadership and relationship management skills, capable of overseeing the development and implementation of comprehensive regional planning strategies that align with overall organizational financial goals. The role involves optimizing planning processes, ensuring high-quality outputs, and providing data-driven insights to inform strategic decision-making at the regional level.


Essential Functions:

  • Deliver global transformation initiatives: design, build, and deploy standardized solutions.
  • Regional Planning Operationalization and Execution: Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive regional planning strategies, ensuring alignment with organizational financial goals and consistency across regions, business units, and corporate functions.
  • Cross-functional Leadership and Process Optimization: Drive projects to create and adopt global standards and solutions managing critical functions including expense strategy, driver analysis, quality control, and process governance. Continuously improve and standardize regional planning processes for enhanced efficiency and effectiveness in partnership with the regional teams and leaders.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Insights Delivery: Partner with regional finance teams and other stakeholders to support their planning needs. Leverage data-driven insights and analytics to inform strategic decision-making and provide actionable recommendations. Shape and develop systems requirement.
  • Quality Control and Governance: Establish and maintain robust quality control measures and governance frameworks for regional planning activities. Ensure accuracy and understanding of specific regional financial performance indicators, organizational structures and market drivers.
  • Ad-Hoc Ownership and Project Leadership: own key deliverables and projects on behalf of the broader Planning COE agenda beyond local representation to drive a unified standard across all regions and teams.
  • Change Management: Foster a culture of innovation across the Finance community. Quickly adjust planning strategies in response to changing business environments and organizational priorities, maintaining high performance and resilience.
  • Talent Development: Lead and develop a team of 4 FTEs, providing coaching, mentoring, performance management, and career development. Foster a high-performing, inclusive culture while building capabilities, supporting succession planning, and ensuring team members are positioned for growth and increased responsibility.

Visa requires at least 4 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • 15 or more years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 12 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, or MD); PhD with 9+ years of experience
  • Proven experience in leading regional financial planning teams and processes within a large, complex organization
  • Strong understanding of expense strategy, driver analysis, quality control, and process governance in financial planning
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights
  • Experience in implementing and optimizing planning processes across multiple regions and business units
  • Experience in driving innovation and digital transformation in financial planning processes.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Vi søker en servitør i 50 % stilling. Søkere må ha fylt 18 år.
description:
I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?
Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss😎

Som servitør er du stjerna på gulvet i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater.


Hva er suksessoppskriften?
Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på🤩


Det er en fordel dersom du:

  • Har erfaring fra restaurant eller service

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har en lidenskap for salg og gjesteopplevelser

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.


Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢


Har du spørsmål er du hjertelig velkommen til å kontakt med restauranteier Raysun Paringit på +4798886409/raysun.paringit@sabrurasushi.no

title: Plate Rolling Operator, Maritime
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Maritime Manufacturing Technology Team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies, processes, and materials for cutting-edge defense hardware. The team is developing deployable static and moving surfaces, undersea and sea to air vehicles, and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an experienced Metal Former/Machine Operator to join the team, working in a cutting-edge production environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in maritime manufacturing. You will play a key role in delivering our products to our customers by working hands-on with our engineering team on a multi-disciplinary workflow. This role will include fabricating high-quality parts in a cutting-edge production system as well as building assemblies to support the production floor.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Read and interpret technical drawings and CAD models.
  • Program/set-up/operate manual, semi-automated and CNC plate rollers, hydraulic presses, and shears.
  • Design/spec out and lead implementation of various work holding and fixture methods.
  • Act as SME on the rolling/forming/contouring fabrication of pressure vessels, alloys, or varying materials.
  • Troubleshoot issues and make adjustments during the manufacturing process.
  • Perform quality control both during and at completion of the manufacturing process.
  • Lead the organization, machine maintenance, and cleanliness of the work area.
  • Collaborate with the Quality and Engineering teams to identify and implement safety policies and procedures.
  • Help build, supervise, and mentor the fabrication team on rolling, forming, contouring, safe handling, etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years' experience as a metal forming technician.
  • Proven experience in setting up and operating plate rolling machines to form cylinders, cones, and other curved shapes of various metal thicknesses (up to 4-6”).
  • Extensive experience in operating hydraulic press brakes for forming and bending.
  • High level of familiarity with various alloys, metals, etc.
  • Knowledgeable in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Proficient in using precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, protractors, tape measures).
  • Can own the completion of an assigned manufacturing task from start to finish.
  • Ability to flex between R&D fabrication and production tasks.
  • Able and willing to jump in on production assembly integration tasks as needed.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs unassisted.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working with exotic materials like Inconel, Monel, Titanium, and HY-80).
  • General fabrication experience (cutting, forming, welding).
  • Forklift and/or overhead crane certification or ability to obtain.
  • Experience with CAD software like Siemens NX (Unigraphics).
  • Prior work with architecture and infrastructure engineering partners and/or general contractors to build, improve or modify machining systems.
  • Hobbyist fabricator, welder, builder.
US Hourly Range
$41.35—$54.81 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

title: Innovation Lead - Video Games
description:
Innovate UK has the following secondment opportunity available for employees of Innovate UK Business Connect:

Applications must be submitted by

09-10-2026

Vacancy for Innovation Lead – Video Games


The Creative Industries are one of the UK Government’s priority growth sectors, with Video Games identified as one of four Frontier Industries where innovation, technology, intellectual property and high-growth businesses have the potential to drive significant economic impact.


*Please note this advert will close on 8th October 2026 at 23.59pm.

Watch our video “Why Join Innovate UK?” here.


Title: Innovation Lead – Video Games

Band: UKRI Band F (UKRI Ts & Cs)

Salary: £58,589 gross per annum

Reports to: Head of Creative Industries

Location: UKRI sites: Swindon, London, Harwell, Daresbury, Keyworth, Cambridge, Edinburgh

Contract: Fixed Term (6 Months)


Employees applying for any opportunity which may mean being away from your substantive role for a temporary period of time, please refer to the Recruitment Policy for further information in the first instance. If you are made an offer, please ensure you liaise with your Line Manager and the designated HR Team as soon as possible in order that implications of any move are clear and understood, prior to a move taking place.


Innovate UK works with businesses and stakeholders across every nation and region of the UK. As part of UKRI, our hybrid working approach is built around one simple principle: time should be spent where it delivers the greatest impact.

This means working across three settings: UKRI sites, time on the ground with businesses, partners and stakeholders and time working from home. It's an approach designed to support collaboration, connection and impact.

This role is in Tier 2, with 40-60% of working time typically spent either at a UKRI site or engaging with external businesses and stakeholders across the UK. Outside of this requirement, you can work from home. Whilst this role will be formally based at one of the following UKRI sites, it is externally facing, and we expect that there will be requirement to travel around the UK and occasional international travel for 2/3 days each week on average.

Read the full UKRI Hybrid Working Policy Hybrid Working at UKRI

Innovate UK recognises the importance of work-life balance and we will be happy to discuss any requests for flexible working arrangements.

Context:

The Creative Industries are one of the UK Government’s priority growth sectors, with Video Games identified as one of four Frontier Industries where innovation, technology, intellectual property and high-growth businesses have the potential to drive significant economic impact.


Alongside Film & Television, Music & Performing Arts, and Advertising & Marketing, Video Games is therefore a key strategic focus for Innovate UK’s Creative Industries activity.


The UK has one of the world’s leading video games sectors, combining creative talent, technology, intellectual property and global routes to market. The sector encompasses games studios and developers alongside publishers, platforms, technology providers, investors and an extensive supply chain.


A major component of Innovate UK’s activity is Next Wave, which forms part of the wider UKRI Creative Industries programme. Next Wave is designed to support the growth and scaling of innovative, IP-rich businesses across the four Creative Industries Frontier Industries. The Innovation Lead – Video Games will have a central role in ensuring that Next Wave is successfully delivered within the sector and contributes to the wider ambitions of the UKRI Creative Industries programme.


Job Purpose:

As Innovation Lead – Video Games, you will lead Innovate UK’s activity for one of the four Creative Industries Frontier Industries, providing sector leadership for Video Games and ensuring that Innovate UK’s interventions support innovation, commercialisation and business growth.


You will be responsible for developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the businesses, technologies, markets, investment environment and structural challenges shaping the sector and translating this insight into Innovate UK strategy, programmes and investment activity. A key priority will be to support the successful delivery and development of Next Wave within the video games sector, ensuring that the programme reaches high-potential innovative businesses, responds to market need and creates meaningful routes to growth, investment, collaboration and international markets.


Working with colleagues across Innovate UK and UKRI, government, industry and the wider innovation ecosystem, you will design and deliver interventions that enable innovative UK businesses to develop and commercialise new products, technologies, services and business models, access investment and new markets, and scale. You will act as a visible and credible representative of Innovate UK within the UK and international video games ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

  • Lead Innovate UK’s activity for Video Games as one of the four Creative Industries Frontier Industries, acting as the principal sector specialist within the team.
  • Support the Head of Creative Industries in developing and delivering Innovate UK’s strategy for innovation and business growth in the video games sector.
  • Play a leading role in the successful delivery of Next Wave, ensuring activity responds to sector needs, reaches high-potential businesses and delivers against programme objectives.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the UK and global video games industry, including emerging technologies, business models, investment trends, market dynamics and routes to commercialisation.
  • Identify opportunities where Innovate UK intervention can address barriers to innovation, accelerate business growth and generate economic impact.
  • Build strong relationships across the video games ecosystem, including studios, publishers, platforms, technology companies, investors, trade bodies, academia and regional partners.
  • Work across Innovate UK, UKRI, government and delivery partners to develop and deliver funding, business growth, investment and international activities for the sector.
  • Identify opportunities for collaboration and technology transfer between Video Games and the other Creative Industries Frontier Industries, as well as wider sectors.
  • Use data, evidence and industry engagement to assess the impact of Innovate UK activity and inform future strategy and programme development.
  • Represent Innovate UK externally and provide authoritative advice and thought leadership on innovation, commercialisation and growth within the video games sector.

This is not an exhaustive list and you might be encouraged to undertake any other duties across the wider directorate, commensurate with the Band and level of responsibility of this post, for which the post holder has the key experience and/or training.

Shortlisting criteria

(S) – Assessed at shortlisting

(I) – Assessed at interview

(S&I) – Assessed at both shortlisting and interview

Person Specification:

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of the commercial and technological environment in which video games businesses operate.


You will understand the strategic importance of Video Games as one of the Creative Industries Frontier Industries and be capable of representing the sector within Innovate UK, UKRI, government and the wider innovation ecosystem.


You will understand both the creative and technology-driven nature of the sector and be able to distinguish between innovation with the potential to transform businesses and markets and the normal commercial risks associated with the production of individual games.


You will be commercially aware, comfortable operating in a complex stakeholder environment and able to use evidence, market insight and industry engagement to identify where Innovate UK intervention can have the greatest impact.


You will also have the delivery focus required to turn this insight into successful activity, including helping ensure that Next Wave achieves meaningful outcomes for innovative video games businesses.


Experience & Qualifications:

Essential –

title: Buyer / Senior Buyer - Electromechanical Components
description:
About Stark

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road-legal VARG EX & SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

Headquartered in Barcelona and growing fast (77% year-on-year), our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.

The Role

Electromechanical parts sit where the mechanics and electronics of our motorcycles meet: motors, actuators, wiring harnesses, connectors, switches, sensors, lighting and charging hardware. We are looking for a Buyer or Senior Buyer to own sourcing for these commodities as part of our China purchasing team in Shanghai. You will report to the Electronics & Electromechanics Purchasing Manager and work closely with Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain across our global sites.

Open to All Levels

We are hiring at Buyer and Senior Buyer level. As a guide, Buyers bring 3+ years of sourcing experience, and Senior Buyers 7+ years with ownership of a commodity, supplier portfolio or major negotiations. Apply with the experience you have and we will shape the scope around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, assess and choose manufacturers for motors, actuators, harnesses, cable assemblies, connectors, switches, relays, sensors, lighting and charging hardware

  • Run RFIs, RFPs and RFQs, and make sure NDAs and Master Purchase Agreements are in place

  • Build should-cost and total-cost-of-ownership models and lead negotiations to drive continuous cost reduction

  • Cut lead times on critical parts, keep stock low without running out, and dual source where risk demands it

  • Support Engineering early in design to choose manufacturable, available parts and qualify alternatives

  • Manage supplier performance, quality issues and disputes with Quality and Supply Chain

  • Track raw material (copper, magnets, plastics) and component markets, technology roadmaps and supply risks

What You Will Bring

  • 3+ years of sourcing electromechanical components in automotive, motorcycle, e-mobility or similar industries (7+ for Senior Buyer)

  • Comfortable reading drawings, specifications and BOMs, and discussing materials, processes and tolerances with engineers

  • Knowledge of the Chinese and global supplier base for harnesses, connectors, motors and sensors

  • A strong, data-driven negotiator who is organised and results-oriented

  • Passion for sustainability, and a degree in engineering or business administration

  • Fluent English and Mandarin

Why Work With Us?

  • A product people are genuinely passionate about, and a company with real momentum

  • A creative, international team across Europe, Asia and the Americas

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

At Stark, we celebrate difference. We are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging, and we encourage applications from underrepresented groups. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, contact HR@starkfuture.com.

title: Sr Business Analyst, Salesforce
description:
What you would be taking on

This is an opportunity to get into healthcare technology and work at a fast pace, using AI to speed up how we design, build and deliver.


In this role, you would be the person who makes sure we build the right thing the first time. You would connect the business and technology teams across our enterprise applications, with Salesforce at the center. You would lead requirements, process analysis and backlog management across Salesforce, Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud and Boomi integrations. We are looking for a strong analyst first: someone with deep Salesforce experience who applies the same approach to any system.

Why this role

  • Shape what gets built. You would own backlog readiness, so the work our developers pick up starts with your problem statement, your requirements and your acceptance criteria.
  • See the whole business. You would work with Sales, Finance, Professional Services, Customer Success and Marketing, and follow processes like quote-to-cash and the customer lifecycle across every system they touch.
  • Be part of big changes. We are rethinking quote-to-cash, including a move from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud. You would help design how it works.
  • Learn more than one platform. Salesforce is the center, but you would also work with Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud and Boomi.
  • Use AI every day. You would have AI tools to draft requirements, map processes and analyze data faster, so more of your time goes to the analysis that needs a person.
  • Set the standard. You would define how we write requirements and documentation, and help the rest of the team follow it.
  • Work that matters in healthcare. Veradigm builds technology used by physician practices, health plans and life sciences companies. The systems you improve keep that work running.

What you will do

  • Manage the intake of business requests: clarify the problem, define scope, assess business value and prepare the work for the delivery backlog.
  • Run requirements sessions with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Professional Services, Customer Success and Marketing.
  • Document current-state and future-state business processes, and identify gaps, risks and improvements.
  • Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows in Jira, and maintain supporting documentation in Confluence.
  • Own backlog readiness. Make sure work is well-defined, prioritized and ready before sprint planning.
  • Take part in Agile Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
  • Work with developers, admins and QA through delivery. Answer requirements questions, support testing and confirm solutions meet acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze cross-system processes and data flows, such as quote-to-cash, professional services delivery and customer lifecycle, across Salesforce, Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight and Boomi integrations.
  • Help prioritize work by bringing data, business impact and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
  • Set and maintain requirements and documentation standards. Guide stakeholders and other contributors to follow them.
  • Influence stakeholders at all levels. Push back constructively on incomplete, conflicting or low-value requests.
  • Support user acceptance testing, release communications and change management.

What we need

All of these are required:

  • 4+ years of business analysis experience with enterprise business applications.
  • 3+ of hands-on business analysis on Salesforce, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ.
  • Proven ability to apply business analysis skills across multiple platforms and quickly learn new systems.
  • Strong experience in Agile Scrum environments, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience with process mapping and documentation, such as BPMN, swimlane diagrams, Visio or Lucidchart.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

What helps

  • Salesforce Business Analyst or Administrator certification.
  • Experience with Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud or other SaaS business applications.
  • Understanding of integration concepts and middleware, such as Boomi or MuleSoft, including data mapping and system dependencies.
  • Experience with quote-to-cash, revenue operations, professional services or customer success processes.
  • Basic SQL or reporting skills for data analysis.
  • Healthcare technology or regulated-industry experience.
  • CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA or Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) certification.

Compensation Range:

$84,520-$117,483

Compensation for this job is subject to market conditions, geographic considerations, the candidate’s unique skills and experience, state and local laws, and budget. Our commitment to pay transparency is a testament to our dedication to creating a fair, equitable, and inclusive workplace. By continuously analyzing market trends, staying abreast of changes in state laws, and making budgetary adjustments accordingly, we strive to ensure that our compensation practices reflect the value we place on our associates’ unique contributions and support their professional growth.


Enhancing Lives and Building Careers


Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work and to further their professional development. Together, we are In the Network. Interested in learning more?


Take a look at our Culture, Benefits, Early Talent Program, and Additional Openings.

title: Sr Business Applications Developer
description:
American Crystal Sugar is seeking a motivated Sr. Business Applications Developer at our corporate office in Moorhead who provide product and technical ownership and lifecycle management for assigned business applications through a combination of software development, business process analysis, solution design, system integration, and application support activities.

This position serves as a primary product and technical resource for assigned business processes and applications, partnering with business stakeholders, analysts, software developers, vendors, and other IT team members to deliver reliable and maintainable business solutions. The Sr. Business Applications Developer is expected to understand both the business processes and technical components that support assigned applications and is accountable for supporting, enhancing, validating, and evolving those solutions over time.

This position performs hands-on software development while also participating in requirements gathering, solution design, testing, implementation, production support, and continuous improvement initiatives.

DIMENSIONS: N/A

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

The Sr. Business Applications Developer position is accountable for providing product and technical ownership of assigned business applications while supporting the full software solution lifecycle.

The Sr. Business Application Developer completes the following essential functions within established company and department policies, procedures, deadlines, and budget constraints:

Lead and promote a positive work culture through Company Values of Safety, Integrity, Quality, Teamwork, and Accountability.



Application Ownership

  • Serves as the primary technical resource for assigned business applications and business capabilities.
  • Develops deep understanding of the business processes, data flows, interfaces, integrations, and operational requirements supported by assigned applications.
  • Maintains awareness of application health, application changes, technical debt, enhancement opportunities, and production issues affecting assigned systems.
  • Works independently and collaboratively as a subject matter expert for assigned applications and their related business processes.

Business Analysis and Solution Design

  • Collaborates with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, process requirements, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Assists in defining and documenting functional and technical requirements for application enhancements, integrations, and new solutions.
  • Participates in solution design activities to ensure proposed solutions align with business requirements, supportability goals, and existing system capabilities.
  • Evaluates alternative approaches and makes recommendations regarding process improvements, software enhancements, system integrations, and vendor solutions.

Software Development

  • Designs, develops, tests, deploys, and maintains custom software applications, integrations, APIs, tooling, and related technical solutions.
  • Creates clean, maintainable, secure, and supportable software solutions following established development standards and best practices.
  • Participates in code reviews, troubleshooting activities, software testing, and deployment planning.
  • Develops technical documentation for software applications, integrations, support procedures, and development artifacts.

System Integration

  • Designs, develops, supports, and maintains integrations between business applications, databases, cloud services, vendor platforms, and enterprise systems.
  • Designs, implements, maintains COTS and custom tooling to perform data validation, data mapping, and integration troubleshooting activities.
  • Leads and/or assists in identifying integration opportunities that improve operational effectiveness and reduce manual effort.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and external resources to ensure timely and accurate movement of data between business systems.

Testing, Validation, and Implementation

  • Develops test plans, validation procedures, and deployment activities for software enhancements and new solutions.
  • Coordinates and participates in system testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and production implementations.
  • Produces and maintains test automations to ensure reduce effort and time needed to complete test regressions.
  • Ensures software solutions meet documented business requirements and quality expectations.
  • Supports training, communication, and transition-to-support activities associated with application changes.

Production Support

  • Provides level-II and level-III support for assigned applications and integrations.
  • Investigates and resolves application issues while minimizing business disruption.
  • Participates in on-call support activities as assigned.
  • Works with business users, vendors, and IT resources to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identifies opportunities to improve application reliability, maintainability, usability, and operational efficiency.
  • Participates in modernization efforts and technology adoption initiatives as appropriate.
  • Contributes to development standards, application support practices, and team knowledge sharing activities.
  • Maintains awareness of emerging technologies, tools, and industry practices relevant to assigned systems.

Other Duties

  • Other duties as assigned.



KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:

Required

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in software development, business application development, systems implementation, or related technical disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and supporting business applications in a production environment.
  • Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and implement technical solutions.
  • Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting application integrations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work across multiple assignments and competing business needs.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Commercial Off The Shelf (COTS) business applications.
  • Experience working with ERP, operational, manufacturing, agricultural, logistics, accounting, laboratory, or enterprise business systems.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and modern integration technologies.
  • Experience participating in Agile project delivery methodologies.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Work Environment. The individual must be able to work in an environment with interruptions, office noise, and competing and changing demands. The individual must be able to work extended days as workload requires.
  • Physical Requirements. The individual must be able to, throughout the day, input and access information from the computer system, perform keyboarding functions, type and use the phone system. The individual must be able to climb stairs, bend, kneel and lift 25 pounds.



Compensation Range:

$109,993.90 - $137,492.33 Annual Salary

Benefits Include:

Our benefits include eligibility for comprehensive medical insurance starting on day one.

In addition, we offer a health savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with a Company match and contribution, paid dental insurance paid basic life insurance, paid short and long-term disability, vision insurance, life insurance, flexible spending accounts, paid time off, paid sick leave, paid parental leave, paid volunteer opportunities and paid holidays. We also offer discretionary bonuses, tuition reimbursement, service awards, and a 24/7 employee assistance program with access to eight confidential visits with a licensed counselor at no cost.​ ​ Some of these benefits are subject to eligibility criteria.

We are proud to offer such a comprehensive package to our employees and believe that it reflects our commitment to their well-being and success.​
