title: Team Leader - Children's Homes
description:
£44,348 - £51,852 assuming good attendance and up to 3 sleep ins per month



Those huge small victories

Working in our Children’s Homes means being a part of a young person’s day to day life. This means being there for the highest highs and lowest lows. Our team leaders enable our young people to get their childhood back and create pathways to become well rounded adults – an incredibly rewarding role to have. There will be challenges along the way but there will also be the smallest moments which feel like a huge small victory!


Our homes accommodate young people with social, emotional and mental health needs, and our aim is to create the best possible outcome for the young people in our care. Our team leaders are fulfilled by the idea of affecting even the smallest positive changes in our young people, so we celebrate the little things.



Get out what you put in


You’ll be a part of taking care of our young people day to day, making sure things run smoothly and creating lasting memories. As a team leader you will also make sure that the staff team are supported and the home is operating at our high standards, prepared to step up to deputise for the Registered and Deputy Managers. We’re looking for someone able to relate to and build relationships with our young people. Compassionate, emotionally resilient, and supportive, you’ll also be able to provide the leadership that inspires your colleagues.




What we do for you


We know you’re going to do great things. For your hard work and commitment, we reward you with the best salary and benefits package in the care sector. With us, you’ll get to make a genuine difference to the lives of our young people – plus you’ll get:

  • Salary: Base salary of £36,568 - £44,072
  • Bonuses: In addition to your base salary you’ll do up to 3 sleep ins per months, these are paid at £80 per sleep (approx. £2,880 per year) and Attendance allowance up to £1,400 per year, £2,000 Regional Allowance, £1,500 Responsibility Allowance, £1,000 Welcome Bonus - on completion of 6 months employment & £1,000 Loyalty Bonus (after 12 months of employment)
  • Training: A full 4-week induction on our Care Academy
  • Holiday: You’ll work hard at WG, so you’ll be rewarded with 7 weeks’ holiday
  • Progression: If career development is your thing, most of our team leaders and managers have been promoted from within our group – plus you could join our ‘Aspire’ future managers programme
  • Flexible benefits package: meaning you can increase/decrease your holiday allowance, pension and life insurance – check out our benefits here
  • Wellbeing: a host of wellbeing tools and advice including employee assistance
  • Medical cover so you can claim back the cost of things like an opticians or dentist appointment and a host of high-street discounts
  • Meals provided while you’re at work
  • Beautiful working environments with the very best facilities – check out our homes here
  • A recommend a friend scheme that offers a £1,000 bonus every time




Bring your whole-self to work


Here at Witherslack Group, we celebrate everyone’s differences as that’s what makes us the best at what we do. Our young people come from all walks of life, diverse backgrounds and with different needs – and our workforce reflects that diversity, so that our teams can engage, encourage and inspire our young people to be themselves. You don’t need experience, but there are a few things we’ll be looking for from you:

  • A ‘can do’ attitude – a team player who rolls up their sleeves to help others
  • We genuinely care about our young people (and each other) so honesty and empathy is a must
  • The resilience to be able to deal with challenging situations
  • A full UK driving licence which you’ve held for at least 12 months
  • This role requires you to have the Level 3 Children’s Residential Care qualification

You’ll start life as a Team Leader by joining our ‘Care Academy’ – 4 weeks of off the job training with experienced WG professionals to help you feel confident and ready to support our young people.



Join the UK’s best special education and care provider


At Witherslack Group, inclusion is part of who we are. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, valued and that they truly belong.


As a specialist provider of education and care for children and young people with special educational needs, we understand the importance of embracing individuality and championing difference- especially when it comes to neurodiversity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and the unique strengths that each person brings to our community.


We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities. We are proud to be recognised as an inclusive employer and are committed to making our recruitment and workplace practices inclusive and accessible. If you need any adjustments to support you through the recruitment process or in the workplace, we’ll be there every step of the way.


By building a diverse and inclusive team, we’re better able to support the children, young people and families we serve and ensure every member of our team can thrive, grow, and be their authentic self.

title: Senior Technical Specialist - AI Domain
description:
Here at BNZ, it's about more than just banking. We work together in an agile, energising environment to create innovative solutions through our promise "If you can imagine a better future, let's find a way."



We support wellbeing, flexible working and have a generous leave offering. There is the opportunity for growth, learning and career development. No two days are the same.

Help build the AI platforms, products, and engineering practices that will shape how BNZ uses AI.



At Bank of New Zealand, we are transforming how AI is designed, built, and scaled across the organisation. We are looking for a Senior Technical Specialist to help build the products, platforms, integrations, and engineering practices that make enterprise AI safe, useful, and scalable.



Mō te Tūranga | About the Role

This is a hands-on engineering role for people who want to help shape how enterprise AI is built in a regulated environment. You will work across AI product delivery and shared platform capability, building reusable components, integrations, patterns, and guardrails that help teams deliver AI safely and effectively.



What's exciting about this opportunity?

This role offers the chance to shape how AI is engineered and adopted across BNZ. You will work on practical technical problems, contribute to foundational AI capability, and deliver products, integrations, and platform components that create value across the organisation. There is real scope to influence how we build, scale, and embed AI in a way that is practical, safe, and sustainable.



What do we want you to know before you apply?

You will join a team that designs, builds, and operates AI capability end-to-end. That includes AI-powered products and APIs, agentic solutions, enterprise integrations, shared platform services, MCP servers, gateways, reusable tooling, and the engineering patterns and guardrails that help AI be adopted safely and effectively across the bank.



As a Senior Technical Specialist in the AI domain, you will be hands-on: shipping AI-enabled products, building shared platform capability, improving reusable engineering patterns, and helping domain teams adopt those patterns. You will work closely with architects, engineers, and product teams, moving between delivery and core platform engineering depending on where your skills can create the most value.



What will success look like?

Success in this role is defined by ownership, delivery, and learning. You will move problems forward, turn ideas into working capabilities, collaborate generously, share knowledge, and keep improving how AI is engineered and adopted across BNZ.



What tech skills would add value for the AI team?

This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer with excellent stakeholder management skills, sound judgement, and adaptability. You don't need to tick every box from day one; curiosity, engineering discipline, and a willingness to grow with AI capability are essential.



We are interested in capable engineers who can learn quickly, work well with others, and bring disciplined engineering practices to emerging AI technology.



We are interested in experience across some of the following areas:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or TypeScript, including modern frameworks, back-end services, and APIs.
  • Experience building AI-powered solutions, such as agents, orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, LLM-backed services, or AI-enabled product experiences.
  • Experience building, onboarding, or operating shared technical capabilities, such as enterprise integrations, cloud services, agent platforms, MCP servers, gateways, or reusable tooling.
  • Working knowledge of secure, production-ready delivery in regulated environments, including observability, operability, identity, and access controls.
  • Experience with governance and guardrails development, such as platform standards, environment management, policy controls, evaluation approaches, and guardrail frameworks that enable safe development.
  • Experience creating reusable libraries, SDKs, templates, and reference implementations that help other engineers build effectively.



Why BNZ?

You will be working on AI capability with real enterprise scale, meaningful customer and colleague impact, and the complexity of a regulated banking environment. This is your chance to apply modern AI engineering in a setting where safety, reliability, and trust matter.



What attributes will this person display in order to be successful in this role?

You'll bring sound judgement, strong communication, and a commitment to helping others grow.

title: Buyer / Senior Buyer - Mechanical Components
description:
About Stark

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road-legal VARG EX & SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year-on-year), and our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.

The Role

We are looking for a Buyer or Senior Buyer to join our Mechanical purchasing team at Stark HQ in Sant Boi de Llobregat, Barcelona. You will source high-performance mechanical parts, vehicle components and technical assemblies, hitting demanding cost, quality and delivery targets. You will report to the Mechanical Purchasing Manager and work closely with Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain.

Open to All Levels

We are hiring at Buyer and Senior Buyer level. As a guide, Buyers bring 3+ years of sourcing experience, and Senior Buyers 7+ years with ownership of a commodity, supplier portfolio or major negotiations. Apply with the experience you have and we will shape the scope around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and choose world-class manufacturers for mechanical components and subassemblies

  • Own RFIs, RFPs and RFQs, and make sure NDAs and Master Purchase Agreements are in place

  • Lead price negotiations and drive continual cost reduction and supplier consolidation

  • Reduce lead times for critical parts and keep stock low without ever running out

  • Manage supplier relationships, performance and dispute resolution

  • Track market conditions and technology roadmaps to spot risks and opportunities

  • Lead vendor selection with Engineering, following our Lean and Just-in-Time approach

  • Travel when needed, including to key racing events

What You Will Bring

  • 3+ years of sourcing in automotive or high-performance machinery (7+ for Senior Buyer)

  • Knowledge of the global mechanical supplier landscape (Tier 1 and Tier 2)

  • Analytical, organised and data-driven, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

  • Ability to manage multiple work streams in a fast-growing environment

  • Passion for sustainability

  • Degree in engineering or business administration

  • Fluent English is a must; Spanish is a plus

Why Work With Us?

  • A product people are genuinely passionate about, and a company with real momentum

  • A creative, international team based in Barcelona

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

  • Subsidised lunch in our in-house restaurant and free access to our gym

  • 30 days of paid vacation

At Stark, we celebrate difference. We are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging, and we encourage applications from underrepresented groups. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, contact HR@starkfuture.com.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Python/React or Angular
description:
Here at Venator, we are working with an eCommerce company who have UK's biggest technology platform - they have a live mobile application as well as a web based application- the company is now looking to grow!

Please Note- this is a hybriod role but will require you to be in the office (London) 4 days per week . You will have 20 work from anywhere days added on top which you can use to make soime weeks 2 days a week from home.

Please also note - sponsorship is not an option here unfortunately.

The role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Understand complex business problems then propose and implement technical solutions
  • Have input into the architecture, working closely with the Head of Technology and other senior team members
  • Work with other engineers and the business to improve user experiences
  • Bring your experience and enthusiasm to our engineering culture
  • Promote excellence with technical mentoring, feedback, and code reviews
  • Participate in planning sessions, retrospectives, stand-ups and demos
  • Join us in curating a codebase to be proud of, driving for quality, maintainability and testability

The candidate

  • You have built great products for the web and/or mobile
  • You have analysed business problems then scoped and built technical solutions to solve them
  • You can quickly become productive using our backend or frontend technologies, or both
  • You’re excited about understanding the real problems working people come up against and fixing them with technology
  • You can work well in small teams to deliver radical improvements
  • You will be proud to show how you’ve impacted other parts of a business and delivered results
  • You will be pushing frameworks and languages for good business reasons
  • You stay up-to-date with developments in AI and are comfortable using AI tools to boost your productivity and problem solving

The tech

Our core technologies are:

  • Python on the server side, using Django as a web framework, and Django Rest Framework for our API
  • Angular and TypeScript on the client side for our mobile apps and booking flow
  • Next.js and React for parts of our marketing website
  • Ionic for hybrid and progressive mobile apps
  • PostgreSQL for our database, using some of its advanced geographic modelling capabilities
  • Metabase for analysis and self-serve data exploration
  • Redis for caching and task queues
  • GitHub, Codeship and Heroku for seamless code review, integration and deployment
  • Claude Code for agentic coding
  • AWS S3, CloudFront and Lambda for storage and content delivery
  • Cypress for end-to-end testing
  • Third party APIs: OpenAI, Stripe, Twilio, Sendgrid, Mailchimp and more

Our tech culture

We follow an agile development process with fortnightly sprints. We keep meetings to a minimum, but the ones we do have are highly valuable.

We strongly believe in ownership and you will be responsible for taking your features from development through to testing, deployment and design review with end users.

We take code quality seriously. We have a preferred code style and we use automated linting, code formatting and other code inspection tools to detect common errors and ensure consistency.

We run an extensive suite of unit, integration and end-to-end tests on every git push and deploy.

Perks

  • Share options
  • 25 days holiday allowance + bank holidays
  • Flexible hours and work-from-anywhere days
  • Free trial cleans and discounted recurring cleaning
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Salary sacrifice gym membership scheme
  • Access to Employee Pricing Programs
  • Sponsored learning, including conference tickets and travel
  • Choice of hardware, OS and IDE – you do you
  • Posh Christmas and Summer parties
  • Tons of sponsored team socials
  • Casual dress code

title: Summit Expert Business Consultant, Front Office
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Drive Front Office Transformation with Teciem

Join Teciem as a Summit Expert Business Consultant, Front Office and help some of the world's leading financial institutions transform their Treasury and Capital Markets operations.

As part of Teciem's Global Professional Services team, you will work directly with clients to design, implement, and optimize Summit Front Office solutions.   • Help customers maximize trading efficiency, risk visibility, and operational effectiveness.

  • Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and industry-leading consulting approaches.

  • 8+ years of experience in Treasury, Capital Markets, Banking, or Financial Services.

  • Proven experience delivering consulting engagements for banks, financial institutions, or treasury organizations.
  • Strong client-facing consulting, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation experience.
  • Experience leading complex workstreams or business transformation initiatives.

Functional Expertise

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:

  • Front Office Operations
  • Treasury Trading
  • Foreign Exchange (FX)

  • Money Markets
  • Derivatives
  • Trade Lifecycle Management
  • Market Risk Management
  • Valuation & Pricing

What Makes You Successful

  • Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Passion for delivering exceptional client outcomes.
  • Ability to navigate complex business and technology environments.
  • Collaborative leader who enjoys mentoring and developing others.
  • Commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and industry best practices.

Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

title: Architecture & SDLC Metrics Reporting Engineer | S3 | Chief Technology Office | Milton Keynes | Internal Mobility
description:
Architecture & SDLC Metrics Reporting Engineer | S3 | Chief Technology Office | Milton Keynes | Internal MobilityCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE

The Chief Technology Office is looking for an Architecture & SDLC Metrics Reporting Engineer based out of Milton Keynes.

At Santander, we are committed to delivering technology that is resilient, compliant, and strategically aligned with our global architecture principles.
The Architecture & SDLC Metrics Reporting Engineer will play a key role in this by supporting in the definition of strategic reporting for architecture governance adherence, developer performance, and SDLC compliance across our UK Technology organisation.

This role will help ensure that our system development lifecycle controls, design standards, and delivery practices are measurable, transparent, and continuously improved — supporting decision-making for CTO leadership.

We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Supporting controls definition and design, and maintaining automated dashboards that track adherence to Santander’s Architecture Governance Framework,
  • Developing, maintaining and supporting the applications and workflows that support our SDLC controls and processes,
  • Lead the Development for the existing “SDLC Compliance Platform” and timing to develop it’s capabilities, improve its usability and respond to both business and technology requirements.
  • Manage requirements from user stories through to software change implementation.
  • Driving increased adoption of automated controls and processes through the development and integration of new API interfaces and supporting upstream application owners with integrating into them.
  • Enabling end to end visibility of the status of Santander’s application health through the design and delivery of auditable metrics to demonstrate adherence to policy standards.
  • Developing dashboards and portals that measure SDLC governance metrics, aligned to Santander’s Software Development Lifecycle Policy.
  • Designing the integration and model data from multiple Santander systems — including, Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub, and architecture repositories (Abacus, AGT, SDLC Compliance Portal, CMDB, etc.) — to create a consolidated view of technology delivery performance and risks.
  • Working with Enterprise Architects, Engineering Leads, and Governance Managers to define KPIs, thresholds, and scoring logic that reflect compliance with internal standards and regulatory expectations. Ensuring automated metrics and dashboards comply with data quality, security, and governance controls in line with Santander’s Data Management Policy.
  • Developing data models, API interfaces, data transformation jobs and reconciliation processes to ensure the full scope of upstream data has been correctly collected, managed and assessed.
  • Oversee and manage technical deployments, software changes, dashboard releases / promotion and access management, within CTO’s reporting suites and applications. Maintaining inventories on data sources, metric definitions, and transformation logic in alignment with Santander’s Data Lineage and Metadata Standards.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience

  • A working knowledge and understanding of GenAI tools (Devin, & Atlassian AI toolset) (Required)
  • Proven experience as a full-stack software engineer working with:
    • Front End: Angular
    • API Layer: IBM V10 REST APIs
    • Backend: Java (Spring Boot)
    • Data: Oracle SQL 19c
    • Hosting: RedHat OpenShift, GitHub and GitHub Actions (Required)
  • Experience designing RESTful API interfaces to support both user and system interactions. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of ETL and data integration — connecting to structured and unstructured sources via SQL, APIs, or batch transfers. (Required)
  • Familiarity with building data ETL processes within Java. (Required)
  • Working knowledge of designing integration of data from SDLC and DevOps tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow) to monitor delivery governance. (Preferred)
  • Knowledge of Python for advanced analytics, data enrichment, or anomaly detection. (Preferred)
  • Understanding of Santander’s data security, privacy, and governance controls, with the ability to ensure compliance in BI solutions. (Preferred)

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience). (Required)
  • Knowledge of financial services regulation and governance practices. (Preferred)

Hard Skills

  • Experience with Santander’s Data Platform, Data Lake, and/or Power Platform ecosystem. (Required)
  • Familiarity with internal Santander architecture principles and patterns. (Preferred)
  • Exposure to Agile delivery models, particularly within highly regulated financial environments. (Preferred)

Soft Skills

  • Ability to translate complex governance data into actionable insights through clear, well-structured visualizations. (Required)
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills with experience working across architecture, engineering, risk, and compliance functions. (Preferred)
  • Strong attention to detail, documentation, and presentation standards suitable for audit and regulatory reviews. (Required)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.
Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.


Salary Range:
£61,600.00 - £92,400.00 per annum (depending on experience)

This salary range represents the expected remuneration for the role. Annual salary is based on a standard 35-hour working week. Actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, qualifications and location.


  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

title: QA Supervisor
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Job description:

Job Overview
The Quality Assurance Supervisor plays a key role in ensuring that food safety, regulatory compliance, and quality standards are maintained throughout the facility. This role requires daily presence on the production floor, actively monitoring Operations while supporting QA to ensure processes consistently meet company and regulatory requirements. The Supervisor works closely with both QA and Operations teams to promote an audit‑ready culture and drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Floor Oversight & Compliance (High Priority)

· Maintain daily presence on the production floor, actively monitoring Operations while supporting Quality Assurance to ensure food safety and quality standards are met.

· Conduct routine GMP observations, process checks, and verification activities across all production areas.

· Provide real-time coaching and corrective guidance to Operations personnel to reinforce adherence to GMPs, sanitation procedures, proper documentation practices, and QA requirements.

· Serve as the primary on-floor QA support resource, collaborating with Operations to identify, communicate, and resolve issues quickly.

Food Safety & Quality Program Management

· Serve as Backup SQF Practitioner, supporting SQF system maintenance and documentation.

· Participate as a key member of the HACCP Team and Food Quality Plan Team.

· Support specialty programs such as the Gluten-Free Program, Organic Program, and others.

· Assist in developing, maintaining, and updating QA and food safety documentation, procedures, and work instructions.

Audit & Compliance

· Support preparation for and participation in third‑party audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.

· Conduct internal audits, plant inspections, and facility walk-throughs to ensure continuous compliance.

· Promote and maintain an audit-ready environment across all production and storage areas.


Operations & Technical Support

· Provide QA support during production runs, including sampling, testing, and monitoring activities.

· Assess quality deviations and partner with Operations to implement corrective actions.

· Recommend improvements to processes, equipment, and workflows to enhance food safety and operational efficiency.

· Perform all tasks required of QA Technicians when necessary.


Leadership & Training

· Guide, train, and support QA Technicians to ensure strong floor coverage and consistent application of QA practices.

· Promote a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement across all departments.

Additional Responsibilities

· Complete other duties as assigned by the QA Manager to support departmental goals and compliance requirements.


Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Food Science or a related scientific field (preferred).

· SQF certification and PCQI certification (or ability to obtain).

· Experience in food manufacturing with strong knowledge of food safety, quality systems, GMPs, and regulatory requirements.

· Strong communication, leadership, and problem‑solving skills, especially in fast-paced production environments.

· Ability to read and interpret SOPs, equipment manuals, and regulatory documents.

· Proficiency in MS Office and electronic quality systems (preferred).


Physical Requirements

· Ability to walk and move continuously throughout production and plant areas.

· Ability to stand for extended periods.

· Ability to bend, reach, and lift up to 20 lbs.

· Ability to work in variable temperature environments typical of food manufacturing.

General Requirements

· Always follow proper safety procedures.

· Follow all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and hygiene standards.

· Report any food safety, quality, sanitation, or equipment concerns immediately.

· Maintain professionalism and a high level of communication across all departments.

You will work independently on frontend development while collaborating closely with software developers, product owners, business stakeholders, and other technical teams across locations

  • Contribute to software quality through code reviews, automated testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
  • Participate across the software development lifecycle, including technical design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

What you’ll need to be successful in this role

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Professional experience developing modern web applications using React and Next.js.
  • Good working experience with TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Experience with modern frontend architecture, reusable components, responsive UI development, and API integration.
  • Experience working in a professional software development team using source control, code reviews, and established development practices.
  • Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international working environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, combined with a pragmatic and quality-minded approach.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn and contribute beyond your primary area of expertise

Additional skills & interests we value

The following qualities would help you contribute successfully:

  • Backend development using .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core, or Entity Framework.
  • Automated testing using Playwright, Cypress, or similar technologies.
  • Integration with enterprise systems and APIs, including Salesforce.
  • CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery.
  • Agile or similar software development methodologies.

We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology used by the team. If you have strong frontend fundamentals, sound software engineering practices, and a willingness to learn, we encourage you to apply

What we offer you

  • Work on modern applications that improve business processes and support scientific and laboratory workflows.
  • Strengthen your frontend expertise while gaining exposure to backend development, integrations, testing, and software delivery.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues, product owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams in Malaysia and Denmark.
  • Contribute across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Join a collaborative environment that values practical solutions, technical quality, continuous learning, and shared success

Working conditions

  • The position is based in Kelana Jaya, Malaysia, with a hybrid working arrangement that combines office-based and remote work. You will collaborate across locations and time zones, including with colleagues in Malaysia and Denmark.
  • Normal working hours apply, with flexibility when cross-location collaboration requires it.

title: Summit Senior Business Consultant, Middle Office
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Help Financial Institutions Strengthen Risk, Control & Operational Excellence

Join Teciem as a Summit Senior Business Consultant, Middle Office and help leading financial institutions optimize their Treasury and Capital Markets operations.

As part of Teciem's Global Professional Services team, you will contribute to Summit implementation, upgrade, migration, and transformation programs, helping clients enhance risk management, trade lifecycle controls, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

This role is ideal for a consultant with strong Middle Office expertise who enjoys working closely with clients, solving complex business challenges, and growing their consulting career within a collaborative, high-performing environment.

What You'll Do

Deliver Middle Office Solutions

  • Support the analysis, design, configuration, and implementation of Summit Middle Office solutions.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into effective functional designs and system configurations.
  • Participate in workshops, solution design sessions, and business process reviews.
  • Support testing, user acceptance activities, go-live, and post-production support.
  • Contribute to successful delivery across implementation and transformation projects.

Support Risk & Control Transformation

Work with clients across areas such as:

  • Trade Lifecycle Management
  • Market Risk Management
  • Counterparty Credit Risk
  • Exposure Monitoring
  • Limits Management
  • Valuation & P&L Validation
  • Liquidity & Funding Risk
  • Collateral Management
  • Regulatory Compliance & Reporting
  • Trade Controls & Exception Management
  • Treasury & Capital Markets Operations

Build Strong Client Relationships

  • Work closely with Risk, Treasury, Operations, Finance, and Technology stakeholders.
  • Provide functional recommendations and industry best practices.
  • Support issue resolution and process improvement initiatives.
  • Deliver a high level of customer service and stakeholder engagement.

Contribute to Team Success

  • Collaborate with functional, technical, and delivery teams across global projects.
  • Share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the development of project deliverables, templates, and best practices.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior consultants when appropriate.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Treasury, Capital Markets, Banking, Risk Management, or Financial Services.
  • Experience working on Summit projects or similar Treasury and Capital Markets platforms.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, business transformations, or operational change initiatives.
  • Strong client-facing consulting and stakeholder management skills.
  • Consulting experience is advantageous.

Functional Expertise

Knowledge of several of the following areas:

  • Middle Office Operations
  • Trade Lifecycle Management
  • Market Risk Management
  • Counterparty Credit Risk
  • Exposure Management
  • Valuation & Pricing Controls
  • P&L Analysis
  • Liquidity Risk Management
  • Collateral Management
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Treasury Risk Processes
  • Capital Markets Business Processes

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong business analysis and requirements gathering skills.
  • Experience with functional solution configuration and testing.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, or data analysis techniques is advantageous.
  • Understanding of software implementation and project delivery methodologies.

What Makes You Successful

  • Customer-focused with strong relationship management skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and workshop facilitation capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic consulting environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a continuous learning mindset.
  • Comfortable working with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to leverage AI and automation tools responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and knowledge sharing.



Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

title: Fermentation Control Intern
description:

Interested in a career that matters?

At Novonesis, we are pushing the boundaries of fermentation technology by developing next-generation control strategies that enable higher productivity, increased robustness, and improved sustainability. As a Fermentation Control intern, you will join our Fermentation and Recovery Development team in our Development and Optimization of Microbes organization that is responsible for the development, scale-up, and optimization of microbe products, processes, and technologies. Our teams are composed of scientists and researchers with diverse backgrounds that use a wide array of lab-, pilot-, and production-scale equipment, plus advanced data and digitalization tools, to develop and launch new products. We also collaborate with colleagues globally to take advantage of our combined knowledge in industrial microbiology.

About the Role

As a Fermentation Control Intern, you will work alongside Scientists and Research Associates to enhance fermentation performance, productivity, and process robustness, with a particular focus on Bacillus and yeast production processes. Specifically, you will implement and test a new fermentation control strategy on our bench and pilot fermentation systems while gaining experience with fermentation equipment and utilities, sensors, and programming strategies.

  • Biochemical Engineering
  • Biological Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Or a related technical discipline

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Exposure to Research and Development, analytical equipment, fermentation equipment and controls

Bring your whole-self to work

title: Image Review Associate II
description:
Job Summary:

Job Description:

Role Summary

The Image Review Associate plays a direct role in Elovate's mission to make roads safer. In this position, you will review and adjudicate traffic enforcement images — including speed, red light, school zone, and work zone violations — on a computer screen, ensuring that each citation meets client and jurisdictional requirements before it is issued. This is a detail-oriented, production-focused role where accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established procedures are essential to the quality and integrity of Elovate's enforcement programs.

Responsibilities

Image Review & Adjudication

  • Review traffic enforcement images captured from automated enforcement systems on a computer screen, carefully examining each image to determine whether a violation meets the criteria for citation issuance.

  • Apply jurisdiction-specific rules, violation thresholds, and evidentiary standards consistently across all assigned programs.

  • Assess image quality, vehicle identification, and violation elements to ensure accuracy before transmitting to the next processing stage.

  • Flag ambiguous, unclear, or non-compliant images for supervisor review in accordance with escalation procedures.

  • Maintain a high level of accuracy and throughput to meet daily and weekly production targets.

Document & Data Processing

  • Receive, process, and classify documents and violation data from electronic and hard copy sources.

  • Sort, image, file, and archive documents and records by form type and program requirements.

  • Capture and enter data accurately based on client-specific requirements and established procedures.

  • Verify data generated by automated extraction tools, correcting errors and flagging discrepancies.

  • Ensure completed data and processed images are transmitted to the appropriate next level in a timely manner.

  • Support outbound correspondence processing as required by client contracts.

Quality & Compliance

  • Follow all established processing procedures, quality standards, and client contract requirements.

  • Maintain a consistent error rate within program quality benchmarks.

  • Participate in quality audits and accept coaching to improve accuracy.

  • Comply with all Elovate policies, data privacy requirements, and program-specific confidentiality standards.

  • Report system issues, image quality problems, or unusual volume trends to the supervisor promptly.

Requirements

  • Entry-level role; no prior experience required — we will train the right candidate.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to make consistent, accurate decisions at volume.

  • Comfortable working in a production environment with daily throughput expectations.

  • Ability to prioritize, multi-task, and maintain focus and accuracy under pressure.

  • Basic computer proficiency; comfortable navigating web-based platforms and data entry tools.

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal direction.

  • Strong communication skills and willingness to ask questions and accept feedback.

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience in data entry, document processing, image review, or a production operations environment.

  • Familiarity with traffic enforcement, public safety, or government services.

  • Experience working in a role requiring high accuracy and adherence to defined procedures.

AI & Technology

Elovate uses AI-assisted tools to support the image review process. Image Review Associates are expected to work comfortably alongside these tools while applying their own judgment to every decision.

  • Work with AI-assisted image processing tools that may pre-screen images or flag potential violations — your role is to review those outputs and make the final adjudication decision.

  • Understand that AI tools support your work but do not replace your judgment; every citation decision requires human review and sign-off.

  • Report unexpected AI tool behavior, unusual outputs, or quality concerns to your supervisor so improvements can be made.

  • Be open to learning and adapting as Elovate introduces updated AI tools and workflows into the image review process.

  • Participate in training sessions on new AI-assisted tools and contribute feedback on usability and accuracy.

About Elovate

Elovate, a Modaxo company, has been a trusted partner to municipalities and state agencies for over 30 years. We deliver data-driven automated traffic enforcement solutions — covering speed, red light, school zone, and work zone safety — designed to prevent dangerous driving behaviors before they lead to incidents. Our mission is simple: protect lives and create safer roads for the communities we serve. As part of Modaxo, a global collective of people-movement technology companies, we combine deep industry expertise with innovative technology to make meaningful, lasting impact.

National Radio Astronomy Observatory


Title: Scientist (Open Rank)

Location: NRAO Albuquerque Office, 800 Bradbury Dr SE Ste 235, ALBUQUERQUE, New Mexico, United States of America• NRAO Array Operations Center, PO Box 0, SOCORRO, New Mexico, United States of America

Position Description:

Position Summary

The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) is a prestigious research and development organization that plays a vital role in the study of the universe. Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory is a hub for technological and scientific collaboration, operating state-of-the-art radio telescope facilities for use by the international scientific community. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe.

The development of an X-Ka wideband receiver spanning 8-38 GHz has begun for the VLBA, enabling new scientific and astrometric capabilities for the instrument. This highly anticipated upgrade will add flexibility and enhance performance by significantly increasing the instantaneous bandwidth available for channelization, enabling access to previously unobservable frequencies, and enabling more efficient and comprehensive spectral studies.

The NRAO is seeking a Scientist, Open Rank (Assistant, Associate, or Scientist) to be the Project Scientist for the VLBA X-Ka Wideband Receiver Project. The appointee will be expected to spend 75% of their time on functional work as part of the VLBA Development Team, with the remaining 25% available for independent research. The primary responsibility of this position is to help oversee the development and integration of a novel X-Ka receiver system being developed for installation on the VLBA. The appointment will be on the NRAO Scientist track, with starting rank determined by the candidate’s experience.

  • This position will be a three-year appointment, with the possibility of renewal subject to observatory needs, budget and mutual agreement.
  • It will be based in New Mexico at either the Albuquerque or Socorro NRAO office with travel between the two sites as required.

What You Will be Doing

Technical Development and Integration:

  • Capture and maintain top level project requirements
  • Work with project leadership to develop and maintain project foundation documents
  • Organize testing and commissioning campaigns and preparation of test reports
  • Help coordinate installation while minimizing impacts to the VLBA observing program
  • Prepare material for and participate within project reviews
  • Establish standard observing bands
  • Participate in trade studies

Community and User Support:

  • Communicate with scientific users and external mission partners
  • Prepare user- and public-facing documentation such as user guides, news articles, press releases

Scientific Contribution:

  • Contribute to the broader VLBA development portfolio by consulting and collaborating with teams on parallel projects like the Next Generation Radar (ngRadar) and the Next Generation VLA (ngVLA).
  • Maintain awareness of developments at related astronomical facilities
  • Maintain an active independent research program which ideally makes significant use of Observatory facilities

Work Environment

The position is based in an office environment. The successful candidate must be able to work at a computer with detailed and complex textual and numerical information.

Who You Are:

Education

  • A PhD. In astronomy or related field

Experience

  • At least one year of related experience using radio interferometry for astronomical research

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong communication skills in written and oral English
  • Strong inter-personal skills
  • Familiarity with Linux / Unix operating systems
  • Ability to travel

Preferred:

  • High-level understanding of the functionality of radio telescopes
  • Experience scheduling VLBI experiments
  • Experience reducing VLBI data
  • Experience within a leadership team of medium to large projects
  • Proficiency in the Python computer language

Additional Requirement

Observatory employees must be authorized to work in the United States. The Observatory presently cannot sponsor H-1B Visas for this position.

Total Rewards:

Compensation

The starting salary rate of this position is between $85,000-$138,000 per year. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include; education, experience, skills, competencies, other qualifications of the successful candidate, as well as internal equity and labor market conditions.

Benefits:

Associated Universities, Inc (AUI) offers a comprehensive benefits package addressing the needs of employees and their families with most benefits beginning on the first day of employment, subject to eligibility requirements. AUI provides:

  • Excellent paid time off (13 holidays, annual accrual of up to 24 vacation days)
  • Medical, dental and vision plans are effective on the first day of employment.

To ensure success, the ideal candidate is driven to understand all aspects of NICB’s business to ensure the effectiveness of the IT Infrastructure solutions deployed, and is effective in collaborating to further the continuous improvement of NICB’s Enterprise IT & OT organization going forward.

RESPONSIBILTIES

High-level Day to Day Problem Resolution:

  • Leverage your technical skills to resolve tickets and problems escalated related to IT\OT Infrastructure solutions.

  • Determine the root cause of problems and eliminate those barriers to success.

  • Become the SME for the technical aspects of the ITOT Infrastructure area of responsibility within NICB.

High-level Strategy & Planning

  • Design, implement and maintain the organization's infrastructure, including on-premises and cloud-based solutions.

  • Manage the integration of cloud-based solutions with on-premises infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security.

  • Work with external vendors and service providers as needed.

Governance & Planning

  • Lead and mentor the infrastructure team to ensure all systems infrastructure and services are maintained in a multi-site 24/7 environment across North America.

  • Collaborate with NICB’s Enterprise IT & OT teams, to assess near- and long-term infrastructure capacity needs in support of IT Leadership directives.

  • Create and maintain documentation as it relates to infrastructure configuration, processes, and service records.

  • Assist in the development and adoption of policies, procedures, and associated training plans for overall infrastructure administration, usage, and disaster recovery.

Acquisition & Deployment

  • Design and deploy enterprise infrastructure technologies including servers, network devices, storage and backups, UPSs, and coordinate with site maintenance personnel to ensure reliability of core infrastructure supporting plant operations.

  • Conduct research on infrastructure products, services, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the infrastructure industry.

  • Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades of ITOT Infrastructure solutions.

  • Develop and manage relationship with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure infrastructure products and services.

Operational Management

  • Configure systems and network infrastructure to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling business objectives and processes.

  • Monitor systems and network infrastructure performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed.

  • Oversee installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of servers, including database, print, and backup servers and their associated operating systems and software.

  • Oversee and implement Group Policies, performing best practice management of Active Directory and O365.

  • Coordinate and execute patching of all systems equipment as available patching windows and as guided by the NICB Enterprise Security team.

  • Practice asset management, including maintenance of server component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information.

  • Monitor and test systems performance and provide relevant KPIs.

  • Participate in managing all infrastructure security solutions.

  • Perform server and security audits, and system backups and recovery.

  • Collaborate with NICB’s Enterprise Security Team to ensure security compliance and hardening of all systems and equipment.

  • Provide guidance to other members of the ITOT Infrastructure team.

  • Adherence to change control processes.

title: Intern, Revenue Administration
description:
Job Description



College Intern – Revenue Administration


Start building your career while gaining hands-on experience in public-sector finance, grants, and program administration! As a College Intern supporting OCTA’s Revenue Administration, you’ll work alongside experienced professionals and contribute to the department’s day-to-day activities, recurring processes, and special projects.


This position offers exposure to grant administration, financial reconciliations, compliance activities, program analysis, reporting, and project tracking while helping you develop valuable analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.


OCTA's College Intern Program is a year-round paid student/intern program. You will gain real-world work experience on meaningful projects under the guidance of experienced transportation professionals. You will have opportunities to strengthen your problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills while benefiting from mentorship, career development, and internal networking.


The pay range is $20.00 – $23.00 per hour, depending on education level. This position is not eligible for employee benefits. The work schedule will consist of approximately 20 hours per week, not to exceed 1,000 hours within a continuous 12-month period.


This posting will remain open until a candidate is selected.


What You’ll Do


  • Assist with grant administration and ongoing departmental projects.

  • Assist with compliance audits and related documentation.
  • Compile, organize, and analyze financial and program data.
  • Develop and maintain spreadsheets, tracking tools, and reports.
  • Assist with program analysis and research assignments.
  • Prepare presentations, memos, reports, and other business materials.
  • Support project tracking and monitor activities, deadlines, and deliverables.

What We’re Looking For


  • Currently enrolled full-time as a Freshman, Sophomore, Junior, or Senior at a four-year college or university and pursuing a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, public administration, economics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, research, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with financial and program information.

Why You’ll Love It Here

Join a team where innovation, integrity, and strategic thinking are valued.
Apply now to help shape the future of OCTA’s programs.

title: Reconstruction Project Manager
description:
Thomasville Restoration's vision is to be the #1 most trusted and respected restoration company.





Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year


About Thomasville Restoration

Thomasville Restoration’s vision is to be the #1 restoration company in the Mid-Atlantic Region. To help achieve this goal and support our growth, we are adding a Project Manager. This position offers a unique opportunity to support our mission of putting families’ homes and lives back together across the MidAtlantic while upholding our culture of Family First, Compassion, and Communication.

What You’ll Do

  • Ensure 100% compliance with Thomasville’s Project Concierge Playbook
  • Manage restoration projects ranging from $1,000 to $60,000
  • Oversee approximately 22–28 active projects at any given time
  • Create long- and short-term plans, including setting milestones and meeting deadlines

  • Submit receipts and verify accuracy of job costing within QuickBooks

Who You Are

  • Covers West Philly, West Chester, Reading, and Wilmington area

As a Project Manager, you are the homeowner’s trusted guide throughout the reconstruction process. You coordinate schedules, manage subcontractors, and ensure funding, materials, and communication all align.

By reducing stress for homeowners and protecting their investment, you directly fulfill Thomasville’s mission of putting homes and lives back together.

title: Coordinator, Community Engagement
description:
Powered by Passion. United by Purpose. Build for Impact.

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one.

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.

We bring these teams – and world-class entertainment – to life at our iconic venues, including Scotiabank Arena, BMO Field, Coca-Cola Coliseum, Ford Performance Centre, BMO Training Ground, and OVO Athletic Centre. Off the field, we serve up elevated dining at e11even, Real Sports, and our signature club spaces like Hot Stove Club, ScotiaClub, and Platinum Club.

Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.

This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves.

So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team.

** We know that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, transferable skills, and lived experience may be exactly what we’re looking for. **

Job Description

As a member of our dynamic MLSE Community Engagement Team, you will be at centre court of the action. Reporting to the Manager of Engagement, you will be responsible for coordinating In-Reach initiatives, external group and school excursions to MLSE LaunchPad, creating collaborative initiatives, overseeing positive program experiences for youth in programs, and maintaining the strong family culture we have at MLSE LaunchPad.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to the administration, planning, evaluation, and growth of the youth engagement strategy.

What’s Great About This Job:

As the Community Engagement Coordinator, you will be responsible for the overall positive experience of the MLSE LaunchPad members participating in our amazing programs, cool opportunities and special events. This is a people job – how we care and show up for our people and our community influences the outcomes and impact of our programming.

Your Team:

Our “one team” approach means you'll work in collaboration with the Sport Programming and Member Engagement Teams. Both teams pride themselves on creating the absolute best experience for youth in our programming, and put our “Youth First, Always” value at the core of their work. We are passionate about the community, building and maintaining real relationships, the quality of our programming, and, above all, the experience of the youth and staff in our spaces.

What You Will Be Doing:

· Work with the Manager, Community Engagement to develop and execute a youth engagement strategy to support the positive experience of youth in MLSE LaunchPad programs

· Provide direct in-reach support for multi-year programs, new programs and programs serving specific populations

· Maintain relationships with local high schools and elementary schools to ensure teachers, youth and parents are aware of opportunities and feel supported during excursions to MLSE LaunchPad

· Assist with scheduling and implementation of Youth Volunteerism and related marketing activities, campaigns, and strategies

· Generate promotional materials such as brochures, public presentations, newsletters and email updates

· Lead, promote and represent the MLSE LaunchPad Youth Advisory Committee within the space

· Support youth-focused special events and initiatives to build and sustain engagement among existing members of the facility

· Work across teams to help plan, organize and execute Summer Camps, March Break and other holiday programming, PA Days and other special events, actively promoting a comfortable and welcoming environment for youth of all ages

Qualifications

You’ll Be A Great Fit For This Job If:

You are versatile, flexible, and willing to work within changing priorities with enthusiasm

  • We interact with numerous diverse communities and community organizations, as well as departments across Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment.

You are highly organized and can manage and prioritize competing responsibilities

  • We work in a fast-paced environment with a number of different programs, events and administrative priorities running simultaneously. Being organized and working as a team are key components of your role.
  • Strong critical thinking and conceptual skills to prioritize multiple programs, events and engagements.

You are a collaborator

  • We are one team, and every decision we make impacts someone else. Understanding who to bring in and how is important.

You have experience supporting, planning and executing both programs and special events

  • Many of our projects will include both programmatic and events-based components and will require support planning, delivering, and debriefing components.
  • With so many stakeholders, it is crucial to maintain high professional standards with the ability to see the big picture while managing the practical details.

You have an understanding of “Youth First Always” and the importance in a youth sport context (or a willingness to learn)

  • All of what we plan and do in our program centers around the positive experience of the youth we serve.

You care about how inequity in sport continues to impact girls and racialized and marginalized communities, and are committed to breaking down the barriers to youth access in sport

  • You have familiarity with and a passion for applying anti-oppressive and anti-racist principles to your work and engage in continued learning in these areas.

REQUIREMENTS


  • 3+ years working in community engagement or youth in-reach/outreach
  • Strong experience in developing and supporting programs
  • -Passionate about sport and believe sport can change lives
  • Experience overseeing budgets
  • Proven track record of working with people of all ages and cultural backgrounds
  • Proven track record of working with senior business, government and non-profit leaders
  • Demonstrated experience supervising staff and volunteers

Job Posting Compensation Range/Rate:

$50,000-55,000

title: Senior System Engineer - AI Program
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards to enable technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


The EcoNet System Lead is responsible for the end-to-end leadership of the EcoNet platform, including product strategy, system architecture alignment, customer deployment readiness, roadmap execution, and cross-functional coordination between Engineering, Applications, Product Management, Support, and Field Teams.

The role serves as the technical and operational focal point for EcoNet solutions, ensuring successful delivery of AI-driven inspection, review, and classification capabilities while driving infrastructure modernization, product scalability, and customer success.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in multidisciplinary R&D environments.
  • Experience with Architecture of AI-SW products, Microservices, Cloud native App
  • Proven experience leading complex system development programs.
  • Strong understanding of system engineering, architecture, integration, and qualification methodologies.
  • Experience working with Software, Algorithms, Applications, HW and Manufacturing teams.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to drive execution and influence without direct authority.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.



We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.


KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Youth Ministry Director at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida
description:
*Please note this position would require our Staff to live near the community where they would be doing ministry.

Description:

There are nearly 300,000 teenagers of active-duty U.S. military parents who are stationed all over the world. These teens move an average of seven times during their school-aged years. The questions of identity and belonging that all teens face grow even more challenging to answer amid starting over and meeting new friends at each location.

This is where you can be the difference in a military teen’s life! By being in their world, walking alongside them, and creating a community where they experience the truth of God’s love and purpose for them, our staff provide a safe space where teens can develop friendships and connections to experience laughter, build hope, and generate resiliency.

We are currently providing incarnational ministry at many military installations around the world. You will have the opportunity to lead and oversee the overall Young Life Military program, known as Club Beyond, which is ecumenically focused and outreach oriented.

We are currently looking for both full-time and part-time staff throughout the United States, as well as international locations. Colorado Springs, CO, is the headquarters.

description:
Interested in a career that matters?




In our Fermentation department, you’ll join a team responsible for critical production steps—including sanitizing, pelletizing/freeze‑drying, mixing, separating, and monitoring—to ensure safe, precise, and high‑quality output. The team collaborates closely, troubleshoots equipment or process issues, and supports each other across trained areas. You’ll also contribute to continuous improvement using Lean principles and help develop peers through training and knowledge sharing.

The Role & Your Impact

As an Operator in Fermentation, you’ll play a central role in operating, adjusting, sanitizing, and monitoring specialized equipment used to produce high‑quality microbial products. Your work ensures process consistency, compliance with GMP standards, and seamless production flow. You’ll contribute directly to product quality, safety, and operational excellence.


Key responsibilities include:
• Preparing, operating, adjusting, cleaning, and sanitizing fermentation and processing equipment.
• Mixing raw materials, overseeing fermentation runs, and completing downstream separation and bulk packaging.
• Handling materials—including transporting product in and out of -55°C freezers; stacking, labeling, and verifying lot/batch numbers for traceability.
• Collecting and submitting samples for Quality Control testing.
• Following GMPs, ISO safety protocols, sanitary requirements, and supporting Kosher/Halal compliance.
• Complying with facility hygiene rules (no jewelry, nail polish, artificial nails/lashes, perfumes, etc.) and restricted food/beverage and cell phone use.
• Completing accurate documentation and data entry for production, inventory, and quality records.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

• High School Diploma or GED.
• Ability to read, write, and speak English.
• Basic math skills, including metric conversions.
• Ability to read and follow production journals and instructions.
• Ability to use basic hand tools (hammer, screwdriver, wrench) for equipment assembly/disassembly.
• Basic computer skills; SAP experience preferred.
• Strong communication skills with co‑workers regarding process status.
• Experience in regulated, fermentation, or food manufacturing environments preferred but not required.
• Ability to operate a pallet walker and/or forklift (preferred).

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

• Curiosity and drive to learn the process deeply—not just follow steps.
• Reliability and pride in producing high‑quality work.
• Strong attention to detail to maintain safety and quality.
• Desire to support teammates, share knowledge, and contribute to continuous improvement.

What We Offer

• A collaborative team environment focused on learning and continuous improvement.
• Opportunities to expand technical skills in fermentation and downstream operations.
• A role where your contribution directly supports product quality and customer satisfaction.

Ways of Working / Working Conditions

• Schedule: 7‑on/7‑off rotation on nights
– Monday–Friday: 10‑hour shifts
– Saturday–Sunday: 12‑hour shifts
• Overtime: Built into the schedule, with additional hours available during off‑weeks as needed.
• Environment: Wet, humid, dusty, or loud conditions; exposure to chemicals, airborne particles, moving machine parts, and extremely cold environments (-55°C). Work may occur in small air‑locked rooms.
• PPE: Required company uniform, coveralls, dust mask, hearing protection, hair/beard nets, safety glasses, gloves, safety shoes.
• Allergens: Potential exposure to milk/dairy allergens.
• Hygiene rules: No jewelry, fragrances, artificial nails/lashes; restricted food/beverages; no personal cell phones in production areas.
• Physical demands: Frequent standing, walking, kneeling, crouching, crawling, scooping, lifting/moving up to 50 lbs; operating equipment and tools.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Hourly rate: $19–$25 per hour, based on experience. plus shift premium
  • 401(k) with up to a 9% company contribution
  • Minimum of 3 weeks of vacation plus 12 holidays and 2 weeks of Wellness Time
  • Health, Dental, Vision & Life insurance
  • Healthcare savings account option
  • Employee assistance program
  • Parental leave
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • All benefits begin on your first day

Relevant Information

• Application deadline: 10/23/26

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
