title: Product Owner
description:
Summary:
The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners, IT partners, and delivery/engineering teams to build and execute a strategy in alignment with business priorities. Ownership of the product roadmap and a quality backlog will ensure teams deliver the highest-value outcomes with clear priorities and well-defined work. The Product Owner is responsible for maintaining strong relationships with a variety of partners to facilitate discussions, identify dependencies or areas of efficiency, and ensure successful execution of features.

In addition, the Product Owner will build and document requirements in the form of initiatives, epics, features and user stories, communicate daily with the delivery/engineering team, run team meetings and ceremonies, and accept or reject work results.


The Product Owner is an excellent communicator who excels when coordinating efforts, setting expectations, and driving results.


Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy & Planning
  • Define and maintain the product vision, goals, and roadmap in alignment with high-value outcomes.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define outcomes, success metrics, and sequencing.

Backlog ownership

  • Own and refine the product backlog: initiatives/epics/features/stories, prioritization, and readiness, ensuring business direction leads to prioritized, well-shaped work.
  • Work with IT teams to manage and prioritize technical debt, ensuring proper allocation of time between maintenance and feature work.
  • Define and enforce standards (e.g., Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, clear acceptance criteria, intake process, backlog hygiene).

Discovery & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Drive discovery to surface and clarify problems while presenting high-value solutions.
  • Facilitate tradeoff decisions by presenting clear options (scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks).
  • Manage and report on critical metrics.

Delivery Partnership:

  • Partner with IT partners and delivery/engineering teams to plan and manage flow.
  • Support a balance of Scrum practices (e.g., sprint goals/planning).

Position Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Experience as a Product Owner (or equivalent) owning prioritization and backlog quality for enterprise platforms. Customer portal experience is preferred.
  • Strong skills in backlog creation (epics/stories), acceptance criteria, and prioritization methods.
  • Proven ability to run discovery and align stakeholders around outcomes and tradeoffs.
  • Experience working with Kanban teams, scrum teams, agile ceremonies, etc. Experience with Jira is preferred.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, including operating effectively with a variety of stakeholders and technical/data teams.
  • Experience coordinating efforts across business units and technical teams.
  • Knowledge of program, project and change management practices.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Licensing and/or Certification

title: Lead, Systems Engineering - Solipsys
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title:** Lead, Systems Engineering - Solipsys

**Job Code:** 43459

**Job Location:** Rockwall, TX

**Job Schedule:** 9/80 - Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off.

**Job Description:**

Perform as part of a team that supports the requirements, design, development, test, and integration of complex, specialized hardware/software systems installed on ground and airborne ISR and communication platforms. The ideal candidate will serve as a subject matter expert in Solipsys command-and-control (C2) mission software, providing hands-on architecture development requirements, system design, configuration, integration, and testing expertise for airborne system applications. Travel requirement will vary with the phase of the program, ranging from <10% during SW development phases to an excess of 50% during integration, testing, and delivery.

**Essential Functions:**

- Serve as the primary C2 product owner, leveraging in-depth working knowledge of Solipsys software architecture, features, and the full range of available configuration options.
- Integrate and configure Solipsys mission software for use with airborne C2 weapon systems (NATO desired), ensuring compatibility and operational effectiveness with external weapon system platforms.
- Develop, manage, and maintain exportable Solipsys configurations for use across multiple programs within business area.
- Translate operational concepts (CONOPS) into C2 software requirements and configurations that meet mission requirements.
- Translate customer requests into system, subsystem, and product level requirements and ensure proper requirement traceability throughout the program lifecycle.
- Write subsystem specifications based on system-level requirements and evaluate alternative solutions to establish preliminary system designs.
- Prepare effective presentations to communicate Solypsis C2 capabilities as integrated into the weapon system to non-technical professionals, operators and government customers.
- Develop, author, and implement software and system test plans in a collaborative team environment.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering technology and minimum of 9 years of relevant experience (Software Engineer also considered with relevant experience).
- Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience.
- In lieu of a degree, a minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
- Strong understanding of core Systems Engineering requirements development, decomposition, traceability, verification, and validation, with the ability to translate customer and stakeholder needs into clear, testable, and compliant system requirements.
- Demonstrated, hands-on experience integrating and configuring Solipsys mission software for airborne and/or ground-based system applications.
- Working knowledge of Solipsys C2 software architecture and how to configure Solipsys C2 software to support a NATO C2 weapon system.
- Demonstrated experience working with OpenShift deployments and cluster environments.
- Prior experience obtaining ATO of a software solution supporting a weapon system.
- In-depth knowledge of requirement development process to integrate Solipsys C2 software with both OTS and custom developed software products.
- In-depth knowledge of Solypsis SDK, API interfaces, data flows, and system architecture.
- Security+ Certified.
- DoD Secret Clearance with eligibility for TS/SCI; requires U.S. Citizenship.

**Strongly Preferred:**

- Experience creating and managing exportable Solipsys configurations for deployment across multiple platforms or customer environments.
- Familiarity with Solipsys software updates, version management, and configuration baseline control.
- Experience identifying and troubleshooting software and/or network anomalies.
- Aircraft optical sensor system integration and ground/flight test support experience.
- Experience with obtaining and maintaining a government network ATO (Authorization to Operate).
- Experience working with subcontractors and U.S. Government customers.
- Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
- Hands-on experience testing, integrating, and verifying hardware and/or software systems.
- Ability to support flight test/ability to obtain active flight physical.

We are looking for a dedicated, professional and customer-focused individual to join Hull Register Office as a Registration Officer.

This is a unique and rewarding role, providing the opportunity to support people during some of the most important moments of their lives. From registering births and deaths to conducting marriage and civil partnership ceremonies, you will play a key role in delivering a high-quality registration service for the residents of Hull.

We're looking for a real people person who is confident communicating with a wide range of customers, can put people at ease in sensitive situations, and is committed to delivering outstanding customer service with empathy, professionalism and integrity.

As a Registration Officer, you will carry out statutory registration duties, conduct interviews with customers, ensure legal requirements are met, maintain accurate records and support the delivery of ceremonies in a dignified and professional manner. The role requires excellent attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to work confidently within legislative frameworks and procedures.

The successful candidate will have strong communication and interpersonal skills, be highly organised and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion. You will enjoy working with people from all backgrounds and be committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming service.

In return, you will become part of a supportive and experienced team, receive specialist training and have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of registration law and practice while making a meaningful difference to the lives of Hull residents.

ROLE AND PURPOSE

To carry out the statutory functions of a Registrar of Births, Deaths and Marriages, providing a professional and customer focused registration service to customers within the Hull Registration District, delivering a full range of registration services that complies with General guidelines and with legislation relating to Register Offices.

To register life events, interviewing parents or relatives after a birth or death and recording accurate details for both paper and computerised records.

To both undertake legal preliminaries and conduct and register civil ceremonies such as marriages and civil partnerships in line with legislation and in a dignified and professional manner.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:
    1. To register births, deaths, still births, marriages and civil partnerships in a legal and timely manner. This involves interviewing members of the public in the strictest of confidence to obtain information to complete an accurate registration. Ensure accurate, legal and legible records are maintained.

    2. Issue certificates and other appropriate paperwork following registration. To be responsible for the maintenance and security of stock items and stationary within their possession and work area.

    3. To take marriage notice / legal preliminaries from couples, ensure that relevant sight of appropriate documents and accurate recording of information. Ensure the timely printing and checking of certificates for marriage, highlighting any discrepancies at the earliest opportunity.

    4. To be responsible for the collection, recording and banking of statutory and non statutory fees, this includes the issue of appropriate receipts and recording of transactions in respect of payments to the council and stationary used. Ensure that this is done efficiently and accurately in order to maximise income in to the council and that accurate and auditable records are maintained.

    5. To register marriages and civil partnerships in accordance with legislation. This involves checking that all necessary paperwork is available for the registration to proceed, interviewing couples to validate information and ensure an accurate registration. Witnessing declaratory and contracting words within a ceremony, and completing a handwritten registration and / or electronic registration.

    6. To conduct a range of ceremonies suitable for the occasion, of a high standard and meet both customer expectations and legal requirements. This includes both small ceremonies at the and large ceremonies in approved venues across the city.

    7. To attend and deliver non statutory services including Nationality & Settlement Checking, Citizenship, Renewal of Vows, Naming Ceremonies and Funerals and to take notices of Marriage and Civil Partnership, issuing appropriate certificates and paperwork.

    8. To take ownership of respond to enquiries and requests for assistance and advice from the public, regarding technical registration issues and ensure that accurate and appropriate information is provided.

    9. Safeguard the integrity of the registration, through an awareness of sham marriage and other opportunities for fraudulent / criminal activity (i.e. forged documents, suspect certificate applications). Be aware of own responsibilities in handling sensitive and confidential information and wider role in preventing counter fraud and public protection.

    10. To maintain working knowledge of regulations, handbooks, circulars and procedures and be able to interpret these accurately and support others to do so.

    11. Support appropriate information sharing in the ethos of ‘tell us once’ and improved and joined up service delivery to customers. Working with Customer Service Advisors to provide seamless and consistent excellent customer service signposting customers to other council services as appropriate.

    12. To contribute towards the delivery of a flexible and responsive service, working at different locations and licensed premises as appropriate. This will involve weekend working and may include delivering promotions with other organisation and partners both on and off site.

    13. The Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and associated legislation places responsibilities for health and safety on Hull City Council, as your employer and you as an employee of the council. In addition to the Councils overall duties, the post holder has personal responsibility for their own health & safety and that of other employees; additional and more specific responsibilities are identified in the Council’s Corporate H&S policy.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

What we do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit the website each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love it —our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!


Role overview

Join our first Dublin engineering team! The International team is seeking a talented and driven Principal Software Development Engineer to join new Dublin office and lead exciting product initiatives for our Canadian and UK markets and play a key role in establishing the office’s culture.


In this role, you’ll be responsible for leading the full software development lifecycle –across both the frontend and backend –


collaborating with Engineering and Product peers to design innovative solutions and tackle complex challenges for our dealer-facing products.


We are looking for candidates who are able to learn and adapt quickly, and collaborate with other engineers to deliver solutions. Some examples of potential project opportunities:



  • Building new, full-stack features for dealer products from the ground up Integrating with existing services and expanding functionality using React, TypeScript, and Java Designing and implementing integrations with third-party APIs and partners, building applications with Remix.

  • Modernizing and rearchitecting current systems to leverage cloud technologies like AWS As a principal engineer on this team, you will own projects from conception to completion, working closely with other engineers and product partners, in Dublin and in the US, to deliver impactful solutions for the international business.

  • Success in this role requires a balance of deep technical expertise and strong business judgement to guide teams in making strategic technology decisions that align with both immediate and future product needs.

  • You must quickly learn and adapt to new challenges, working closely with engineers and stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions.

  • Car expertise is welcome but isn't required; what matters most is your passion for technology, your commitment to engineering excellence, and your drive to have a real impact.


What you'll do

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders across the company to refine new product requirements and transform them into effective technical solutions.

  • Own the full development lifecycle from refining initial concepts and architecting advanced features as robust microservices and modern web applications (Java/React/TypeScript), to implementing and delivering practical, high-quality systems.

  • Contribute to high standards of quality by ensuring code is reliable, performant, and well-tested, with automated tests across the testing pyramid that ensure strong production health of our systems.

  • Promote a culture of observability and operation excellence by helping teams leverage metrics to diagnose, mitigate, and resolve challenging production issues across multiple services and boost operational excellence.

  • Use AI technologies, optimizing the software development process and driving greater efficiency across teams.

  • Mentor engineers by offering guidance, actionable feedback, and insightful recommendations to support sound technical decision-making in the new Dublin hub.


What you'll bring:

  • 8+ years of experience as a professional Software Engineer, including 3+ years serving as a technical lead or principal engineer.

  • Deep full-stack expertise working with Java and TypeScript (or similar languages) and frameworks such as Spring Boot, Hibernate, and React.

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, deploying, scaling, testing, and evolving distributed systems using service-oriented architecture in 24/7 production environments.

  • 2+ years of experience using cloud infrastructure technologies such as AWS, Terraform or similar cloud services. Hands-on experience working with both relational and NoSQL databases, applying the right data models to diverse needs. Experience in operating and troubleshooting production systems.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with a demonstrated talent for translating technical concepts for both engineering and business audiences.

  • Consistent record of being self-motivated, resourceful, and proactive in driving projects and business goals.

  • An aptitude for leveraging AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar to enhance software development and operational efficiency.

  • Additional hands-on experience with LLMs is a huge plus. Bonus: Deep experience with server-side TypeScript and modern isomorphic frameworks (especially Remix, though Next.js or Express are also highly valued)

description:
SUMMARY

New-Indy Containerboard (NICB) is seeking an ITOT Infrastructure Architect, who is responsible for the design, engineering, and day-to-day evolution of enterprise infrastructure across compute, storage, network, and cloud platforms.

This role combines hands-on engineering with architectural oversight, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives. The right candidate for this position can leverage technology to ensure operational excellence of multiple disciplines of Infrastructure technology within the 24/7/365 manufacturing facilities across North America.

The ITOT Infrastructure Architect will serve as the lead role for coordination of projects, along with direct hands-on work and mentorship within the NICB IT Infrastructure team for all activities related to the broad range of tools and technologies deployed involving servers, virtualization (both on-premises and cloud), storage, backups, as well as Office365 and Domain Administration tasks. To ensure success, the ideal candidate is driven to understand all aspects of NICB’s business to ensure the effectiveness of the IT Infrastructure solutions deployed, and is effective in collaborating to further the continuous improvement of NICB’s Enterprise IT & OT organization going forward.

RESPONSIBILTIES

High-level Day to Day Problem Resolution:

  • Leverage your technical skills to resolve tickets and problems escalated related to IT\OT Infrastructure solutions.

  • Determine the root cause of problems and eliminate those barriers to success.

  • Become the SME for the technical aspects of the ITOT Infrastructure area of responsibility within NICB.

High-level Strategy & Planning

  • Design, implement and maintain the organization's infrastructure, including on-premises and cloud-based solutions.

  • Manage the integration of cloud-based solutions with on-premises infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security.

  • Work with external vendors and service providers as needed.

Governance & Planning

  • Lead and mentor the infrastructure team to ensure all systems infrastructure and services are maintained in a multi-site 24/7 environment across North America.

  • Collaborate with NICB’s Enterprise IT & OT teams, to assess near- and long-term infrastructure capacity needs in support of IT Leadership directives.

  • Create and maintain documentation as it relates to infrastructure configuration, processes, and service records.

  • Assist in the development and adoption of policies, procedures, and associated training plans for overall infrastructure administration, usage, and disaster recovery.

Acquisition & Deployment

  • Design and deploy enterprise infrastructure technologies including servers, network devices, storage and backups, UPSs, and coordinate with site maintenance personnel to ensure reliability of core infrastructure supporting plant operations.

  • Conduct research on infrastructure products, services, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the infrastructure industry.

  • Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades of ITOT Infrastructure solutions.

  • Develop and manage relationship with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure infrastructure products and services.

Operational Management

  • Configure systems and network infrastructure to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling business objectives and processes.

  • Monitor systems and network infrastructure performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed.

  • Oversee installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of servers, including database, print, and backup servers and their associated operating systems and software.

  • Oversee and implement Group Policies, performing best practice management of Active Directory and O365.

  • Coordinate and execute patching of all systems equipment as available patching windows and as guided by the NICB Enterprise Security team.

  • Practice asset management, including maintenance of server component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information.

  • Monitor and test systems performance and provide relevant KPIs.

  • Participate in managing all infrastructure security solutions.

  • Perform server and security audits, and system backups and recovery.

  • Collaborate with NICB’s Enterprise Security Team to ensure security compliance and hardening of all systems and equipment.

  • Provide guidance to other members of the ITOT Infrastructure team.

  • Adherence to change control processes.

title: Senior Director, Market Access Pricing & Contracting
description:
Job Description:

Senior Director, Market Access Pricing & Contracting


NewAmsterdam Pharma is an innovative biotech company with the experience and expertise to deliver across its ambitious clinical, regulatory, and commercial goals. Our robust scientific approach focuses on advancing a new era of life-saving treatments for lipid-related diseases. Our vision is that people at risk for heart disease can take control of their health and live longer, fuller lives. Our team is led by a world-class team of industry veterans and key opinion leaders, including some of the world’s preeminent cardiometabolic experts and we foster a passionate, supportive culture that is backed by a high level of integrity and inclusivity.


The Senior Director, Market Access Pricing & Contracting will report to the VP, Pricing, Trade & Value Communications to lead the development and execution of NewAmsterdam Pharma's U.S. pricing, contracting, and gross-to-net (GTN) strategy in preparation for and following the company's first commercial launch, pending regulatory approval. This individual will serve as the organization's subject matter expert on pricing and payer contracting, driving key decisions that optimize patient access, market competitiveness, and long-term revenue performance.

As a strategic leader and hands-on builder, the Senior Director will partner across Market Access, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Medical Affairs, and executive leaders to establish pricing governance, evaluate market access tradeoffs, negotiate payer agreements, oversee rebate operations, and support launch readiness. The successful candidate will balance strategic analysis with execution excellence and thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. This position is an individual contributor at the time of hire.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead development of U.S. pricing strategy, including WAC recommendations, launch pricing assessments, lifecycle pricing considerations, and competitive market analyses.
  • Develop and maintain pricing governance processes, including cross-functional pricing committee leadership and executive decision support.
  • Assess pricing implications of evolving market dynamics, policy changes, competitive actions, and payer management trends.
  • Provide strategic pricing recommendations based on market research, payer insights, and financial analysis.
  • Monitor the evolving impacts of IRA, Medicare redesign, inflation penalties, and other healthcare policy developments on pricing strategy.
  • Monitor the evolving impacts of PBM reform including FTC settlements and the Consolidated Appropriations Act on pricing strategy.
  • Design and execute payer contracting strategy across commercial, Medicare, PBM, GPO, integrated delivery network (IDN), and emerging customer segments.
  • Develop channel- and customer-specific access strategies that balance formulary access objectives, net revenue targets, and patient affordability considerations.
  • Partner with Account Management to support customer negotiations and formulate evidence-based contracting recommendations.
  • Evaluate rebate, discount, and value-based agreement opportunities to optimize profitable access.
  • Lead contract strategy discussions with executive leadership and provide recommendations regarding access tradeoffs and investment priorities.
  • Lead GTN strategy development, forecasting assumptions, contracting scenario planning, and financial impact assessments.
  • Partner with Finance to develop GTN forecasts, accrual methodologies, budgeting assumptions, and launch planning models.
  • Oversee rebate administration strategy and external vendor management.
  • Monitor contract performance, rebate effectiveness, and market access ROI to ensure achievement of business objectives.
  • Develop reporting and dashboards to support pricing, contracting, and GTN decision-making.
  • Lead pricing and contracting launch readiness activities to support successful commercialization.
  • Build scalable processes, governance models, SOPs, and operating procedures for contracting and pricing management.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Trade & Distribution, Patient Support Services, Value Communications, Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations to ensure alignment across access-related functions.
  • Support development of payer engagement strategies, AMCP dossiers, value communications, health economic evidence needs, and account-specific value propositions.
  • Serve as the internal expert on market access economics, pricing strategy, and payer purchasing behavior.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 12+ years of progressive pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience in market access, pricing, contracting, managed markets, finance, or related commercial functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing U.S. pricing strategies and market access contracting programs.
  • Deep understanding of commercial and Medicare payer dynamics, PBMs, rebates, formulary management, and access pathways.
  • Significant experience with GTN, pricing analytics, revenue management, and contracting economics.
  • Experience supporting or leading product launch readiness activities.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate complex contracting scenarios.
  • Ability to lead pricing and contracting decisions, synthesize complex tradeoffs, and make clear recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across Market Access, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Medical Affairs, and external partners.
  • Knowledge of government pricing, Medicaid, 340B, and federal contracting considerations.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate complex pricing, access, and financial concepts clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional audiences.
  • High degree of accountability, sound business judgment, and an entrepreneurial, scrappy, and resourceful mindset, with the ability to build scalable capabilities and operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Proven ability to establish new capabilities, governance processes, and operating models in an emerging or first-launch commercial organization.
  • Agile, collaborative leader with the ability to adapt quickly to evolving business priorities, partner effectively across functions, and drive alignment in a fast-paced launch environment.
  • NAP operates under an on-demand workplace philosophy. This role is predominantly remote; however, in-person attendance at the Philadelphia-area office is required based on business needs, collaboration requirements, and key organizational initiatives rather than a predetermined office schedule. The frequency of onsite participation is expected to increase during commercial launch planning and launch-related activities. Candidates located within commuting distance of Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, are strongly preferred.

Salary and Benefits:

We offer a competitive base salary, annual bonus, and long-term incentives. In addition, we provide a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, dental and vision coverage, term life and disability coverage, and retirement plans.

title: Youth Ministry Director at Joint Base Lewis-McChord JBLM, Tacoma, Washington
description:
*Please note this position would require our Staff to live near the community where they would be doing ministry.

Description:

There are nearly 300,000 teenagers of active-duty U.S. military parents who are stationed all over the world. These teens move an average of seven times during their school-aged years. The questions of identity and belonging that all teens face grow even more challenging to answer amid starting over and meeting new friends at each location.

This is where you can be the difference in a military teen’s life! By being in their world, walking alongside them, and creating a community where they experience the truth of God’s love and purpose for them, our staff provide a safe space where teens can develop friendships and connections to experience laughter, build hope, and generate resiliency.

We are currently providing incarnational ministry at many military installations around the world. You will have the opportunity to lead and oversee the overall Young Life Military program, known as Club Beyond, which is ecumenically focused and outreach oriented.

We are currently looking for both full-time and part-time staff throughout the United States, as well as international locations. Colorado Springs, CO, is the headquarters.

Responsibilities:

  • Actively develop healthy relationships with adults, as well as kids, and build vibrant relationships with the local community, the military installation, and the chapel community.
  • Be a role model (incarnational) and assist with developing community outreach to "unchurched" teens, discipleship to Christian teens, and leading and equipping volunteers to do "hands-on" middle and high school Christian youth programs.
  • Work well in an environment that sees (due to high military operational tempo) a high degree of turnover among teens, families, chaplains and volunteers.
  • Be respectful of and embrace a community that is deeply influenced by a military culture.
  • In this ministry, you will need to live out the Club Beyond Core Value Statement:

Club Beyond is a Christ-centered community of leaders with an exclusively military focus. Our methods are incarnational, and our perspective is ecumenical. We leverage strategic partnerships for the greatest results. We value professionalism from our staff and excellence in our stewardship.

Qualifications:

  • A deep love for Christ and for lost teens.
  • Competent communicator with youths, parents, and senior military leaders.
  • Teachable heart.
  • Willingness to make a three-year commitment.
  • Minimum of three years' youth ministry experience preferred.
  • College degree preferred.
  • Willingness to raise part of the budget through personal support.

title: Data Center Site HR Partner, AWS HRP, BeXT AIS
description:
Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Data Center Operations Site HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on-site role where you'll be embedded in the Data Centers you support, serving as the voice of Builders and the strategic HR partner to site leadership. You'll work across a cluster of Data Centers, traveling weekly to ensure every Builder feels valued, engaged, and supported.

What we are looking for:

- Flexible skill set: Manage multiple scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence
- Strategic thinking: Connect sentiment trends and HR data to bigger picture operational goals while diving deep into details
- High judgment: Exercise sound judgment, manage ambiguity, serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns
- Collaboration: Influence multiple levels of the organization, from Builders to senior leaders

Key job responsibilities
Builder Advocacy: Proactively monitor and analyze Builder sentiment trends using listening mechanisms. Provide regular sentiment updates and recommended actions to site leadership and HRBPs. Ensure Builders feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are.

Strategic Partnership: Partner with Data Center Operations leaders at multiple levels to develop proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Connect sentiment trends and HR data to operational goals while diving deep into details.

HR Expertise: Apply HR fundamentals to problem-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations. Support Builder queries with discretion and expertise, navigating Amazon Policies with high judgment. Conduct workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations.

Leadership Development: Consult, coach, and develop site leadership through decision-making with empathy and sound judgment. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with partner teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies across your cluster of Data Centers. Manage through ambiguity in a fast-paced, continuously innovating environment.

A day in the life
You'll conduct weekly Gemba Go See (GGS) walks, engaging directly with Builders to understand their experience. You'll leverage Builder sentiment data to advocate for their needs, partnering with site leaders to develop proactive strategies focused on engagement. You'll consult and coach leadership through talent management, performance management, compensation decisions, and employee relations issues, applying empathy and sound judgment. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to align on Builder engagement actions. You'll conduct workplace investigations, manage Builder concerns as the first point of escalation, and own site-specific people projects that drive impact.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:

TWF is a workforce strategy and staffing firm serving behavioral health, mental health, human services, hospitality, and federal workforce sectors. HRSA, SAMHSA, state behavioral health workforce grants, and behavioral health foundation grants are all in our addressable universe.

Grant writers with documented federal and foundation grant track record. Former federal program officers (HRSA, SAMHSA), foundation program officers (RWJF, Annie E. Casey, Conrad Hilton), or boutique grant consulting firm operators. You have written grants that were awarded, not just submitted. Send CV and one-paragraph note on the largest grant you have authored that was awarded to with subject "Grant Writer." Reply within 48 hours.

title: Asset and Configuration Analyst II
description:
Position Purpose: Tracks and manages the IT (Information Technology) asset life cycle from selection and depreciation to retirement and replacement. Assists in identifying, controlling, recording, reporting, auditing, and verifying configuration items and asset records, including versions, baselines, constituent components, their attributes, and relationships.


Key Details: This is an onsite role supporting the Brentwood, MO Depot and O'Fallon, MO Data Center, with travel between locations as needed. This is not a remote or desktop support position. The focus is on infrastructure hardware, physical asset management, depot operations, data center readiness, ServiceNow data accuracy, RFID inventory, chain-of-custody documentation, and audit support. The role will require operation of material handling equipment. Candidates must be willing and able to obtain company-sponsored certification for equipment operation and comply with all applicable safety requirements.

  • Ensures effective management of the CMDB and Asset Management tools and the accuracy of content in the tools
  • Provides KPI/metric information and standardized reporting on a scheduled and ad-hoc basis
  • Defines and enhances schemes for identifying hardware and software-related assets as well as CIs (configuration items), including versioning and dependencies in the asset management tools, attributes, the contract management library, asset tables and the CMDB
  • Manages inventory of CIs and assets (including dependencies and attributes), making sure that modifications, withdrawals, and additions of existing ones are correctly recorded by teams within the tools to ensure compliance with vendor contracts
  • Performs verification and audit of CMDB and other asset management toolset content; verifies software assets with license contracts, confirms hardware assets with actual inventory, and initiates corrective actions including reclamation
  • Designs and improves processes relating to software and hardware asset management
  • Creates, monitors and tracks requisitions through approval to the creation of the purchase orders and validates accuracy of incoming order
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and requires 2 – 4 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Technical Skills:

One or more of the following skills are desired.


  • Knowledge of Other: ITSM (Information Technology Service Management) and ServiceNow tools; licensing agreements involving software; IT Service Management processes including continuous improvement
  • Experience with Other: CMDB and the specific business services that it supports
  • Data center operations, including ServiceNow data accuracy, RFID inventory management, chain-of-custody documentation, and audit support.


Soft Skills:

  • Intermediate - Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty
  • Intermediate - Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Intermediate - Ability to work independently


License/Certification:

  • IAITAM (International Association of Information Technology Asset Managers) CITAM (Certified IT Asset Manager); CHAMP (Certified Hardware Asset Management Professional); CITAD (Certified IT Asset Disposal) preferred

Pay Range: $27.02 - $48.55 per hour

title: Manufacturing Preparation Specialist / Mitarbeiter:in Arbeitsvorbereitung - High-Tech Manufacturing
description:
German version below

Introduction to the job

In our high-tech small production runs, single part and prototype production, you will support us in the high-precision manufacture of optical components, assemblies and systems made of glass, glass ceramics and ceramics.

Role and responsibilities

  • Work plans & bills of materials: Create and maintain work plans, bills of materials, and manufacturing-related master data in SAP.
  • Master data management: Maintain and optimize material, warehouse, workplace, production master data, and inspection plans.
  • Production documentation & material readiness: Ensure the availability of all required production documentation and materials to support manufacturing operations.
  • Inventory & material management: Monitor inventory levels, optimize storage areas, and initiate escalations when required.
  • Cost monitoring & reporting: Support manufacturing cost calculations and provide relevant data for decision-making and production planning.
  • Continuous improvement & projects: Analyze processes, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to operational, manufacturing, and SAP-related projects.
  • Procurement & production support: Support material procurement, first article tracking, inventory activities, and production-related tasks.

Education and experience

  • You hold a bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, Production Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical field, or have an equivalent qualification combined with relevant professional experience.
  • You bring several years of experience in manufacturing preparation or manufacturing organization.
  • You have solid SAP knowledge, particularly in the PP and MM modules.
  • You are confident using MS Office applications, especially Excel.
  • You have experience working with production master data, manufacturing processes, and material flows.
  • You are fluent in German and have good English communication skills.

Skills

  • You work in an analytical, structured, and independent manner.
  • You demonstrate a proactive mindset and strong ownership.
  • You communicate effectively and collaborate successfully across functions.
  • You can translate complex information into clear and manageable digital processes.
  • You identify improvement opportunities and implement practical solutions.
  • You maintain a strong overview and effectively prioritize competing demands.

Other information

  • Job with bright future prospects at an innovation leader in the semiconductor industry in Berlin Neukölln
  • Remuneration according to company collective agreement (with IG Metall) including 13th monthly salary and variable remuneration components
  • Collective working time: 35 hours/week
  • Flexible arrangement of your daily working hours (depending on the work area)
  • 30 days of vacation
  • Reimbursement of moving expenses for you and your family (starting from 100 km distance)
  • Participation in the Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Specific advanced training and development opportunities
  • Access to organized childcare and vacation care
  • Health and sports offers (e.g. subsidy for sports activities, health days, company doctor, free vaccinations, etc.)
  • Travel allowance for BVG company ticket or bicycle

Dein Arbeitsumfeld

An unserem Standort in Berlin fertigen unsere Mitarbeitendenden Schlüsselkomponenten für die ASML Lithografiesysteme. Als Teil unserer Präzisionsfertigung unterstützt du bei der Produktion optischer Komponenten, Baugruppen sowie Systeme aus Glas, Glaskeramik und Keramik für unsere High-Tech-Kleinserien, Einzelteil- und Prototypenfertigung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Arbeitspläne & Stücklisten: Du erstellst und pflegst Arbeitspläne, Stücklisten und Fertigungshilfsmittel in SAP und stellst sicher, dass alle produktionsrelevanten Daten aktuell und vollständig sind.
  • Stammdatenmanagement: Du pflegst und optimierst Material-, Lager-, Arbeitsplatz- und Fertigungsstammdaten sowie Prüfpläne in enger Abstimmung mit relevanten Schnittstellen.
  • Produktionsunterlagen & Materialverfügbarkeit: Du stellst sicher, dass alle erforderlichen Produktionsunterlagen und Materialien termingerecht zur Verfügung stehen.
  • Lager- & Materialmanagement: Du überwachst Materialbestände, optimierst Lagerflächen und leitest bei Bedarf geeignete Eskalationen ein.
  • Kosten- & Datenanalyse: Du unterstützt bei der Ermittlung und Überwachung von Herstellkosten und stellst relevante Daten für wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen bereit.
  • Prozessverbesserungen & Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und wirkst an Optimierungs- und SAP-Projekten mit.
  • Beschaffung & Produktionssupport: Du unterstützt bei der Materialbeschaffung, Erstauftragsverfolgung, Inventuren und weiteren produktionsnahen Aktivitäten.

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Bachelorabschluss in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Produktionstechnik, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit relevanter Berufserfahrung.
  • Du bringst erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Fertigungsorganisation mit.
  • Du verfügst über gute SAP-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in den Modulen PP und MM.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit MS Office, insbesondere mit Excel.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Stammdaten, Produktionsprozessen und Materialflüssen.
  • Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Deine Kompetenzen

  • Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du gehst Themen proaktiv an und bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative mit.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und arbeitest erfolgreich mit unterschiedlichen Schnittstellen zusammen.
  • Du bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte vereinfacht in die digitale Landschaft zu übertragen.
  • Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen für den Produktionsalltag.
  • Du behältst auch bei mehreren Themen parallel den Überblick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten.


Das bieten wir dir ​

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for Project Manager to join our team.


Quipu is the dedicated IT company of the ProCredit group and provides comprehensive end-to-end solutions for all ProCredit institutions, as well as for other banks and financial institutions This includes everything from electronic payment services to software systems, hybrid cloud hosting, and a host of other operations.


A 100% subsidiary of ProCredit Holding, Quipu was established in March 2004 and is headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Quipu plays a central role within the ProCredit group, providing a comprehensive range of support services that enable the banks to become competitive and efficient.


The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering infrastructure-related projects for Quipu and ProCredit Group banks, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with regulatory, security, and operational requirements. The PM works closely with the IT Operations Management (ITOM) team, bank stakeholders, and Quipu technical units to ensure successful project outcomes and seamless integration into ongoing IT Operations.



Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of infrastructure projects (planning, execution, monitoring, closure) across ProCredit Group banks.
  • Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations, ensuring alignment with bank and Quipu priorities.
  • Coordinate with Quipu technical teams, ITOAM, and external vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality of deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements in all project activities.

Governance & Alignment

  • Align infrastructure project execution with bank strategic objectives, IT roadmaps, and IT Operations priorities.
  • Provide regular status updates, progress reports, and risk assessments to Senior Management, ITOAM leadership and bank governance bodies (e.g., ITSC, StratCo).
  • Ensure all projects follow Quipu’s project management standards, methodologies, and documentation practices.
  • Support the prioritization mechanism of infrastructure projects within the IT Operations Sub-Portfolio.

Risk & Quality Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage risks throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring proper mitigation and escalation when necessary.
  • Monitor project KPIs (time, cost, quality, scope) and take corrective actions where deviations occur.
  • Facilitate testing, validation, and acceptance of delivered infrastructure solutions by the bank.
  • Ensure smooth handover of completed projects into IT Operations, with clear documentation and training where required.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the primary point of contact for infrastructure project-related communication with banks.
  • Maintain transparent communication with ITOAM, Quipu teams, and bank management, ensuring expectations are well managed.
  • Build strong working relationships with relevant bank units to ensure alignment and trust.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of infrastructure project delivery methodologies and tools within Quipu.
  • Share lessons learned and best practices across ITOAM and other project managers.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize project execution efficiency, cost control, and quality outcomes.


Requirements

  • Proven experience in managing IT infrastructure projects (e.g., networking, datacenter, cloud migration, security, hardware/software upgrades).
  • Strong project management skills with knowledge of relevant methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of IT operations, ITIL practices, and regulatory/audit requirements in the financial sector.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience engaging with senior bank management.
  • Ability to coordinate across diverse technical teams and external vendors.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to travel and maintain on-site presence at bank premises as required for project execution.


What we offer:

  • A substantial degree of flexibility, allowing for an autonomous approach to performing duties
  • Challenging and varied work
  • Flat management structure
  • Long-term prospects with plenty of opportunities for development and growth
  • Excellent team-oriented and international working environment
  • Travel possibilities
  • Hybrid model of working (100 days HO)

Job Summary:

The CT Technologist applies the art and skill of diagnostic imaging through the safe and effective use of CT scanning equipment in a way that provides direct patient care in a compassionate and timely manner. The CT Technologist assists in the diagnosis and treatment of patients by producing diagnostic CT scans.


Essential Functions:

  • Assures the quality of all images and confirms that all pertinent patient/procedural data is correct.
  • Performs computed tomography procedures.
  • Performs timeout as required per policy.
  • Properly positions patients on CT scanning cradles and properly immobilizes patients with appropriate devices to obtain desired position.
  • Makes radiation exposures by energizing scanner per physician request and patient history.
  • Performs intravenous injections and demonstrates a knowledge of use and care of existing IVs, administers oral, rectal, and IV radiographic contracts agents specific to procedures.
  • Assists the radiologist with biopsies, drainage procedures, etc. utilizing sterile techniques, exhibiting safe and effective use of all contrast and radiation materials.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of all CT IT systems, including Radiant and PACS.
  • Participates in on call rotation as required.

title: Customer Experience Advisor | S1 | Retail Banking | Beaumont Leys
description:
Customer Experience Advisor | S1 | Retail Banking | Beaumont LeysCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.


THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE

Santander is looking for a Customer Experience Advisor based out of Beaumont Leys Branch , working 35 hours per week, on a rota’d basis Monday to Saturday, between 8am & 6pm.


For our customers, you’ll be more than just the friendly face and voice of Santander. You’ll be a listener and problem solver. Whether you’re helping someone with a simple cash transaction, aiding them with technology in the banking hall, transacting with them over the phone or protecting your customers against fraud and scams, you’ll never know what the next challenge will be.

What’s not in doubt is that you’ll have plenty of support. Life in a branch can be busy, varied and challenging, so we’re a close-knit team.

You’ll be totally flexible in your approach and comfortable in undertaking a broad range of activities. This means not limiting your time and focus on one particular element of your role. You’ll thrive on the variety this gives you and take satisfaction for operating in a multi-skilled environment. You’re the eyes and ears of our business after all.

We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Acting as the first point of contact for customers in branch or over the phone
  • Assisting with day-to-day transactions, queries and servicing
  • Answering customer calls into our contact centre
  • Building relationships and finding solutions
  • Developing your knowledge of services and products to help our customers
  • Identifying new ways to improve the customer experience

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience

  • Proven ability to deliver outstanding customer service either from a face to face or a telephony background (Required)
  • The ability to communicate effectively with customers to truly understand their needs (Required)
  • A real desire to go above-and-beyond for customers (Preferred)
  • Effective team working skills with a flexible, can-do approach to work (Preferred)
  • Openness to a broad range of activities even if outside of standard expectations (Preferred)
  • Ability to grow, adapt and change accommodating business needs and priorities (Preferred)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.


  • The starting salary is £25,000 together with a £500 flexible benefit allowance and the opportunity to earn a discretionary performance-related bonus of 8% of salary.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 26 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.
  • Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates. Including: medical insurance, dental insurance, and health assessments
  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.
  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.
  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans.
  • As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services
  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.


LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen Branch location.

Right to work in the UK

  • All candidates must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander.

WHAT TO DO NEXT

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk

title: Business Consultant
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




What will you contribute?


Reporting to the Senior Manager , the Business Consultant is responsible for data analysis and mapping, system configuration, implementation, consultative training and/or reinforcement of training, and implementation support of software applications for new and existing clients. Follow project standards within established timeframes and at defined quality levels, and ensure projects are completed according to schedule and client specifications. This position is client-facing and requires travel to the client site as the project warrants. Work performed is typically moderately complex.


Responsibilities & Deliverables:

Your deliverables as a Business Consultant will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Interact with client, consultatively, to determine project requirements and needs analysis.
  • Establish and/or assist client with configuring system parameters and controls based on client’s business practices and processes; recommend best practices; review setup with clients and gain client acceptance.
  • Conduct data analysis and mapping activities for assigned applications if applicable. Analyze source data files and map data to target application for use by technical resources to develop programs.
  • Provide on-site or remote support during client conversions as applicable.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in relevant area of expertise, preferably for a financial institution or an industry software company.
  • Client facing service experience required.
  • Software implementation, support, or training experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with project management disciplines preferred.
  • Experience with Teciem products a plus.
  • Industry / Business Knowledge in Treasury Capital Markets domain is must.
  • FX, money market, Fixed Income, Derivatives, LIBOR changes, Risk Reference Rate, IFRS9, SWIFT
  • Successful completion of a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Finance, Mathematics or Computer Science.
  • Strong communication skills and client facing experience
  • Exposure to working with multiple clients from various locations around the world.
  • Defect Management and Reporting.
  • Able to working on multiple projects at a given time to meet the required objectives for project deliveries.
  • Should be ready to travel on short or medium term assignments on need basis.
  • Working cross functions with Customer Support, QA/Development, Product Management when relevant.•




Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

title: Software Engineer, iOS, Level 5
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.


The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.


​We’re looking for a Software Engineer, iOS to join Snap Inc!


What you’ll do:

  • Create and refine high performance mobile apps that push the limits of mobile technology
  • Build fun, new products that are very stable and run smoothly
  • Design, architect and implement well-tested Objective-C software which powers experiences in Snapchat’s camera
  • Conceptualize, develop, and launch new features
  • Carefully evaluate the technical tradeoffs of every decision
  • Work with the Design team to hone in on the best UI and infrastructure practices
  • Carry out code reviews to guarantee code quality
  • Utilize AI tools and high velocity engineering workflows to design and ship scalable services while upholding rigorous standards for code correctness, security, and production ready quality code

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Proven understanding of Objective-C Runtime and processes which run “under the hood”
  • Knowledge of the OS internals, compilers, optimization for low-power and mobile systems
  • Proficiency with multithreading and performance optimization techniques for iOS
  • Strong CS fundamentals (algorithms and data structures) and problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of software design patterns and iOS best practices
  • Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.
  • Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science or equivalent years of practical work experience
  • 6+ years of post-Bachelor’s software development experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 5+ year of post-grad software development experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field +2+ years of post-grad software development experience
  • Experience with iOS application development

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Objective-C and iOS
  • Experience with Swift
  • Experience with C/C++
  • Experience with OpenGL or Metal

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.


At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

title: Project Manager | S3 | Digital | Milton Keynes | Internal Mobility
description:
Project Manager | S3 | Digital | Milton Keynes | Internal MobilityCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE


Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.

THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE


Santander Digital is looking for a Project Manager based out of Milton Keynes.


This role is on a fixed term contract for 12 months.


You will be a project manager for multiple projects within the TSB migration programme.


We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


  • Responsible for the smooth implementation of new products, services and functions by understanding the impact of change and anticipating risks and issues.
  • Considers the potential risks associated with of suggestions and recommendations made around business requirements and project solutions, escalating where required.
  • Leads effective engagement with project team members and stakeholders in support of robust and successful project outputs.
  • Drives for customer satisfaction through appropriate engagement and endorsement from management, project team members and business stakeholders with regards to proposals and recommendations.
  • Provides challenge and scrutiny around selection of the chosen approach and delivery of the change in support of a successful outcome for the business.
  • Plays a key role in determining and agreeing the best method of introducing recommendations to the business.
  • Uses data modelling practices to analyse findings and create suggestions for strategic and operational improvements and changes.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING


Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Professional Experience:


  • Solid knowledge of investigation techniques, business process modelling, requirements development and impact assessment (Required)
  • Excellent analytical and modelling skills, analytical mindset, evidence-based approach (Required)
  • Experience managing project resources in a matrix environment (Required)
  • Experience operating in a project / programme environment, working with agile and waterfall delivery methodologies and meeting deadlines (Required)
  • Problem solving skills (breaking down complex problems into manageable pieces, vetting assumptions, create frameworks, testing hypotheses) (Required)
  • Ability to work under pressure on multiple projects with project timeframes (Required)

Soft Skills:


  • Direct management of project resources may be required in this role, and matrix management outside formal line management structures (Preferred)
  • Able to build rapport and establish credibility at all levels (Required)
  • Able to plan and prioritise workloads for any team members in support of project deadlines (Required)
  • Able to work independently with limited guidance from project manager / sponsor (Required)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT


At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.


Salary Range:


£49,274.00 - £73,912.00 per annum (depending on experience)

This salary range represents the expected remuneration for the role. Annual salary is based on a standard 35-hour working week. Actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, qualifications and location.

  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.


LOCAL COMPLIANCE


At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.


We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.


To make this possible, our roles are site-based with a hybrid working pattern, where colleagues are expected to attend the office at least 12 days per month (pro-rata for part-time roles).


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen office location.

WHAT TO DO NEXT

Please contact Jamie O’Neil – jamie.oneil@santander.co.uk
