title: Theatre Practitioner- Scrubs
description:
Role: Scrub Theatre Practitioner
Location: London, The Portland Hospital
Hours: Permanent, Full time, 37.5 hours per week
Shifts: Monday to Sunday, early and late shifts. Participation in the on call and standby rota, including overnight stay requirements. Typically one in four Saturdays, with occasional Sunday overtime available.
Salary: Competitive + Shift Allowances


We’re looking for a Scrub Theatre Practitioner to join our Theatre team at The Portland Hospital. As the UK's only private hospital dedicated to women and children, and the largest private children's hospital in the country, you'll be part of a highly specialised environment where every day brings variety and opportunity. From routine ENT procedures through to complex cardiac and spinal surgery, colleagues deliver care across a broad spectrum of surgical specialties. The hospital is also home to the UK's only fully private maternity service, supporting more than 1,600 births each year. Working here means being part of a close knit community that combines clinical excellence, innovation and compassion to provide outstanding care for women, children and adults.


As a Scrub Theatre Practitioner in Theatres, you'll join a collaborative and highly skilled team delivering care across paediatric, maternity and adult services. Working within state of the art Elective Theatres and a Hybrid Theatre, you'll support a wide range of acute and complex procedures alongside leading consultants and multidisciplinary colleagues. This is a role that offers genuine clinical breadth, exposure to advanced surgical technologies and the opportunity to develop expertise across multiple specialties. Whether your background is in paediatrics, obstetrics, gynaecology or another surgical discipline, you'll be supported to grow your skills in an environment that values learning, teamwork, recognition and professional development.


The role operates across a varied shift pattern, including early shifts from 7:30am to 4:00pm and late shifts from 11:30am to 9:00pm, 12:30pm to 9:00pm or 7:30am to 9:00pm. You'll also participate in the on call and standby rota, helping to provide emergency and out of hours support when patients need it most. As part of this service, overnight stays within the hospital are typically required around once per week.


At HCA UK we care about what you care about. We care that you want to deliver the very best care. We care that you want a career you can be proud of. We care that you want working conditions that support your health and wellbeing. Let us care for you and your career, the same way you do for others.


What you’ll do:

  • Deliver high quality scrub support across a wide range of surgical specialties, including paediatric, adult and maternity services.
  • Prepare and maintain theatre equipment, instrumentation and sterile fields in line with best practice and safety standards.
  • Work closely with surgeons, anaesthetists and multidisciplinary colleagues to ensure efficient and safe patient care throughout the perioperative pathway.
  • Participate in the on call and standby rota, providing support for emergency procedures and out of hours services.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, patient safety and clinical excellence within the Theatre team.

What you’ll bring:

  • Current HCPC or NMC registration.
  • Postgraduate experience working within operating theatres.
  • Scrub theatre experience across a range of specialties, including General Surgery, Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Cardiac, Neurology, Paediatrics and Obstetrics.
  • Strong understanding of aseptic technique, patient safety and theatre best practice.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary environment.

Why HCA UK?

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.

We believe that by caring for our colleagues, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Scrub Theatre Practitioner in Theatres you'll be eligible for:

  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.

Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

  • Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
  • Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
  • Honesty, integrity and fairness: We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
  • Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments

We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

description:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our team and own the Agent Orchestration Framework, covering multi-agent orchestration patterns, checkpointing/state management, and human-in-the-loop workflow design as part of our Enterprise Agent Development Platform — a production-grade, cloud-native ecosystem that enables engineering teams to define, orchestrate, deploy, and observe AI agents at scale. The platform standardizes agent development across the organization using LangGraph and Strands Agents on AWS AgentCore Runtime, providing a single-file developer experience where the platform handles runtime, tooling, observability, and deployment automatically.

Responsibilities

  • Own the design and evolution of the Agent Orchestration Framework across the platform
  • Design and implement multi-agent orchestration patterns such as supervisor/worker and fan-out/fan-in
  • Build and maintain checkpointing and state management mechanisms within LangGraph workflows
  • Architect human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows to support enterprise approval processes

description:

Join the MCA Family: Communications Systems Intern Opportunity for Veterans!


Mobile Communications America (MCA), your trusted advisor for wireless communications, data, and security, is seeking a Communications Systems Intern to support our fast-growing In-Building Wireless Solutions (IWS) team.

(This opportunity is designed specifically for transitioning service members through the DoD SkillBridge Program.)

MCA seeks team members who share our values: Service First, Growth, Teamwork, and Safety. As a Military Friendly Employer, we proudly employ over 250 veterans—and counting. Join us and become part of the MCA family, where we prioritize both work and enjoyment.


Location(s): MADISON, TN


Transferable MOS/AFSCs (Not all-inclusive):

  • 25C, 25L, 25N, 25Q, 25S, 94E, 0621, 0627, 2847, 2841, 1D7X3A, 1C8X3, 1D7X2, 2E1X3, ET, IT, CTM, CTR, CTT


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Supporting RF Engineers and Lead Technicians during system installations, upgrades, and maintenance projects

  • Installing and configuring RF transmission equipment, antennas, repeaters, and 2-way radio systems to manufacturer and company specifications

  • Assisting with RF cabling infrastructure including coax, Cat5/6, and fiber lines for in-building and outdoor communication systems

  • Utilizing RF test equipment, basic hand and power tools for signal alignment, radio programming, and equipment mounting

  • Working across diverse environments such as stadiums, hospitals, schools, and enterprise facilities to deploy and service communication networks

  • Maintaining a clean, organized, and RF-safe workspace compliant with grounding, ESD, and safety standards

  • Delivering reliable, high-quality RF and 2-way radio work that ensures optimal coverage, signal integrity, and customer satisfaction


WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TEAM:

  • 1 year of technical experience or a combination of related education/experience
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and systems
  • Hands-on experience with OEM equipment
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics
  • Flexibility to work various shifts and adapt to evolving technologies

title: Director of Information Security
description:
Who We Are

ArentFox Schiff is an award-winning, globally recognized law firm that delivers sophisticated, innovative, and practical legal solutions to clients around the world. With more than 600 lawyers and policy professionals, ArentFox Schiff's expertise is sought out by Fortune 500s, start-ups, international governments, non-profits and trade associations, and private individuals. Our work spans highly complex, global matters as well as the deeply personal issues that shape the lives of individuals and communities.

Why Join Us

At ArentFox Schiff, we know that diverse backgrounds produce different perspectives, richer thinking, and more creative solutions to the challenges our clients face. We hope you share that vision. Join us and take on the challenge of doing meaningful work while helping us build upon a culture that reflects our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We base all of our employment decisions on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic.


Job Description


The Director of Information Security leads the development, operation, and continuous improvement of the firm’s information security, cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and technology risk programs. This role safeguards firm and client information by defining security strategy, governance, architecture, controls, and operational capabilities across cloud services, identity, applications, endpoints, networks, email, data, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and third-party services.

Working closely with administrative departments, attorneys, clients, and external providers, the Director enables responsible technology adoption while maintaining acceptable risk levels. The role oversees security policy and standards, ISO certification, regulatory compliance, AI and emerging-technology risk, vendor security, security operations, incident response, identity and access management, data protection, security awareness, client audits, business continuity, and security program performance.

Strategy, Governance, and Risk

  • Develop and execute the firm’s information security strategy, governance framework, policies, standards, and annual security roadmap to protect firm, client, and employee information.
  • Lead enterprise cybersecurity, privacy, risk management, and compliance programs in alignment with applicable laws, regulations, client requirements, and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, ISO 22301, and NIST.
  • Establish security requirements and governance for cloud services, AI, generative AI, machine learning, autonomous agents, and other emerging technologies, balancing innovation with the protection of confidential and proprietary information.
  • Direct enterprise risk assessments, security architecture reviews, and control evaluations to identify, prioritize, and remediate cybersecurity, technology, vendor, and operational risks.

Security Operations and Technology

  • Oversee security operations, including threat monitoring and detection, vulnerability management, incident response, forensic investigations, and security engineering.
  • Provide governance and oversight for identity and access management, data protection, network security, endpoint security, application security, cloud security, and third-party technology integrations.
  • Support the development and oversight of the firm’s business continuity, disaster recovery, and physical security programs.

Advisory, Client, and Vendor Responsibilities

  • Serve as the firm’s primary security advisor to leadership, business stakeholders, clients, auditors, and vendors on cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory, and technology risk matters.
  • Lead client security audits, security questionnaires, Outside Counsel Guidelines reviews, Requests for Proposal, and other client-driven security assessments.
  • Direct vendor security reviews and due diligence for managed security services, cloud providers, software platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Partner with Technology Services, Innovation, administrative departments, and business leaders to integrate security into enterprise projects, system development, operational processes, and technology-enabled initiatives.

Leadership and Program Management

  • Promote a culture of security awareness through training, communication, policy enforcement, and ongoing education for attorneys, staff, and technology personnel.
  • Define and report cybersecurity metrics, program maturity, emerging risks, and strategic initiatives to executive leadership.
  • Manage security budgets, contracts, projects, and strategic investments.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, specialized training, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Relevant industry certification, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or a comparable credential.

Experience

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, privacy, compliance, security architecture, or related discipline, including at least three years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success leading a multidisciplinary security program in a legal, professional services, financial services, healthcare, or similarly sensitive and regulated environment; law firm or professional services experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing and operating enterprise security capabilities across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, cloud applications, email, endpoints, networks, data, APIs, and third-party services, using platforms such as ReliaQuest, Proofpoint, Abnormal Security, Netskope, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Intune.
  • Experience evaluating the security, privacy, compliance, and operational impact of AI and AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience governing OAuth applications, Microsoft Graph permissions, enterprise application registrations, privileged and workload identities, certificates, service accounts, secrets, and role-based access controls.
  • Experience leading incident response, vendor assessments, remediation efforts, client and ISO audits, security awareness initiatives, and executive risk reporting.
  • Experience applying ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Experience managing security teams and providers, budgets, contracts, implementation projects, and service levels.

Because cybersecurity risks and technologies continue to evolve, the responsibilities and qualifications for this role may change over time based on the firm’s needs and the complexity of its information security environment.


This is an exempt position and can be based in our NY, DC, or Chicago office. The anticipated good-faith base salary range for this position is:

Your exact offer will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, your experience, skills, and overall qualifications. We also review compensation regularly against industry benchmarks and performance outcomes, so you can grow your career here with confidence—knowing your pay recognizes both your impact and our commitment to an equitable approach.

In addition to a competitive base salary, certain positions are eligible for a comprehensive performance-based bonus, payable monthly or annually.

Benefits

We know that the needs of our employees vary and can change throughout the different stages of life. That’s why we offer a wide array of flexible benefit options designed to help you live healthy, live well, and live for tomorrow. In addition to medical, dental, vision, profit-sharing, generous paid time off, and numerous other benefits, we also provide a flexible reimbursement account that helps pay for the things that contribute to your personal well-being, in your own way.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

ArentFox Schiff is committed to equal employment opportunity and diversity in the workplace. We base all employment decisions on merit and maintain a policy of considering all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship status, order of protection status, national origin, ancestry, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, physical or mental disability, parental status, source of income, military or veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, or any other basis protected by applicable law. title: Senior Software Engineer - Streams - Observability
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Observability Streams team at Elastic is building Elastic's unified data pipeline - the layer that connects where your data comes from to where it lands, with full control over how it's processed and routed along the way. Whether you're collecting metrics from cloud accounts, shipping logs from agents, or routing traces to different destinations, Streams is what ties it all together.
The Streams Backend team is responsible for the backend services powering this pipeline, ensuring data is routed, processed, and delivered efficiently and reliably at scale. We also own Logstash, the open-source streaming ETL tool (and the “L” in the “ELK stack”) trusted by enterprises worldwide to move and transform data, and we are regular contributors to the OpenTelemetry Collector.
As a Senior software engineer on the Streams Backend team,you will help drive the design and development of new features across the Streams Backend service and Logstash, contribute to the OpenTelemetry Collector, and support our users and enterprise customers.
Our team is distributed across the globe, and we communicate mostly through Slack, GitHub, email and Zoom.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing and implementing new features for Logstash and its plugins in Java and JRuby.
  • Designing, building, and operating core backend services for the Streams program in Golang.
  • Adding new features, and making contributions to the Open Telemetry Collector in Golang.
  • Solving hard distributed systems problems at scale.
  • Maintaining, updating and improving existing code and dependencies while ensuring automated test coverage.
  • Engaging with multiple public GitHub repositories and community forums.
  • Providing Pull Request reviews and guidance to your peers.
  • Collaborating with other teams to drive product goals.
  • Working together with the support organization to help our customers, which will also include participating in an on-call rotation.

What You Bring

  • Ability to work in a remote-first, highly distributed environment, with top-notch verbal and written communication.
  • Proficient analytical, problem solving, debugging skills and ability to find efficient solutions.
  • Critical thinking, positivity, autonomy and adaptability.
  • Expertise in at least one of Java, Golang and Ruby, and willingness to learn and work with the others and ability to adapt to regularly working in different codebases.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to work proficiently in a remote-first, highly distributed team.
  • A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with observability tools and concepts (tracing, metrics, logging), especially experience with or interest in OpenTelemetry
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • JRuby development
  • Open source software development
  • Knowledge of stream processing platforms (such as Kafka), database technologies (e.g., Postgres or MySQL) and network technologies (e.g., TCP, UDP and HTTP).
  • Exposure to the Elastic stack.

Practice Agreement

For Nursing Staff

Please read the below standards and expectations.

Standard (I understand that…)

Our patients deserve care that sets the standard for excellence and meets the needs of each and every patient whose care is our primary purpose and mission. (Quality)

Expectations (So I will…)

Achieve Excellence in Infection Control By:

  • Isolating per policy.
  • Consistently adhering to proper infection control practices and I will educate patients and visitors of the same.
  • Taking responsibility to read, learn, follow, enforce and remain up to date on Saint Louis University Hospital policies and procedures.
  • Practicing excellent hand washing technique - Wash or gel my hands when going into and coming out of patient rooms and between glove use, especial when it relates to dressing changes, suctioning, etc.
  • Change dressings when they need to be changed now rather than later and maintain all invasive lines as directed by policy.
  • Vaccinate per policy.
  • Notify my supervisor if I see anyone or anything that puts my patient at risk.
  • Utilizing safe practices during crisis situations (i.e. codes) and transport to other departments, e.g. masks, 02 tanks.

Achieve Excellence in Nursing Practice By:

  • Contributing in a positive way to the functioning of the patient care team.
  • Taking an active role in practice development through participation in unit based and hospital committees.
  • Ensuring that documentation of patient care is consistently thorough and legible.
  • Rounding with a purpose on each patient.
  • Modeling practice excellence to new employees.
  • Ensuring that licensure, certifications, and other mandatory requirements are completed within assigned deadlines.

Own and Respect My Environment By:

  • Maintaining proper care of and treat all equipment with respect (clean up after using the microwave, not hit the walls with beds etc.).
  • Maintaining a neat, clean and organized work environment.
  • Keeping the nursing station, bathroom, and break room neat and clean.
  • Leaving my patient’s room in good order, with supplies in place, and ready for the next shift and my work area in the same condition as I would like to see when I return.
  • If I see something out of order I will pick it up, fix it, or call to have it repaired. I will not assume that someone else will do it.
  • Giving hand-off report to another nurse before I leave the unit with another patient or for any other errand.

Standard (I understand that…)

Treating my colleagues, our patients, visitors, and business partners with respect and dignity is necessary to create an environment where excellence in caring and nursing practice can thrive. (People)

Expectations (So I will…)

  • Show empathy to every patient and communicate my commitment to assist in their comfort, safety, and restoration to health.
  • Demonstrate my respect to my colleagues and co-workers through effective communication about patients’ condition and concerns, mentoring new employees, resolving conflicts constructively, and proactively scheduling shifts to meet unit needs.
  • Come to work with a positive attitude.
  • Offer constructive criticism to co-workers when addressing concerns, praising in public and criticizing in private when necessary.
  • Be part of the solution – not part of the problem.
  • Not complain to or complain in front of my patients/families and staff (i.e. too busy or short staffed, no lunch).
  • Follow up on patient concerns every time to the appropriate person.
  • Respond promptly to patient requests.
  • Always refer to physicians as Dr. ____.
  • Make sure that my patients are checked at least every 01 hour 0 30 minutes 0 15 minutes per clinical standard and as appropriate.

Standard (I understand that…)

Patients and their families are scared and vulnerable. It is my responsibility to communicate through verbal and non-vernal means that I am here to help. (Service)

Expectations (So I will…)

  • Introduce myself to all my patients and family members.
  • Take time to tell them what to expect and keep them informed.
  • Answer lights promptly to meet a patient’s needs and prevent patient falls.
  • Respect the patient’s privacy and modesty – close curtains, cover patient, reduce traffic in patient’s room during procedures.
  • Explain all procedures, test, medications and monitoring equipment, etc to each patient and discuss plan of care for the day/shift with patient and family.
  • Be compassionate and empathetic to their concerns at all times.

The intent of this agreement is not to provide a complete list of job responsibilities. Its intent rather is to be a positive statement of concrete actions which will ensure that nursing practice at Saint Louis University Hospital sets the benchmark for excellence in service, quality, and people.

As a member of the nursing staff at Saint Louis University Hospital, I understand that on behalf of my hospital, our patients and my co-workers I will conduct myself according to this agreement at all times.

description:

  • Agency name: U.S. Department of War (DoW); projects funded through the Office of the Deputy Chief Financial Officer (DCFO)
  • Start Date: Anticipated, upon approval and funding of the surge projects (positions are contingent on funding).

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a skilled and experienced Financial Management (FM) Palantir Data Analyst. This position supports anticipated surge projects for Department of War clients, expected to be approved and funded through DCFO, where our client provides professionals with Palantir experience alongside the prime contractor. The work applies Palantir Foundry and the Vantage platform to enterprise financial management transformation initiatives. The role requires an active and maintained Secret Federal or DoW security clearance, includes travel of up to 20% based on client needs, and does not need to be full-time.

Our client is a boutique consulting firm that employs consultants and professionals with unique skill sets to support the federal government with strategic execution, financial process enablement, IT systems, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software implementation.

What will you do

As a Financial Management (FM) Palantir Data Analyst, you will support Department of War clients in designing, developing, and enhancing modern solutions in the Vantage platform, leveraging Palantir Foundry, that strengthen financial management operations, improve financial reporting and data transparency, and enable data-driven decision-making across enterprise financial management transformation initiatives. At the Manager level, you will additionally supervise and mentor project team members and foster collaboration, accountability, and professional development across the program.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and enhance modern solutions in the Vantage platform, leveraging Palantir Foundry, that strengthen financial management operations and improve financial reporting and data transparency.
  • Build and support data solutions using Palantir Foundry, including pipelines, transforms, datasets, and data lineage.
  • Build and enhance applications in Palantir Workshop that enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Develop Python, SQL, PySpark, and Spark-based data processing.
  • Work with relational and analytical data stores (e.g., Databricks, Oracle, Postgres, SQL Server), applying sound data modeling principles.
  • Support or integrate solutions with DoD Advana/Vantage as projects require.
  • Handle federal financial data, including budget, execution, and accounting data, applying data controls and supporting reconciliation needs.
  • Troubleshoot data solutions and translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Managers: supervise and mentor project team members, lead multidisciplinary teams, influence senior stakeholders, and foster collaboration, accountability, and professional development across the program.

Requirements:

  • Active and maintained Secret Federal or DoW security clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree, at minimum 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Palantir Foundry experience.
  • Experience with Palantir, including Workshop; experience supporting or integrating with DoD Advana/Vantage is highly desirable.
  • Experience in Python, SQL, PySpark, and Spark-based data processing.
  • Experience building or supporting data solutions using Palantir Foundry, including pipelines, transforms, datasets, and data lineage.
  • Experience working with relational and analytical data stores (e.g., Databricks, Oracle, Postgres, SQL Server) and applying sound data modeling principles.
  • Experience handling federal financial data, including budget, execution, and accounting data, with an understanding of data controls and reconciliation needs.
  • Managers, with 5+ years of experience: Additionally, you will supervise and mentor project team members and foster collaboration, accountability, and professional development across the program.
  • Managers, with 5+ years of experience: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Able to travel up to 20% based on client needs.

Desired Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Direct experience supporting DoW financial, PPBE, comptroller/CFO, or audit-related programs.
  • Understanding and experience with Federal financial systems (e.g., GFEBS, Navy ERP, DAI, DEAMS) and Federal financial management and accounting concepts, data structures, and policy (e.g., Treasury Financial Manual, OMB Circular A-123, SFFAS, USSGL).
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control, CI/CD concepts, and Agile delivery methodologies in secure environments.
  • Prior experience working directly within the Advana/Vantage ecosystems or adjacent DoD enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Certifications (Palantir, AWS, Azure, Databricks).
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, lineage, and access controls in classified or controlled unclassified environments.
  • Understanding of DoW data, security, and compliance frameworks (e.g., RMF, ATO processes).
  • Previous consulting experience supporting federal or defense clients.

Benefits (provided by our client):

  • Family Health Care (54% cost covered for the entire family)
  • Family Dental (54% cost covered for the entire family)
  • Family Vision (54% cost covered for the entire family)

  • Lifetime Event Bonuses (e.g., child, marriage)
  • Profit-sharing arrangement for any work brought into the company
  • Unlimited Leave with Approval
  • 401k 100% employer match on first 4% invested
  • $1,000 training budget

Job Title

Job Summary

Job Description

The Role


You’ll work on meaningful security challenges that protect critical systems and improve how teams safely access privileged environments. You’ll have the opportunity to shape standards, influence technical direction and make measurable improvements to security outcomes at scale.


As a Senior Security Engineer, you will shape how privileged access is designed, governed and secured across our complex enterprise and cloud environments.


This is a strategic engineering role for someone who can set direction, influence architecture and reduce risk through secure-by-design patterns, automation and strong technical leadership.


What you’ll do


  • Lead the PAM domain strategy, target-state architecture and control roadmap across on-prem, cloud, SaaS and hybrid environments.
  • Design secure, scalable privileged access and secrets management patterns that support modern engineering, DevSecOps and automation practices.
  • Drive a high-automation PAM operating model for onboarding, access requests/approvals, vaulting, rotation, session recording, and offboarding via APIs, workflows, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Influence engineering, architecture, operations, risk and vendor teams to embed PAM controls early and effectively.
  • Improve detection, auditability and assurance through quality logging, reusable evidence, access reviews and automated reporting.
  • Mentor others, uplift technical capability and help build a culture of shared security ownership.

What you’ll bring


  • Deep experience in Privileged Access Management, secrets management, identity security or adjacent security engineering domains.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust, least privilege, service accounts, privileged identities and modern cloud security patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust or cloud-native privileged access capabilities.
  • Experience integrating security tooling with identity providers, MFA, SIEM/SOAR, ticketing, monitoring, APIs or infrastructure-as-code.
  • The ability to translate complex technical risk into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Job Description:

This position offers the opportunity to shape leading-edge data-center networking platforms and work directly with strategic customers on complex, high-value designs. You will combine system architecture, customer advocacy and hands-on laboratory work across Ethernet switching, timing and synchronization, PCIe connectivity, network-interface and management-controller solutions.

More details on the expectations and responsibilities in this position:

  • Own technical engagement for selected strategic and key accounts, building trusted relationships with customer architects, hardware, software and validation teams.
  • Proactively identify customer requirements, risks and support gaps; define action plans, maintain clear ownership and drive technical issues, escalations and commitments to timely closure.
  • Promote and architect Microchip networking solutions for data-center platforms, translating system requirements into appropriate Ethernet switch, PHY, network-interface, timing and connectivity solutions.
  • Support the complete customer design cycle, including architecture reviews, schematic reviews, device configuration, board bring-up, interoperability testing, validation, debug and production readiness.
  • Configure and validate complex Ethernet switch profiles, including VLANs, quality of service, traffic management, redundancy, security, TSN and precision timing functions.
  • Develop and execute laboratory demonstrations and proofs of concept that integrate switches, NICs, management interfaces, PCIe-connected devices, firmware and software in Linux-based systems.
  • Work closely with internal applications, product, software, sales and marketing teams, providing concise status, technical evidence and customer priorities to accelerate resolution and design wins.
  • Deliver customer and channel-partner technical training, workshops and product demonstrations.
  • Travel within Israel as required to support customer engagements, design reviews and laboratory activity.

#LI-LI1

Requirements/Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics, computer engineering or a closely related discipline; an advanced degree is advantageous.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant applications engineering, systems engineering or hardware/software design experience, including substantial customer-facing support for complex semiconductor or networking solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting strategic or key accounts through architecture, design, bring-up, validation, escalation and production phases.

Competencies


  • Deep knowledge of Ethernet switching and networking.
  • Hands-on expertise with TSN, PTP, transparent clocks and relevant timing profiles.
  • Proven ability to create, manage, deploy and debug Ethernet switch profiles and configurations.
  • Experience with high-speed board design and debug.
  • Working knowledge of PCI Express architecture, enumeration, switches, endpoints, NIC integration and Linux drivers; practical PCIe laboratory and troubleshooting experience is desirable.
  • Experience with USB and PCIe-USB bridge devices is advantageous.
  • Strong hands-on laboratory skills, including board bring-up, validation planning, protocol analysis, fault isolation and evidence-based problem reporting.
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux, firmware, drivers, boot flows and collaboration across hardware, software and validation teams.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for engineering and business audiences.
  • Fluent spoken and written Hebrew and English.

0% - 25%

Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems.   • Strong understanding of clinical education, application training, customer onboarding, and workflow optimization.

  • Experience supporting ultrasound product demonstrations, customer evaluations, competitive positioning, or strategic commercial opportunities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, clinical, product, service, and education teams.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.



Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

  • Advanced clinical knowledge of cardiovascular ultrasound systems, applications, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience mentoring clinical teams or developing scalable training content for field organizations.
  • Ability to translate customer needs, workflow challenges, and competitive insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and support successful adoption of advanced technologies.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Software Engineer - United Kingdom
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

What you will do:

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.

  • Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

Requirements

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

    Location

    This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United Kingdom. There is a preference for candidates to be based in London, with the option to work out of our office. Expect regular travel for customer onsites.

title: Senior Manager of Industrial Design & Integrated Experiences
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Industrial Design & Integrated Experiences leads the industrial design function and advances the development of cohesive product, program, and environmental experiences. The role ensures that teams deliver innovative, manufacturable, and cost-conscious solutions that meet customer, end-user, and business requirements.

This leader establishes functional priorities, allocates resources, develops team capability, and provides design leadership from early concept development through design refinement, prototype learning, engineering transition, and implementation. The role considers how individual products, fixtures, digital touchpoints, and physical environments work together within broader customer programs and branded experiences.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Manager serves as a strategic partner to Engineering, Development Project Management, Commercial Technology, Sales, Operations, and customers. The position works closely with Engineering leadership to ensure concepts are technically supported, commercially viable, and transitioned effectively into development and production. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in industrial design, custom product development, environmental or experiential design, and manufacturing, along with sound design judgment, people leadership, and the ability to guide teams through ambiguity and changing business needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead the Industrial Design function and provide design leadership across product, program, and integrated experience initiatives, including physical products, fixtures, branded environments, and technology-enabled customer experiences.

• Set functional priorities and resource assignments by balancing customer needs, project complexity, timelines, team capabilities, financial requirements, and business priorities.

• Build and maintain visibility into workload, capacity, priorities, risks, dependencies, and key milestones through appropriate systems, dashboards, and reporting.

• Establish and continuously improve design processes, standards, tools, documentation, and review practices to increase consistency, quality, scalability, and execution speed.

• Guide the translation of customer objectives, brand standards, shopper or end-user insights, operational requirements, and commercial constraints into clear design strategies and actionable concepts.

• Ensure design solutions account for the complete experience, including product interaction, placement, environment, communication, accessibility, durability, serviceability, and installation requirements.

• Lead design reviews and provide clear direction on concept quality, usability, brand alignment, feasibility, material selection, construction, cost, and intended user experience.

• Partner with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, resolve design risks, and transition approved concepts into detailed development, prototyping, testing, and production.

• Collaborate with Development Project Management to define scope, design deliverables, decision points, dependencies, and timing across customer programs.

• Partner with Commercial Technology when solutions include interactive, connected, or technology-enabled elements to ensure physical and digital components form one coherent experience.

• Engage Sales and customers during discovery, concept presentation, and design refinement, communicating the rationale, tradeoffs, and business value behind proposed solutions.

• Promote design-to-value practices that preserve the customer experience while improving manufacturability, repeatability, cost, lead time, and quality.

• Develop team capability through coaching, feedback, performance management, mentoring, succession planning, and targeted development opportunities.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and solutions-oriented culture that encourages creativity while maintaining disciplined execution and ownership.

• Support capability planning, hiring, onboarding, and the thoughtful use of external design partners when project demand or specialized expertise requires additional capacity.

• Stay informed about relevant trends in retail design, materials, manufacturing, sustainability, technology, and customer experience, and translate useful developments into practical business opportunities.

• Other responsibilities as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

This position has direct supervisory responsibility for the Industrial Design function and is responsible for coaching, feedback, performance management, mentoring, succession planning, team development, hiring, and onboarding.

DECISION AUTHORITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY:

• Own functional work allocation, design review practices, and day-to-day team priorities within approved business and project parameters.

• Recommend design direction, capability investments, staffing needs, process improvements, and development priorities to the Director of Development.

• Escalate material scope, timing, feasibility, cost, quality, or resource conflicts with clear options and recommended actions.

• Maintain accountability for design quality, timely deliverables, effective cross-functional handoffs, and team performance.

• POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

• Strong understanding of industrial design principles, human factors, materials, manufacturing processes, prototyping, and design for manufacture and assembly.

• Ability to connect individual design elements to a broader product, program, brand, and environmental experience.

• Sound business judgment and the ability to balance creativity, customer value, technical feasibility, cost, quality, and speed.

• Strong people leadership, coaching, delegation, performance management, and team-development skills.

• Ability to organize multiple priorities, make decisions with incomplete information, and guide others through ambiguity and change.

• Excellent visual, verbal, and written communication skills, including the ability to present concepts and recommendations to customers and senior leaders.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence without relying solely on formal authority.

• Proficiency with relevant design, visualization, collaboration, and project-management tools; familiarity with current 3D design and rendering workflows is expected.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, Environmental Design, Experience Design, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• Seven or more years of progressive experience in industrial design, custom product development, retail environments, branded experiences, or a related field.

• Three or more years of experience leading people, design teams, or complex cross-functional design programs.

• Demonstrated experience developing products or environments from concept through engineering, prototyping, manufacturing, and implementation.

• Experience in retail fixtures, displays, branded environments, consumer products, architectural products, or custom manufacturing is strongly preferred.

• Portfolio demonstrating strong design thinking, design judgment, problem solving, technical awareness, and successful implementation of physical experiences.

LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS:

• Vibrant: Creates energy around strong ideas, encourages curiosity, and helps the team see possibilities while remaining grounded in customer and business needs.

• Intentional: Establishes clear priorities, decision criteria, ownership, and disciplined design practices that lead to measurable outcomes.

• Respectful: Builds trust across disciplines, invites useful challenge, communicates directly, and values the expertise required to move work from concept to implementation.

• Agile: Adjusts direction as requirements evolve, learns quickly from prototypes and feedback, and helps the team respond constructively to change.

OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Works in a professional office and collaborative design environment, with periodic activity in prototype, manufacturing, warehouse, installation, showroom, and customer settings.

• May need to review physical prototypes, materials, fixtures, displays, or installed environments and use appropriate personal protective equipment when required.

• Periodic domestic and international travel may be required to support customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, installations, and global teams.

• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

• The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

STATEMENT OF EMPLOYMENT

All employees of VIRA Insight are expected to:

• Act as an ambassador of and in accordance with the company’s Core Values.

• Adherent to the company’s Principles of Business and Conduct.

• Demonstrate good judgment and respect the confidentiality of company and personnel information.

• Deal professionally and courteously with all internal and/or external contacts.

• Seek guidance and direction as necessary in the performance of duties.

title: Disability Retirement Analyst II (00015)
description:
Applications must be submitted by 11:59 PM (EST) the day before the posted End Date.


Please read all information in the Important Notices section.

GROW YOUR CAREER SERVING THOSE WHO SERVE OTHERS!


The Virginia Retirement System is seeking a Disability Retirement Analyst II to independently manage and resolve complex disability retirement cases involving both non-work-related and work-related disability retirees. This position is responsible for performing complex benefit calculations, account adjustments, periodic reassessments and related benefit coordination within delegated authority. The role requires advanced knowledge of VRS policies, procedures, applicable statutes and related benefit programs, including Social Security Disability, Workers’ Compensation and the Virginia Line of Duty Act.


In this role, the Disability Retirement Analyst II manages an assigned caseload, serves as an advanced technical resource for complex benefit and processing matters and provides guidance to Disability Retirement Analyst I team members and other staff. The position works closely with the Lead Disability Retirement Analyst, VRS business units, employers, members, attorneys, third-party vendors and state business partners to resolve complex cases, data issues and system discrepancies. This position also supports root-cause analysis, participates in system testing, recommends process improvements and provides intermittent processing and technical support to the Virginia Line of Duty Act Program.

Essential duties include but are not limited to:


  • Independently processes and resolves complex non-work-related and work-related disability retirement cases, including benefit calculations, benefit adjustments, periodic reassessments and related account transactions, in accordance with the Code of Virginia, VRS policies, procedures and established guidelines.
  • Performs complex disability retirement benefit calculations involving multiple sources of benefit information and verifies calculations and supporting documentation for accuracy before processing.
  • Reviews disability and LODA applications and supporting documentation for completeness and identifies issues involving eligibility, benefit calculations, conflicting information or unusual circumstances that require advanced analysis or additional review.
  • Processes assigned disability and LODA cases and coordinates the submission of required documentation to the VRS Medical Board for review and recommendation. Communicates decisions and processing requirements to applicants and other authorized parties in accordance with established procedures.
  • Reviews existing disability retiree accounts for periodic reassessments, benefit adjustments and other events requiring additional documentation or resubmission to the VRS Medical Board.
  • Serves as a reviewer and approver of disability retirement cases, benefit calculations and adjustment transactions for other team members in accordance with established procedures and delegated authority.
  • Provides advanced benefit expertise and technical assistance to members, retirees, employers, the Customer Contact Center, internal staff, third-party vendors and other authorized parties regarding complex disability retirement matters.
  • Analyzes complex Social Security Disability benefit awards, denials and related information and works with the Social Security Administration, members, attorneys and third-party vendors to obtain and interpret information needed to accurately administer disability retirement benefits.
  • Works with Virginia Workers' Compensation Commission representatives and other state business partners to obtain, validate and interpret workers' compensation benefit information required for work-related disability retirement benefit calculations.
  • Maintains working knowledge of LODA benefit requirements and provides intermittent case processing and technical assistance to the Virginia Line of Duty Act Program, as assigned.
  • Reviews and compares disability retiree job duties for retirees seeking re-employment and analyzes the information in accordance with applicable disability retirement requirements.
  • Investigates system processing issues, data discrepancies and benefit account errors; conducts root-cause analysis and develops or recommends potential solutions for consideration by the Lead Disability Retirement Analyst and Supervisor.
  • Participates in system testing and validation activities, documents test results, identifies defects or processing issues and provides recommendations regarding system changes.
  • Provides technical guidance and assistance to Disability Retirement Analyst I and other team members on complex cases, processing requirements and application of established policies and procedures.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve business processes, case processing and customer service and participates in implementation of approved process improvements.
  • Maintains accurate case records, documentation and system notes and ensures processing activities are completed within established service standards.
  • Completes special projects and other related assignments as requested.


Minimum Qualifications:


High school diploma or equivalent.

Four years of progressively responsible relevant experience in benefit administration, retirement administration, disability benefits, financial services, or a related field, including experience working with large databases and web-based systems; or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.


Preferred Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Math, Finance, or a closely related field.


Best Qualified Candidates Will Possess:

Advanced knowledge of disability retirement and pension benefit administration, including Social Security Disability benefits, Virginia Workers' Compensation benefits and Virginia Line of Duty Act benefits. Ability to apply applicable statutes, policies, procedures and administrative requirements to complex and non-routine benefit matters.

Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex member records, benefit calculations, business processes, system information and data discrepancies. Ability to conduct research, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives and recommend appropriate solutions.

Ability to interpret and apply legislative, administrative, business and technical requirements and translate those requirements into appropriate processing actions. Ability to recognize when an issue requires additional research, technical assistance, policy interpretation or supervisory review.

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex benefit information and processing requirements to members, retirees, employers, attorneys, internal staff, managers, third-party vendors and other stakeholders.

Ability to provide technical guidance and assistance to less experienced team members and serve as a subject matter resource on complex disability retirement matters.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, manage multiple priorities, meet established deadlines and exercise sound judgment when resolving complex issues. Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technology teams to investigate system and data issues and participate in testing and implementation activities.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, web-based applications, databases and other systems used to administer disability retirement benefits.

title: Architect / Principal Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Architect / Principal Software Engineer to lead the technical direction of our AI Engineering pods. You will split your time between hands-on engineering (about 30% to 40% prototyping core workflows, building reference implementations, and reviewing code) and higher-level system architecture, technical standards, and mentorship across teams.

You will work closely with US-based Product, Security, Data, and Infrastructure teams to make sure our agentic systems are reliable, fast, and secure. Your main focus will be designing predictable multi-agent workflows, low-latency LLM orchestration services, and retrieval pipelines that run cleanly in production.

Req.#1098579355

Responsibilities

  • Set architectural direction across multiple AI pods, making clear trade-offs between model capabilities, cost, latency, and operational complexity
  • Spend roughly a third of your time in code: writing backend AI services, building orchestration patterns, and defining integration contracts with frontend teams
  • Design agent workflows with streaming responses, predictable error handling, and low latency for chat and automated tasks
  • Establish shared standards for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool schemas, and context management
  • Work with Okta Security and Infrastructure to enforce least-privilege tool execution, tenant isolation, and secret handling within agent loops
  • Define observability requirements and service-level objectives, including tracing with tools like LangSmith or Arize Phoenix
  • Mentor Staff and Senior engineers through direct design reviews and technical guidance

Requirements

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a background in designing, scaling, and operating distributed backend systems
  • 6+ years of Python experience, especially with FastAPI, AsyncIO, and modern typing practices. Python is our primary language for backend and AI services
  • 3+ years building production systems with LLMs, including LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI APIs. Candidates with classical ML backgrounds (PyTorch, scikit-learn) who moved into generative AI architectures are welcome
  • Hands-on experience with LangGraph or similar stateful agent frameworks, particularly managing state graphs, loops, checkpointing, and human-in-the-loop steps
  • 3 to 4 years of React and TypeScript experience, enough to review UI code, understand frontend state, and ensure streaming APIs work cleanly with the web client
  • Production AWS experience, including EKS or ECS, Lambda, Bedrock, S3, Docker, and Terraform or OpenTofu
  • Authentication and security fundamentals, specifically OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and secure credential handling

Nice to have

  • Practical experience building custom MCP servers and defining tool discovery patterns
  • Experience migrating from older retrieval systems (such as Amazon Kendra) to vector platforms like OpenSearch, Pinecone, or Qdrant
  • Experience handling multimodal data (images, documents) within LangGraph state
  • Background in Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Customer Identity (CIAM)

title: Core Faculty, Psychology+ (Art Therapy) (Open Rank)
description:
The Opportunity

Lesley University is seeking a full-time Core Faculty member in Art Therapy to join the undergraduate Psychology+ program. Reporting to the Associate Provost for Mental Health and Wellbeing, the Core Faculty member will teach, advise, and mentor undergraduate students in the Psychology+ program and contribute to the continued development of the Art Therapy specialization and minor. This is a full-time faculty role with opportunities to contribute to curriculum development, program initiatives, and University service.

Psychology+ is a Bachelor of Arts program with five specializations: General Psychology, Counseling, Art Therapy, Expressive Arts Therapy, and Holistic Healing. The program also offers minors in Psychology, Art Therapy, and Holistic Healing. The Core Faculty member will contribute primarily to the Art Therapy specialization and minor, and may also teach courses that support the broader Psychology+ curriculum. The Psychology+ program combines a foundation in psychology with applied, alternative, and arts-based approaches to mental health and wellbeing. Students connect classroom learning with field experiences and internships and may pursue integrated pathways into selected graduate programs. Faculty collaborate across disciplines to prepare students for graduate study, community-based work, and careers in mental health and human services.

The ideal candidate will be an artist-practitioner-scholar with expertise in art therapy theory, methods, and have a strong commitment to undergraduate teaching, student development, and inclusive, culturally responsive pedagogy. The successful candidate will bring relevant professional or clinical experience and an active creative, clinical, or scholarly practice appropriate to the role.


Qualities & Capabilities

A successful candidate will have:

  • Master's degree in Art Therapy or a closely related mental health field (required); PhD or terminal degree (preferred)
  • Current Registered Art Therapist (ATR) credentials through the Art Therapy Credentials Board (required); ATR-BC (preferred)
  • A minimum of two years of teaching experience at the undergraduate level or comparable instructional experience
  • Relevant clinical or professional Art Therapy experience
  • Demonstrated ability to teach and mentor students from diverse backgrounds using inclusive and culturally responsive practices
  • Ability to teach in multiple modalities, such as: in-person, HyFlex, virtual, and asynchronous instruction

Why Lesley

Located in the heart of Cambridge, Massachusetts, Lesley University is highly regarded for its graduate and undergraduate programs in the human arts of education, the arts, and applied social sciences. Lesley fosters a highly creative environment in which innovative ideas thrive, theory is integrated with practice and its 6,400 students and 90,000 alumni are empowered to improve and enrich communities.

We offer a competitive benefits package that includes health, dental, life, and long-term disability insurance. In addition, we offer significant paid time off, a generous retirement plan, and tuition programs that enable employees and their dependents to expand their knowledge and skills.

Lesley is committed to the ongoing pursuit of strategic diversity initiatives that help to position diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to institutional and academic excellence at Lesley. In doing so, Lesley strives for a campus culture and community that fosters a true sense of belonging for all, provides opportunity for everyone to participate equally and fully in the Lesley experience, and helps to develop each individual's capacity to confidently and competently engage within and across difference. Given an evolving national context and the rapid change in the demographic profile of our country, the University has made a significant commitment to addressing and enhancing its campus climate and diversity capabilities as an institution.

title: Buyer / Senior Buyer - Electromechanical Components
description:
About Stark

Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road-legal VARG EX & SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.

Headquartered in Barcelona and growing fast (77% year-on-year), our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.

The Role

Electromechanical parts sit where the mechanics and electronics of our motorcycles meet: motors, actuators, wiring harnesses, connectors, switches, sensors, lighting and charging hardware. We are building a new purchasing team in Chennai, India, and are looking for a Buyer or Senior Buyer to own sourcing for these commodities. You will report to the Electronics & Electromechanics Purchasing Manager and work closely with Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain across our global sites.

Open to All Levels

We are hiring at Buyer and Senior Buyer level. As a guide, Buyers bring 3+ years of sourcing experience, and Senior Buyers 7+ years with ownership of a commodity, supplier portfolio or major negotiations. Apply with the experience you have and we will shape the scope around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, qualify and develop Indian and global manufacturers for motors, actuators, harnesses, connectors, switches, relays, sensors, lighting and charging hardware

  • Run RFIs, RFPs and RFQs, and make sure NDAs and Master Purchase Agreements are in place

  • Build should-cost and total-cost-of-ownership models and lead negotiations to drive continuous cost reduction

  • Cut lead times on critical parts, keep stock low without running out, and dual source where risk demands it

  • Support Engineering early in design to choose manufacturable, available parts and qualify alternatives

  • Manage supplier performance, quality issues and disputes with Quality and Supply Chain

  • Track raw material (copper, magnets, plastics) and component markets, technology roadmaps and supply risks

What You Will Bring

  • 3+ years of sourcing electromechanical components in automotive, two-wheeler, e-mobility or similar industries (7+ for Senior Buyer)

  • Comfortable reading drawings, specifications and BOMs, and discussing materials, processes and tolerances with engineers

  • Knowledge of the Indian and global supplier base for harnesses, connectors, motors and sensors

  • A strong, data-driven negotiator who is organised and results-oriented

  • Passion for sustainability, and a degree in engineering or business administration

  • Fluent English is a must

Why Work With Us?

  • A product people are genuinely passionate about, and a company with real momentum

  • The chance to help build our Chennai purchasing team from the ground up

  • A creative, international team across Europe, Asia and the Americas

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

At Stark, we celebrate difference. We are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging, and we encourage applications from underrepresented groups. If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process, contact HR@starkfuture.com.

title: Client Service Representative
description:
Client Service Representative

VCA Coral Springs Pet Resort & Medical Center


We’re looking for more than someone to answer phones—we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of a team.


At VCA Coral Springs Pet Resort & Medical Center, excellent patient care and excellent client service go hand in hand. We believe every interaction matters—from the first phone call to the moment a client and their pet walk through our doors.

We’re looking for an experienced Client Service Representative (CSR) who is professional, personable, dependable, and genuinely enjoys helping people. The right person understands that veterinary medicine can be emotional, fast-paced, and unpredictable, and can remain calm, compassionate, and solution-focused while keeping the hospital moving.

If you are someone who takes ownership, communicates well, follows through, and enjoys being part of a team that supports one another, we’d love to meet you.


Why We Need You

The CSR is often the first and last impression a client has of our hospital. You will play an important role in creating a positive experience for our clients while helping our medical team provide exceptional care to their pets.

Our CSRs are an important part of the hospital's daily operations and help connect our clients, doctors, technicians, and support team.

What You’ll Do

  • Welcome clients and their pets with professionalism, warmth, and confidence.
  • Answer phones, respond to client questions, and help direct calls and requests appropriately.
  • Schedule, confirm, and coordinate appointments while keeping the needs of the client and medical team in mind.
  • Communicate clearly with clients regarding appointments, hospital policies, services, and next steps.
  • Place outbound calls for appointment follow-ups, patient updates, client communication, and prospective client outreach.
  • Present and explain estimates and fees clearly and confidently.
  • Process payments and assist clients with questions regarding their invoices.
  • Recommend appropriate products and services and assist clients with prescription requests and other hospital services.
  • Provide general, non-medical pet care education and help clients understand preventative care recommendations.
  • Maintain accurate medical records, charts, correspondence, and other required documentation.
  • Work closely with the medical team to ensure information is communicated accurately and efficiently.
  • Help maintain a clean, organized, welcoming hospital environment.
  • Follow hospital policies, procedures, and established workflows consistently.
  • Step in to support your teammates when the hospital gets busy. We believe “the how can I be of help" mindset is what makes or breaks the day.
  • Protect client confidentiality and handle sensitive situations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Help create an environment where clients feel heard, respected, and confident in the care their pets are receiving.

What Makes Someone Successful Here?

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has previous veterinary CSR experience or strong customer-service experience that translates well to a veterinary environment.
  • Is comfortable handling a busy phone queue while simultaneously managing in-person clients and hospital needs.
  • Can prioritize and multitask without losing attention to detail.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally—both verbally and in writing.
  • Is comfortable discussing money, estimates, payments, and services with clients.
  • Can handle difficult or emotional conversations with empathy while maintaining appropriate boundaries.
  • Takes ownership of their responsibilities and follows through.
  • Understands that communication and teamwork are essential in a veterinary hospital.
  • Is dependable, punctual, and accountable.
  • Is willing to ask questions, learn, accept feedback, and continue developing their skills.
  • Can remain calm and professional when the day doesn't go according to plan.
  • Brings positive energy to the workplace and contributes to a respectful team culture.
  • Understands that every member of the hospital contributes to the client and patient experience.

Most importantly...

We want people who care.

Care about the patients.
Care about the clients.
Care about their teammates.
Care about doing things correctly.

And care enough to keep learning when they don't know something.

Veterinary medicine is a team sport. We don't expect anyone to know everything, but we do expect our team members to communicate, ask for help when they need it, support one another, and take responsibility for their part in the patient experience.


What We Offer

We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid vacation for eligible full-time employees
  • 401(k)
  • Generous personal pet care discounts
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • A collaborative hospital environment
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of pets and the people who love them

If you’re an experienced CSR who wants to be part of a team—not just fill a position—we’d love to hear from you.

If you are a current associate, you need to apply through our internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on the Jobs Hub app or search for Browse Jobs.

Benefits: We offer competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and paid vacation/sick days, 401(k), generous employee pet discounts and more!
