title: Disability Retirement Analyst I
description:
Applications must be submitted by 11:59 PM (EST) the day before the posted End Date.


Please read all information in the Important Notices section.

GROW YOUR CAREER SERVING THOSE WHO SERVE OTHERS!



The Virginia Retirement System is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Disability Retirement Analyst I to support the administration of non-work-related disability retirement benefits. This position independently processes assigned disability retirement cases, including application review, benefit calculations, monthly benefit processing and account adjustments.


The Disability Retirement Analyst I reviews member records and supporting documentation, applies applicable provisions of the Code of Virginia and VRS policies and procedures, and communicates benefit information and processing requirements to members, retirees, employers and other authorized parties. The role also coordinates with the VRS Medical Board, Social Security Administration, third-party vendors, employers, attorneys and internal business units to ensure cases are processed accurately and timely.


The Disability Retirement Analyst I is the entry level position to the Disability Retirement series career ladder.


Essential duties include but are not limited to:

  • Independently processes assigned non-work-related disability retirement applications and cases in accordance with the Code of Virginia, VRS policies, procedures and established processing guidelines.
  • Calculates disability retirement benefits using applicable formulas, member data and VRS systems and verifies calculations for accuracy before processing benefits.
  • Reviews disability retirement applications and supporting documentation to determine completeness and readiness for processing and identifies information requiring clarification or additional documentation.
  • Coordinates the submission of complete disability retirement applications and supporting documentation to the VRS Medical Board for review and recommendation and communicates the resulting determination to the applicant in accordance with established procedures.
  • Reviews existing disability retiree accounts for periodic reassessments and coordinates required documentation and resubmission to the VRS Medical Board.
  • Reviews and processes routine benefit adjustments for disability retirees and verifies the accuracy of changes before implementation.
  • Serves as a reviewer and approver of assigned disability retirement applications, benefit calculations and adjustment transactions in accordance with established procedures and delegated authority.
  • Provides accurate and timely benefit information and customer service to members, retirees, employers, the Customer Contact Center, third-party vendors and other authorized parties.
  • Responds to correspondence and inquiries related to disability retirement benefits, application status, benefit calculations, documentation requirements and account adjustments.
  • Reviews Social Security Disability benefit awards and denial information and coordinates with the Social Security Administration, members, member attorneys and applicable third-party vendors to obtain information needed for disability retirement benefit processing.
  • Coordinates with third-party vendor representatives responsible for Medical Review Board services and Social Security benefit advocacy services to obtain information necessary to complete assigned cases.
  • Reviews and compares the job duties of disability retirees seeking re-employment in accordance with established disability retirement policies and procedures and escalates questions or unusual circumstances for additional review.
  • Identifies routine system processing issues, data discrepancies and processing errors; researches available information to determine the nature of the issue and provides appropriate documentation and details to the Lead Disability Retirement Analyst or Disability Retirement Analyst II for further analysis.
  • Participates in system testing and validation activities as assigned and communicates testing results, defects and processing concerns to appropriate team members.
  • Maintains accurate case records, processing documentation and notes in applicable systems.
  • Applies legislative, policy and procedural updates to assigned work and seeks guidance when requirements are unclear or involve complex or unusual circumstances.
  • Provides peer assistance and shares knowledge of established processes and procedures with less experienced team members as appropriate.
  • Completes special projects and other related assignments as requested.

Minimum Qualifications:


High school diploma or equivalent.

Three (3) years of relevant experience in benefit administration, financial services, retirement administration, working with large databases and web-based systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. Proficiency with Microsoft Office products.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Business Administration, Math, Finance, or a closely related field.
  • Experience administering retirement, disability, insurance or other regulated benefits.
  • Knowledge of VRS benefits and disability retirement processes.
  • Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, regulations or statutory requirements.
  • Experience working with large databases and web-based systems.

Best qualified candidates will possess:


Knowledge of disability retirement and pension benefit administration, including basic knowledge of Social Security Disability benefits. Ability to learn and apply applicable provisions of the Code of Virginia, VRS policies, procedures and administrative guidelines.

Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to review member records, benefit information and system data; identify discrepancies; research information; and determine appropriate action within established procedures.


Ability to perform benefit calculations accurately using established formulas, systems and reference materials. Ability to interpret and apply policies, procedures and statutory requirements to routine disability retirement cases.


Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to explain benefit information and processing requirements clearly and professionally to members, retirees, employers, attorneys, third-party vendors, internal staff and the general public.

Ability to manage an assigned caseload, prioritize competing work, meet established deadlines and maintain accurate records. Ability to work independently with limited supervision on routine and moderately complex assignments and appropriately seek guidance when matters require advanced policy interpretation, complex analysis or supervisory direction.

Ability to identify system and data issues, conduct routine research, document findings and communicate issues effectively to technical and business resources.


Proficiency with Microsoft Office products and the ability to effectively use web-based systems, databases and other technology used to administer disability retirement benefits.

Hiring Range:

$72,920 - $75,000

title: Lead Go Language Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Lead Go Language Developer to spearhead the development of mission-critical lab automation systems, Business Process Automation (BPA), and scalable software architectures within an Agile and ITIL-managed environment. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership responsibilities, focusing on delivering robust, reliable, and traceable solutions that integrate seamlessly with laboratory workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Architect robust, standardized integration layers (adapters/services) aligning automation systems (robots/instruments) tightly with LIMS workflows
  • Implement fault-tolerant patterns, state management, and recovery mechanisms for device/network failures
  • Deliver comprehensive monitoring, logging, and device telemetry to ensure system reliability and observability
  • Design, model, and govern a scalable, decoupled business rules engine, ensuring rules are versioned, traceable, and safely deployable without disrupting operations
  • Build scalable, modular systems with independent frontend/backend evolution, implementing caching, async processing, and secure-by-design practices
  • Define and document contract-first APIs with proper versioning and secure interfaces
  • Ensure full auditability and end-to-end traceability of all experimental data flows
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and architecture walkthroughs, fostering autonomy, knowledge sharing, and full-stack system thinking
  • Drive features end-to-end, prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and consistently meet deadlines

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with proven leadership background (1+ years)
  • Expertise in lab automation context (LIMS, device integration) and Business Process Automation (BPA/rules engines)
  • Proficiency in Go (Golang)
  • Advanced knowledge of Ruby on Rails and Phoenix Framework
  • Skills in relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle), NoSQL, and key-value stores
  • Competency in API design and development using REST, GraphQL, and gRPC
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Simple Storage Service (S3), and Application Load Balancer (ALB)
  • Background in DevOps and infrastructure using Terraform, Docker, and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines
  • Understanding of advanced Git workflows, code review best practices, and branching/merging strategies
  • Capability to apply Unit testing, Integration testing, and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) with a mindset of continuous learning and adaptability
  • Proven experience in ITIL-managed organizations, with strong problem-solving/debugging abilities and excellent cross-functional communication
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English (B2+ level)

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience implementing or extending LIMS platforms in lab automation environments

Benefits

  • Engineering Heritage: Best-in-class experts sharing a culture of engineering excellence and tackling complex engineering challenges for over 30 years
  • Advanced Tech Stack: Innovative projects where you can apply or enhance your expertise in Cloud, Data, AI, and other emerging technologies
  • World-Class Clients: Work closely with 340+ of the Forbes Global 2000 on creating disruptive solutions that make a global impact
  • Professional Growth: Exceptional support for career development with comprehensive resources for upskilling or reskilling in pioneering practices
  • GenAI Community: Strong AI competencies with 600+ experts across 55+ locations driving GenAI-enabled transformation journeys
  • Entrepreneurial Culture: If you're passionate and dedicated to improving business transformation, we provide the support you need to bring your ideas to life
  • Hybrid Setup: The flexibility to work from any location in Lithuania, whether it's your home or our dynamic offices in Vilnius and Kaunas
  • Other Benefits: Additional vacation and trust days, private health insurance, Employee Stock Purchase Plan and more

title: Field Operator
description:
Field Operator

.

The Field Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring facilities at Pumping Stations 1 and 2, as well as along the pipeline, in line with EACOP’s HSE and production objectives. The role ensures reliable operation of equipment through first-level maintenance, supports commissioning and emergency response activities, and contributes to safe, efficient, and compliant operations. Key duties include reporting anomalies, executing shutdown/start-up procedures, managing chemicals, assisting maintenance teams, and participating in safety drills among others.

.

In accordance with policies and procedures in place in EACOP, the Operator is responsible for:

  • Reports procedural deviations/equipment failure and/or incidents (immediately) to the Operations Lead.
  • Takes approved remedial actions, follow procedures and standard emergency responses to limit risk to personnel, plant equipment and product inventory during emergencies.
  • Ensures the control and verification of safety equipment.
  • Carries out emergency maneuvers requested by Operations Lead.
  • Ensures the cleanliness of the installations.
  • Informs of any anomaly or incident and participate in their analysis.
  • Operate all units and monitor the facilities.
  • Ensures the shutdown and start-up of the installations according to the operations of the site.
  • Controlling and managing chemicals.
  • Ensures the reporting of the operating parameters of the various units under his responsibility.
  • Participates in the execution of interventions to optimize the functioning of the installations, according to a defined program of verification of parameters, sampling, and routine analyses.
  • Assist the maintenance teams during dismantling, reassembly, maintenance and repair of machines and equipment in the fields of mechanics, electricity, and instrumentation.
  • Team member for the Emergency Response Team, including firefighting.
  • Participate in mandatory training as and when required.
  • Ensures chemical injection, lubricants & diesel consumption (Where applicable) is accurately measured.

During Construction phase:

Core activities:

  • Familiarization with the project documents.
  • Participates in the commissioning operations of the installations in particular the loop tests to adapt with the ICSS and specifically the SCADA.

.

EACOP is committed to ensuring that the health, safety and welfare of workers, communities, and the environment are well addressed and managed. Therefore, the employee is mandated to:

  • Fully complies with Company H3SE (Health, Safety, Social, Security & Environment) policies and Life Saving Rules.
  • Actively participates in HSEQ and promotes this culture to co-workers.
  • Remain vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of potential unsafe conditions.
  • Communicates to management any HSE related concerns and ways to improve them.
  • Maintains a workplace & workspace that is safe, clean, and always neat – practice good housekeeping.
  • Prepare teams for emergencies.
  • Ensure the implementation of corrective actions following incidents or degraded situations.
  • Reporting on operational activities and significant events and Exemplarity in behavior.
  • Ensure the control of technological risks and safety conditions of operations, ensure an optimum level of safety in all site activities, and respect the environment.

Academic Qualifications:

  • High School Certificate in Math and Science subjects
  • Technical diploma in a specialty: mechanical, electrical, instrumentation or internationally accredited oil & gas training certificate.

Experience Required:

  • 2 to 5 years of experience on major production sites. A good knowledge of processes and DCS / SCADA is essential.
  • Good level in English a requirement, both written & spoken.
  • Rigorous and organized.
  • Must be familiar with IT tools (Word, Excel and other PC software), analytical, rigorous, good communication skills, pedagogical, autonomous, organized and recognized ability to lead a team.

.

If you like working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Junior Data Center Shift Engineer
description:
Salary Range: €40,000.00 To €45,000.00 Annually



Massimizzi le sue possibilità di successo assicurandosi che il suo CV e le sue competenze corrispondano ai requisiti di questa posizione.

Across the data center industry – from deployment, through operations and maintenance, to decommissioning – Salute is the industry leader in delivering global data center services. As we expand our operations across Europe – we are looking to recruit a Data Center Engineer in Milan (Mechanical/Electrical).


The Junior Facilities Engineer is responsible, as part of a team, for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The Junior Facilities Engineer primarily interacts with Data Facilities Engineers, clients, and vendors. Data center equipment that supports mission‑critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, emergency diesel generators, electrical switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems, and a basic understanding of this equipment would be preferred.


The Junior Facilities Engineer also provides comprehensive data center white space support for IT infrastructure, which may include monitoring, troubleshooting, reporting, and day‑to‑day maintenance – all of this being site‑dependent and as per the service level agreements with our clients. MSOs are also responsible for using event monitoring and management systems to provide notifications and escalations to stakeholders during service outages.


This role will work on a 2-shift work pattern including night shifts.


Skills/Responsibilities/Experience/Knowledge

  • Basic knowledge of site facility infrastructure regarding power, thermal management and associated systems.
  • Working knowledge of facility equipment including, but not limited to, pumps, compressors, CRACs, UPS, generators, switch gear, BMS, life‑safety systems, security systems and more.
  • Work with senior colleagues, team members, vendors and other stakeholders to test and install data center infrastructure equipment and services.
  • Work closely with senior staff to ensure that operational services functionality meets or exceeds customer expectations for performance, reliability, escalation and communication, as per SLA.
  • Work closely with vendors to resolve service‑affecting incidents and/or outages.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and equipment problems, placing service calls when problems remain unresolved.
  • Provide data center white space support to managed services, which may include monitoring, troubleshooting, reporting, and day‑to‑day maintenance – all of this being site‑dependent and as per the service level agreements with our clients. MSOs are also responsible for using event monitoring and management systems to provide notifications and escalations to stakeholders during service outages.
  • Perform trouble isolation and resolution as needed.
  • Perform maintenance as needed/directed.
  • Perform day‑to‑day operations, functional maintenance on infrastructure equipment to ensure the reliability and resilience of the data center environment, as per checklists and procedures.
  • Perform consolidated event management for all monitored equipment at the data center site.
  • Provide monitoring and overall support, ensuring successful operation of all site facility and other mission‑critical equipment infrastructure (Generators, UPS, Thermal Management, Electrical infrastructure, etc.)
  • Experience from stacking and racking of servers to battery/power and structured cabling.
  • Generate end‑user performance reports as needed.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves client‑side problems, when so required.
  • Produce reports with metrics on service requests, problem management, backup and statistics, number of events for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Monitor capacity utilization.
  • Manages/Monitors physical access to data centers.
  • Successfully execute Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), when so required at site.
  • Trains new staff on all processes and procedures that relate to all of the above.
  • Good analytical and problem‑solving skills. Must be able to logically analyze, isolate and resolve site and customer‑facing service issues. Proficient in monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Good English communication skills, both verbal and written.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • Proven track record of success and delivering results.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship‑building skills, conducive to team development.
  • Physical work ability to lift 18‑23kgs (40‑50lbs) on a regular basis, and able to use server lift or pallet jacks.
  • Military experience would be an advantage.

What you’ll get from us:

Here, at Salute, we value our people and take great pride providing not just a job but fantastic career opportunities. In addition to the opportunity to work in a great team and earn a competitive salary - you'll gain access to cutting edge industry training that aims to enhance your skills and propel your career forward. xysqume Not only will you receive valuable development in your current role, but for those who are ambitious and motivated, the possibilities are endless.

title: Leasing Consultant - Town Westshore
description:
TRG Management, a premier property management company experienced with all types of housing, including subsidized, workforce and affordable, mid-rises, high-rises, luxury rentals, and single-family. Today we manage approximately 20,000 units across several states and our current management portfolio contains over 100 properties. Explore what we have to offer and help turn your talents into a rewarding career.


Job Description:

TRG Management, a premier property management company experienced with all types of housing, mid-rises, high-rises, luxury rentals. Today we manage approximately 20,000 units across several states and our current management portfolio contains over 100 properties. Explore what we have to offer and help turn your talents into a rewarding career. We’re actively seeking a Leasing Consultant for Town Westshore Tampa, FL. This role will collaborate directly with the property management team to provide residents with great service. To earn potential tenants' commitment, it is essential to pay attention to their needs, provide solutions, and support them throughout the leasing process.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities: Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Interview prospective tenants while adhering to Fair Housing Standards.
  • Accompany potential tenants to model apartments to explain size and layout, available amenities and services, and lease terms.
  • Fills out the lease form or agreement and collects the security deposit.
  • Periodically inspects the state of the property and makes arrangements for essential maintenance.
  • Compiles a list of available rental units.
  • Identifies potential prospects.
  • From start to finish, managing the leasing/renewal process.
  • Provide exceptional customer service and build great working connections with our residents.
  • Answers incoming calls and voicemails professionally and promptly.
  • Request that the prospect fill out an application and make a deposit following the company's policies and Fair Housing regulations.
  • Process applications for approvals and update the availability report. (For example, a credit check, rental history, and so on.) Submit completed applications for approval to the Community Manager. Follow up with the candidate to provide status.
  • Ascertain that the apartment is ready for the resident to move in on the scheduled move-in date.
  • Follow up with prospects who did not close and try to close the business. If you are unable to assist a prospect, direct them to a sister community that can satisfy their needs.
  • Monitoring local market trends and updating property comparables to keep an eye on what our competitors are doing.

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • A high school diploma or its equivalent is preferred.
  • 2 years of experience in customer service, hospitality, Conventional or multifamily real estate.
  • Previous leasing experience is a plus, not a requirement.
  • It is vital to have a strong customer service orientation and presenting abilities.
  • Working experience with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Working as a concierge, guest services representative, front desk attendant, or reservations agent in the hotel or hospitality industry is a bonus.
  • Onesite experience a plus.

Benefits as a TRGM Employee:

  • Base Salary + Performance Bonus.
  • Medical, dental, vision, legal services, flexible spending account, and commuter benefits.
  • The benefits package includes 100 percent employer-paid life and disability insurance.
  • Employer Matching 401k
  • Employee Engagement and Wellness programs.
  • Company-paid PTO
  • Opportunities for Professional Development and Tuition Reimbursement.

TRG Management is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are a Drug-Free Workplace.

title: Quality Assurance Technician
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Key Responsibilities

· Quality & Food Safety Monitoring

· Perform in-process quality checks (e.g., weights, pH, temperature, net content, appearance, packaging integrity).

· Verify CCPs, operational PRPs, and other critical control steps as defined in the HACCP plan.

· Conduct allergen verifications, metal detector checks, ATP/environmental swabbing, and sanitation verification.

· Ensure product labeling and coding meet specification and regulatory standards.

· Documentation & Records Management

· Accurately record data on production and QA forms in real time.

· Review and verify batch records, pre-op inspections, and line clearances.

· Support document control processes and assist in updating SOPs and QA programs.

· Microbiological & Analytical Testing

· Collect product and environmental samples for microbiological, chemical, and physical testing.

· Prepare and ship samples to internal or third-party labs according to protocol.

· Assist with shelf-life studies and sensory evaluations as needed.

· Compliance & Continuous Improvement

· Support internal audits, GMP inspections, and regulatory or customer visits.

· Identify and communicate non-conformances or process deviations to QA Management.

· Assist in root cause analysis, corrective actions, and verification of effectiveness.

· Participate in ongoing training and improvement initiatives to enhance food safety culture.

· Follow all plant safety, GMP, and hygiene protocols.

· Maintain clean and organized QA work areas.

· Report any unsafe conditions or behaviors immediately.


Qualifications

High school diploma or GED required.

Understanding of HACCP, GMPs, and food safety fundamentals is preferred.

Familiarity with USDA, FDA, and SQF or other GFSI standards is preferred.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.

Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Physical Requirements

Ability to stand, walk, and perform repetitive tasks for extended periods.

Lift up to 40 lbs as needed.

Work in cold or hot production environments (30°F – 90°F).

Wear PPE as required (smocks, gloves, hairnets, etc.).

title: Senior Software Engineer - Streams - Observability
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Observability Streams team at Elastic is building Elastic's unified data pipeline - the layer that connects where your data comes from to where it lands, with full control over how it's processed and routed along the way. Whether you're collecting metrics from cloud accounts, shipping logs from agents, or routing traces to different destinations, Streams is what ties it all together.
The Streams Backend team is responsible for the backend services powering this pipeline, ensuring data is routed, processed, and delivered efficiently and reliably at scale. We also own Logstash, the open-source streaming ETL tool (and the “L” in the “ELK stack”) trusted by enterprises worldwide to move and transform data, and we are regular contributors to the OpenTelemetry Collector.
As a Senior software engineer on the Streams Backend team,you will help drive the design and development of new features across the Streams Backend service and Logstash, contribute to the OpenTelemetry Collector, and support our users and enterprise customers.
Our team is distributed across the globe, and we communicate mostly through Slack, GitHub, email and Zoom.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing and implementing new features for Logstash and its plugins in Java and JRuby.
  • Designing, building, and operating core backend services for the Streams program in Golang.
  • Adding new features, and making contributions to the Open Telemetry Collector in Golang.
  • Solving hard distributed systems problems at scale.
  • Maintaining, updating and improving existing code and dependencies while ensuring automated test coverage.
  • Engaging with multiple public GitHub repositories and community forums.
  • Providing Pull Request reviews and guidance to your peers.
  • Collaborating with other teams to drive product goals.
  • Working together with the support organization to help our customers, which will also include participating in an on-call rotation.

What You Bring

  • Ability to work in a remote-first, highly distributed environment, with top-notch verbal and written communication.
  • Proficient analytical, problem solving, debugging skills and ability to find efficient solutions.
  • Critical thinking, positivity, autonomy and adaptability.
  • Expertise in at least one of Java, Golang and Ruby, and willingness to learn and work with the others and ability to adapt to regularly working in different codebases.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to work proficiently in a remote-first, highly distributed team.
  • A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with observability tools and concepts (tracing, metrics, logging), especially experience with or interest in OpenTelemetry
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • JRuby development
  • Open source software development
  • Knowledge of stream processing platforms (such as Kafka), database technologies (e.g., Postgres or MySQL) and network technologies (e.g., TCP, UDP and HTTP).
  • Exposure to the Elastic stack.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€67.000—€106.000 EUR

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

title: Software Engineer, AI
description:
Ambrook helps American family-run businesses become more profitable and resilient.
From volatile markets to climate shifts, independent operators face mounting pressure. While sustainable investments often yield the best long-term returns, they require financial clarity and capital that fragmented legacy systems can’t provide.

We are rebuilding the financial infrastructure that real economy operators rely on. By replacing paperwork with modern tools for accounting, banking, and spending, Ambrook gives owners the data they need to prove viability to lenders and the next generation. We empower the stewards of land and labor to make confident investments in their future.

We’re a Series B startup backed by Lachy Groom, Thrive Capital, Dylan Field, Thomson Reuters Ventures, Cameron Ventures, and leaders at Notion, Gusto, and Vercel. We’re looking for team members to help us untangle the intersection of American industry, climate, and the economy.

The opportunity

Ambrook is building a world-class team to empower farmers, ranchers, and small-business owners using modern AI tools. You’ll shape how we use LLMs and intelligent systems to make messy, high-stakes financial workflows faster, smarter, and more accessible for users across the country.

We’re shipping features that lift our customers out of the drudgery of rote bookkeeping and that help them make smart financial decisions, from cashflow management, to enterprise P&L analysis to long term investment planning. Our goal is to supplement our customer’s talents and savvy with the intelligence of a fortune 500 finance team in the form of an AI CFO.

​​We’re looking for someone who we can count on to:

  • Own: Development of intelligent systems and tools that use LLMs, other generative AI solutions and heuristics to streamline bookkeeping, financial workflows and deeper applications that truly understand the user, as well as the infrastructure for evaluating those systems.

  • Teach: Best practices around ML system design, evaluation, prompt engineering, and scalable AI infrastructure.

  • Learn: How messy real world financial data really is - from scanned PDFs to unformatted CSVs to text-heavy emails - and how to make sense of it using language models.

  • Improve: Our internal tooling and infrastructure for classification, tagging, summarization, and user-in-the-loop AI systems.

Within 1 month you'll...

  • Build an assistant that powers a critical bookkeeping workflow.

  • Collaborate with operations, product and engineering to understand customer workflows and where AI would reduce user pain.

  • Review our current AI infrastructure and propose improvements to our evaluation infrastructure, harness design, shared memory, durability and similar foundational components.

Within 3 months you'll...

  • Act on your proposals from month one: scaling our evaluation pipelines, making our harnesses more extensible, and so on.

  • Implement or improve systems for document extraction and financial transaction tagging, using both heuristics and model-based approaches.

  • Collaborate closely with design and product to make AI features feel reliable, intuitive, and helpful – not mysterious or brittle.

Within 6 months you'll...

  • Own and scale the systems that form the backbone of our vision for an AI CFO.

  • Contribute to our long-term AI strategy: which tasks to automate, how to measure confidence, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • Help build internal tooling for prompt iteration, embedding search, labeling, and retraining.

title: Customer Experience Advisor | S1 | Retail Banking | Ballymena
description:
Customer Experience Advisor | S1 | Retail Banking | BallymenaCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE

Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.

Retail & Commercial Banking is a global business integrating all our retail and commercial banking activities to better serve our customers, improve efficiency and drive value creation.


THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE

Santander is looking for a Customer Experience Advisor based out of Ballymena Branch , working 35 hours per week, on a rota’d basis Monday to Saturday, between 8am & 6pm.


For our customers, you’ll be more than just the friendly face and voice of Santander. You’ll be a listener and problem solver. Whether you’re helping someone with a simple cash transaction, aiding them with technology in the banking hall, transacting with them over the phone or protecting your customers against fraud and scams, you’ll never know what the next challenge will be.

What’s not in doubt is that you’ll have plenty of support. Life in a branch can be busy, varied and challenging, so we’re a close-knit team.

You’ll be totally flexible in your approach and comfortable in undertaking a broad range of activities. This means not limiting your time and focus on one particular element of your role. You’ll thrive on the variety this gives you and take satisfaction for operating in a multi-skilled environment. You’re the eyes and ears of our business after all.

We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Acting as the first point of contact for customers in branch or over the phone
  • Assisting with day-to-day transactions, queries and servicing
  • Answering customer calls into our contact centre
  • Building relationships and finding solutions
  • Developing your knowledge of services and products to help our customers
  • Identifying new ways to improve the customer experience

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Professional Experience

  • Proven ability to deliver outstanding customer service either from a face to face or a telephony background (Required)
  • The ability to communicate effectively with customers to truly understand their needs (Required)
  • A real desire to go above-and-beyond for customers (Preferred)
  • Effective team working skills with a flexible, can-do approach to work (Preferred)
  • Openness to a broad range of activities even if outside of standard expectations (Preferred)
  • Ability to grow, adapt and change accommodating business needs and priorities (Preferred)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.


  • The starting salary is £25,000 together with a £500 flexible benefit allowance and the opportunity to earn a discretionary performance-related bonus of 8% of salary.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, which increases to 26 days after 5yrs service, with the option to purchase up to 5 contractual days per year.
  • Voluntary healthcare benefits at discounted rates. Including: medical insurance, dental insurance, and health assessments
  • We put 8% of salary into your pension, even if you don’t contribute yourself. We’ll pay in up to 12.5% of salary, if you contribute as well, and you can take some of our contribution in cash if you prefer.
  • Protection for you and your family, with company-funded death-in-service benefit and income protection insurance, and the option to take advantage of discounted rates for additional life assurance and critical illness cover.
  • Share in Santander’s success by saving or investing in our share plans.
  • As a Santander UK employee, you are able to request staff versions of our products like our Edge Current Accounts and Credit Cards with no fees, as well as apply to many other deals and discounts in Santander products and services
  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE

At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.

We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen Branch location.

Right to work in the UK

  • All candidates must have the right to work in the UK to commence employment with Santander.

WHAT TO DO NEXT

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at resourcing@santander.co.uk

The world is how we shape it

Data Engineer – Cloud & AI Solutions

Entrerai a far parte del team Data Analytics & AI, contribuendo alla progettazione, realizzazione ed evoluzione di architetture dati moderne in ambienti cloud. Sarai coinvolto/a in iniziative di trasformazione digitale, migrazione e valorizzazione dei dati, lavorando a stretto contatto con Data Engineer, Data Scientist e specialisti AI.

In particolare ti occuperai di:

  • Progettare e sviluppare pipeline ETL/ELT scalabili, affidabili e sicure su piattaforme Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e AWS.

Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, orientata all'innovazione e appassionata al mondo dei dati e delle nuove tecnologie.

  • Una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Statistica, Fisica o discipline affini.

  • Una buona capacità di lavorare in autonomia, gestendo attività progettuali nel rispetto delle scadenze.
  • Un approccio analitico e orientato al problem solving.
  • Ottime capacità relazionali e predisposizione a collaborare in team multidisciplinari e multiculturali.
  • Interesse verso le tecnologie emergenti e una forte motivazione ad approfondire gli sviluppi nell'ambito AI, GenAI e Agentic AI.
  • Una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
  • Costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di piattaforme di data engineering e analytics moderne quali Databricks.

Requisiti fondamentali

  • Esperienza su Google Cloud Platform (GCP) con particolare riferimento a:
    • BigQuery
    • Cloud Storage
    • Cloud Dataflow
    • Cloud Pub/Sub
    • Cloud Composer
  • Esperienza su AWS, in particolare:
    • Amazon S3
    • AWS Glue
    • Amazon Athena
    • AWS Lambda
    • Amazon Redshift
  • Ottima conoscenza di SQL.
  • Buona padronanza di almeno uno dei seguenti linguaggi di programmazione:
    • Python (preferenziale)
    • Go
    • Node.js
    • C/C++
  • Esperienza con strumenti di orchestrazione dei workflow, come Apache Airflow o Cloud Composer.
  • Conoscenza di Git, versionamento del codice e pipeline CI/CD.

Costituiscono un plus

  • Conoscenza o esperienza nell'utilizzo della piattaforma Databricks per lo sviluppo di pipeline dati, elaborazioni distribuite e gestione di architetture Lakehouse.
  • Familiarità con Apache Spark e con i principali pattern di Data Engineering in ambienti cloud.
  • Conoscenza dei paradigmi e delle tecnologie di Generative AI, inclusi:
    • Large Language Models (LLM)
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
    • Vector Database
  • Esperienza con framework per lo sviluppo di applicazioni agentiche e orchestrazione di LLM, come:
    • LangChain
    • LlamaIndex
    • CrewAI
    • AutoGen
  • Esperienza in progetti di migrazione dati complessi, integrazioni multi-cloud o modernizzazione di sistemi legacy.
  • Conoscenza delle tematiche di sicurezza del dato, crittografia e processi di re-encryption.
  • Esperienza con strumenti di Infrastructure as Code, come Terraform.
  • Certificazioni cloud, quali:
    • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
    • AWS Certified Data Engineer
    • Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate o Professional)
    • Certificazioni equivalenti in ambito Data & Cloud.

title: SQL/ Python Developer

KBR are a global technical solutions provider with 28,000 employees worldwide, with operations in 34 countries delivering to customers in 80 countries. KBR work collaboratively with their wide customer base to deliver solutions that strive to create a better, safer and more sustainable world. KBR’s Estates Intelligence division specialise in enabling clients to make informed decisions about the operational and strategic management of their estates and asset portfolios, including the external supply chain retained to deliver asset management and maintenance services. As part of the ongoing growth of its Estates Intelligence, KBR is actively recruiting to expand its team to deliver current and future public sector Estates Intelligence contracts.

About the Role

The Developer will report to the Lead Developer and operate as part of the Estates Intelligence BI team. This team delivers data-driven insights across multiple projects, addressing estates and facilities challenges and enabling informed decision‑making for both internal stakeholders and clients. The Developer builds onto and maintains the Reporting Data Warehouse, drives innovation projects, as well as creates and assures BI datasets and pipelines. The Developer also supports technical delivery and ensures solutions meet performance and quality standards.

  • Build & Configuration: Develop machine learning algorithms within the Fabric Notebooks environment. Implement SQL queries, stored procedures and views for data transformations. Develop Power BI datasets, DAX measures and calculation logic to meet reporting needs. Configure and manage refresh schedules and gateway connections.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Tune algorithm model performance, check relationships and visuals for responsiveness. Validate data accuracy and consistency across reports and dashboards. Document test results and remedy defects promptly.
  • Deployment & Documentation: Prepare release notes and update technical documentation for all changes. Promote changes through Dev/Test/Prod environments in line with governance.
  • Operational Support: Monitor daily pipeline runs and resolve failures. Escalate complex issues to the Lead Developer and contribute to root‑cause analysis.
  • Continuous Improvement: Suggest enhancements to improve efficiency, maintainability and scalability. Track new Power BI and Fabric features, as well as other development opportunities, and adopt best practice where relevant.

Required Qualifications, Experience & Skills

Essential:

  • Strong understanding of SQL using environments such as SSMS and Visual Studio.
  • Profound knowledge of Python with experience in using the Fabric Notebooks environment.
  • Able to identify trends and investigate underlying causes to address issues, highlight areas of concerns and identify best practice.
  • Experience managing build, release, and deployment processes within a DevOps framework.
  • Proven experience of Power BI – Desktop & Service – most importantly with knowledge of Fabric features such as Data Engineering, Factory & Science.
  • Familiar with Power Suite.
  • Proven analytical skills and utilisation of data to produce client reports.
  • Skilled in presenting clear and concise information to a wide variety of audiences.
  • Comfortable presenting findings to internal, external and client stakeholders at all levels.
  • Hold or ability to obtain security clearance.

Desirable:

  • Experience in Web Development.
  • Knowledge of App Development within .NET.
  • Understanding of other ML languages.
  • Experience of a broad scope of estates management reporting within a similar environment.
  • Knowledge of Concept Evolution or other CAFM systems.

The role is based at Swindon and will be expected to be in the office up to 3 days per week. There will also be occasional travel to Client Sites required.

title: Summit Senior Technical Consultant
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Join Teciem and Help Transform Treasury & Capital Markets Technology

At Teciem, we're looking for a Summit Senior Technical Consultant to join our Global Professional Services team and help leading financial institutions maximize the value of their Summit investment.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technical consultant who enjoys solving complex challenges, working closely with clients, and delivering innovative solutions across treasury, liquidity, risk, and capital markets functions. You'll work alongside some of the industry's leading Summit experts, contributing to high-impact implementation, upgrade, migration, integration, and transformation programs.

As a senior member of the team, you'll combine hands-on technical expertise with consulting, solution design, mentoring, and customer engagement to drive successful outcomes for our clients.

What You'll Do

Deliver Summit Solutions

  • Support the implementation, upgrade, migration, and optimization of Summit solutions.
  • Configure, deploy, and support Summit environments and associated technical components.
  • Design and implement integrations, automation solutions, reporting capabilities, and data migration processes.
  • Contribute to architecture reviews and solution design activities.
  • Develop technical specifications and implementation documentation.

Technical Consulting & Problem Solving

  • Analyze client requirements and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Recommend best practices for performance, scalability, automation, and operational efficiency.
  • Support special initiatives such as platform optimization, modernization, cloud adoption, and seamless integration programs.

Customer & Project Engagement

  • Work closely with customers, functional consultants, architects, and delivery teams.
  • Participate in workshops, design sessions, testing, go-live activities, and production support.
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders through technical expertise and delivery excellence.
  • Help ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards.

Knowledge Sharing & Mentoring

  • Coach and support junior consultants.
  • Contribute to standards, tools, methodologies, and reusable assets.
  • Share technical expertise and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  • Support continuous improvement and innovation initiatives within the Summit practice.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • Experience delivering Summit technical solutions within banking, treasury, capital markets, or financial services environments.
  • Strong understanding of software implementation, integration, and support activities.
  • Proven experience working directly with customers in project or consulting environments.
  • Experience supporting upgrades, migrations, or transformation initiatives is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

Strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Summit platform architecture and technical framework
  • SQL and Oracle databases
  • Unix/Linux environments
  • Shell scripting
  • XML, JSON, and messaging technologies
  • REST APIs and integration technologies
  • Data migration and reporting solutions
  • Release management and environment support
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Experience with tools such as Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Jira, Confluence, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud technologies is an advantage.

Business Knowledge

Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is beneficial:

  • Treasury Management
  • Cash & Liquidity Management
  • Capital Markets
  • Risk Management
  • Derivatives Processing
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Banking and Financial Services Operations

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong customer focus and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage priorities and work across multiple projects.
  • Collaborative team player with a continuous learning mindset.
  • Passion for technology, innovation, and delivering exceptional client outcomes.
  • Willingness to leverage AI and automation tools responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and knowledge sharing.




Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Assembly Technician
description:
Overview: Must be able to assemble, disassemble and repair specific product lines focusing on Hose production and assembly. To perform the job properly, the Assembly Technician – Hose Assembly must have basic product knowledge, an understanding of production procedures, and ability to use common hand and power tools. The position requires self-direction, focus, and a strong desire to work within a team environment.


Essential Responsibilities:

  • Assemble fundamental components in accordance to the work instructions utilizing a combination of hand tools, power tools, and equipment.
  • Measure, cut and prepare hydraulic hoses in accordance with the work instructions utilizing a combination of hand tools, power tools and equipment.
  • Attach and secure various types of hose ends using crimping and assembly tools and equipment.
  • Assemble, kit and ship hydraulic hoses to meet established standards for quality, quantity, efficiency, and customer specifications consistently and correctly.
  • Communicate with appropriate parties in relation to expedited orders, component quality issues, inventory records, etc.
  • Participate in the implementation of process improvements.
  • Participate in maintaining and suggesting safety practices and procedures.
  • Maintain an orderly work environment.
  • Maintain system accuracy and record transactions in ERP operating system.
  • Participate as a team member to achieve goals.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Mechanical aptitude.
  • Familiarity with hand and power tools.
  • Detail oriented to provide the highest level of quality.
  • Strong sense of urgency and basic ability to prioritize in order to meet the expectations of the customer.
  • 1 year of relevant work experience, preferred.


Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential job functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • The majority of the time will be inside conditions with protection from weather conditions, but not necessarily from temperature changes. Some work is achieved near open bays with no control over weather conditions.
  • There are periodic high noise levels and vibration associated with this job. Sources include: engine noise, air compressors, air powered equipment, and other shop noises. Hearing protection should be used in these environments.
  • There are potential of physical hazards in which there is danger to life, health, or bodily injury, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving equipment, heavy parts, electrical shock, compressed air and exposure to chemicals.
  • Machines, tools, equipment, and work aids which may be representative, but not all inclusive, of those commonly associated with this type of work.
  • Air power tools, electric drill, drill press, crimping machines, grinders (both hand and bench), wrenches, heat guns, lathe, torches, welders, a variety of hand tools, mills, and electric cords.


Physical Requirements: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by and employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Must be able to lift up to 70 lbs. occasionally and/or up to 50 lbs. of force frequently and up to 25 lbs. of force on a regular basis through the day, depending on work related circumstances.
  • Must be able to be attentive to job at hand to complete tasks consistently correctly.
  • Must be able to lift objects from floor to above shoulder level. Must be able to move objects/parts/tools and equipment from one area to another and one level to another level.
  • Strong hand-eye coordination
  • Standing or Sitting for up to 4 hours at a time.
  • Reaching – extending and pulling the hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction while working with various tools as mentioned above.
  • Handling - seizing, holding, grasping, turning, pulling, or otherwise working with hands and arms.
  • Pulling – using arms in such a way as pulling of tools, wrenches, parts, and equipment to complete the job.
  • Manual dexterity – picking, pinching, or otherwise working with fingers primarily.
  • Feeling – being able to determine objects such as size, shape, temperature or texture by means of receptors in skin, particularly those of finger tips.


Benefits:

  • 100% Employee Owned - ESOP
  • Health Insurance (3 plan options)
  • 401(k) plan plus Employer 401(k) Matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • HSA - Health Savings Account
  • Paid time off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Vision insurance
  • Accident/Critical Illness Insurance options
  • Life Insurance
  • And more!

description:

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Job Description – Functional Consultant, Sophis Invest

Keywords: Asset Management, Sophis, Managed Services, Functional, Finance

Teciem is looking for a Functional Consultant to join our Professional Services CoE team and help leading financial institutions get the most from Sophis and Sophis Invest. In this role, you will work on meaningful client projects, deepen your business and technical expertise, and contribute directly to the delivery of high-value services across the professional services team.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, working close to clients, and becoming a trusted expert on Sophis solutions. You will use your hands-on experience to improve customer satisfaction, support successful delivery, and build specialist expertise in a high-impact consulting environment.

Company and Business Unit background

Teciem offers a stimulating environment where you can challenge yourself, strengthen both your technology and business skills, and grow your career through real project exposure. You can expect development opportunities, recognition for your individual and team contribution, the chance to travel within Europe and beyond, and a collaborative atmosphere with supportive colleagues.

This is a unique opportunity to join a world-leading, multi-awarded company and work alongside some very strong professionals in our industry. You will be mentored by leading Sophis experts, contribute to major technology and business transformation initiatives, and play an integral role in shaping the next phase of our solutions and services.

title: Entreprise- eller Projektleder til nedrivning på Sjælland
description:
Har du erfaring med at drive entrepriser og tage ansvar for både fremdrift og økonomi? Trives du med at have overblik på byggepladsen og tage beslutninger, når det gælder? Og motiveres du af at have dit eget ansvar frem for at få det tildelt i små bidder?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Kingo arbejder vi med nedrivning og miljøsanering, hvor tingene skal hænge sammen i praksis og ikke kun på papiret. Det kræver struktur, ansvar og evnen til at få både folk og planer til at fungere i virkeligheden.

Om jobbet
Som Entreprise- eller Projektleder får du ansvar for egne entrepriser inden for miljøsanering og totalnedrivning - fra planlægning til aflevering. Rollen forudsætter, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt fra start og tage ansvar for både fremdrift, kvalitet og økonomi.

Du leder projekterne i samarbejde med egne medarbejdere og underentreprenører og indgår i en organisation med korte beslutningsveje og faglig sparring, når der er behov for det.

Du kommer til at:

  • Have det overordnede ansvar for egne entrepriser - med fokus på fremdrift og indtjening
  • Følge tæt op på økonomi, budgetter og dækningsbidrag
  • Prissætte, beregne og udarbejde tilbud i samarbejde med kolleger
  • Deltage i byggemøder og stå for den løbende kundedialog
  • Gennemføre besigtigelser og bidrage til opsøgende salgsarbejde

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har en byggefaglig baggrund som bygningskonstruktør, tekniker, ingeniør eller erfaren håndværker
  • Har praktisk erfaring med ledelse af entrepriser - gerne inden for byggeri, nedrivning eller miljøsanering
  • Er struktureret og målrettet, med evnen til at bevare overblikket i travle perioder
  • Har økonomisk indsigt og er vant til at arbejde med tilbud og kalkulation
  • Trives med at stå i front - både over for medarbejdere, kunder og samarbejdspartnere
  • Har flair for at identificere forbedringer, både teknisk og procesmæssigt
  • Kendskab til miljøsanering eller nedrivning er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Det tilbyder vi dig

  • Et job med stor indflydelse, variation og ansvar
  • Frihed under ansvar, du styrer og prioriterer selv din hverdag
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på samarbejde, sikkerhed og ordentlige forhold
  • Et fagligt stærkt og uformelt kollegialt fællesskab
  • Grundig introduktion til Kingo og vores måde at arbejde på
  • En attraktiv lønpakke, som matcher din erfaring og værdi

Om Kingo
Kingo er Danmarks førende miljøbevidste nedrivningsvirksomhed med over 70 års erfaring. Med hovedsæde i Silkeborg og afdelinger over hele landet løser vi opgaver fra mindre renoveringer til store totalnedbrydninger, inklusive vindmøller, skrot- og demonteringsopgaver. Vi har et stærkt team af specialister, der er klar til at støtte vores entrepriser. Kingo er synonym med miljøvenlig nedrivning, der skaber plads til nyt byggeri og en grønnere fremtid. Vi bidrager aktivt til branchens udvikling og er ISO-certificeret med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø. Som førende inden for genbrug og genanvendelse af byggematerialer arbejder vi konstant for at reducere ressourcespild gennem øget genbrug af materialer i deres oprindelige form.

Du kan læse mere om Kingo på

Kingo Karlsen A/S

Sjælland

Danmark

Sådan søger du
Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via "Søg Job"- knappen. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette.

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at ringe til Rekrutteringskonsulent, Anne Christine Centio Almvig på 2516 9364 eller sende en mail på acca@kingo.biz.

  • Ability to build processes that support data transformation, workload management, data structures, dependency and metadata
  • Ability to build and optimize data sets, 'big data' data pipelines and architectures
  • Ability to understand and tell the story embedded in the data at the core of our business
  • Ability to communicate with non-technical audience from a variety of business functions
  • Strong knowledge of coding standards, best practices and data governance
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2-C1 or higher)
We offer:
  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Accrual-based Paid Time Off (PTO for any reason, including sick days), plus paid national holidays and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.

  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Engineer IV - Tech. Lead Complexity Optimization
description:
Inside the Role

Daimler Truck North America (DTNA) is advancing Product Complexity Optimization as a strategic imperative to simplify its product and part portfolio, improve operational efficiency, strengthen long-term competitiveness, and support the company's strategic ambition to be the undisputed market leader.
The Technical Lead role serves as the primary technical leader and advisor for enterprise-wide complexity optimization across DTNA's product portfolio. It drives technical idea generation, proposal development, and evaluation activities required to identify and advance meaningful complexity optimization opportunities.
Working across Engineering and DTNA's key business functions, this position enables teams to challenge existing requirements, designs, standards, portfolio decisions, and manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for simplification. Success requires deep engineering expertise, broad vehicle knowledge, and a strong understanding of customer applications and business needs. The goal is to reduce unnecessary complexity without compromising customer value, product functionality, or vehicle capability. With high visibility across the Engineering organization, the role partners closely with Engineering leadership to prioritize and advance complexity optimization proposals.
The role is a critical enabler of DTNA's Complexity Optimization strategy, supporting the delivery of up to $250 million in sustainable cost savings and operational efficiency gains by 2030.

Posting Information

We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected.

We Take Care of Our Team


Job Description

What You Drive at DTNA


  • Serve as DTNA's technical lead for complexity optimization, driving the identification, development, and evaluation of technical complexity optimization opportunities and developing technically and financially sound proposals.
  • Guide Engineering teams in identifying opportunities to simplify DTNA's product portfolio, part portfolio, and manufacturing processes while preserving customer value, product functionality, and vehicle capability.
  • Facilitate technical workshops and working sessions that identify optimization opportunities, challenge assumptions, and mature proposals toward decision readiness.
  • Collaborate across Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Service, Sales, Marketing, Product Strategy, and other functions to build alignment and advance proposals.
  • Identify and shape high-impact complexity optimization opportunities that deliver significant business value across DTNA's product portfolio and operations.
  • Present complexity optimization recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, and investment cases to Engineering and executive leadership.
  • Partner closely with Engineering leadership to prioritize opportunities and secure the resources needed to advance approved complexity optimization proposals.
  • Serve as DTNA's technical advisor and thought leader for complexity optimization by establishing methods and best practices, mentoring teams, and influencing technical decision-making across the organization.
  • Mentor and influence engineering leaders and teams to embed a complexity optimization mindset across DTNA's engineering culture

Knowledge You Should Bring


  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, industrial engineering, or a related technical field and 12+ years of engineering experience in an industrial, automotive, or commercial vehicle OEM environment, is required
  • Broad system level understanding of vehicle architectures, systems, and product lifecycles
  • Demonstrated experience influencing technical direction and decision‑making across multiple programs or platforms
  • Strong understanding of product development processes, engineering governance, and cross‑functional interfaces
  • Proven ability to evaluate technical, financial, and operational tradeoffs without owning detailed design execution
  • Experience working in highly matrixed organizations with indirect authority
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, capable of guiding technical discussions and presenting complex topics to senior leadership
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, enterprise‑wide initiatives
  • An attached resume is required

Exceptional Candidates Might Have


  • Experience in complexity management, value engineering, modular architectures, standardization or design standards development
  • Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, or aftermarket considerations beyond core design engineering
  • Master’s degree in engineering or engineering management
  • Experience in the design and development of metal and plastic components and assemblies
  • Prior experience contributing to enterprise transformation or cross‑product initiatives at DTNA or Daimler Truck
  • Understanding of customer applications, business needs, and the factors that drive customer value

Where We Work

This position is open to applicants who can work in (or relocate to) the following location(s)-

Portland, OR US. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Schedule Type:

Hybrid (4 days per week in-office / 1 day remote). This schedule builds our #OneTeamBestTeam culture, provides an unparalleled customer experience, and creates innovative solutions through in-person collaboration.

At Daimler Truck North America, we recognize our world is changing faster than ever before. By listening to the needs of today, we’re building to solve with cutting-edge solutions in sustainability and future driving technology across electric, hydrogen and autonomous. These solutions, backed by years of innovative success and achievement, continue DTNA’s legacy as the undisputed industry leader. Our evolving brand portfolio is second to none, including Freightliner Trucks, Western Star, Demand Detroit, Thomas Built Buses, Freightliner Custom Chassis, and Financial Services. Together, we work as one team towards our envisioned future – building a cleaner, safer and more efficient tomorrow for all.

That is what we are working toward - for all who keep the world moving.

POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES AND PERFORMANCE CRITERIA (% of Time)
