title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description Overview


At AtkinsRéalis Nuclear, we’re developing digital products that are helping transform how complex nuclear infrastructure is designed, constructed, operated, maintained and decommissioned. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help shape and develop a suite of extended reality (XR) products that connect field teams with project information, digital work packs, asset data, spatial models, evidence capture and remote expert support. You’ll combine hands‑on full stack engineering with technical leadership, working across modern web applications, cloud services, APIs, data integrations and mobile deployment. You’ll collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, subject‑matter experts and client stakeholders to turn promising ideas and existing capabilities into secure, scalable and maintainable products that deliver real‑world value. As a senior member of the team, you’ll help shape technical direction and architecture while supporting others to develop their knowledge and confidence. You’ll have space to share your ideas, explore different approaches and contribute to engineering practices that enable our products and people to grow.



Your role



  • Develop and evolve full stack products, building modern applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, cloud‑native services and well‑structured back‑end APIs.

  • Help shape our technical architecture, making thoughtful decisions that support scalable, secure and maintainable products across web, cloud, XR and engineering data workflows.

  • Support mobile deployment, contributing to applications built for Android and iOS using Capacitor or similar technologies.

  • Connect products, data and engineering workflows, developing integrations with document, model, asset and information sources, including FME or comparable data transformation and automation tools.

  • Develop and support cloud solutions, building and maintaining Azure‑hosted services, deployment pipelines and supporting infrastructure for product development and delivery.

  • Collaborate across disciplines, working with product managers, designers and domain specialists to understand user needs and translate complex construction, engineering and nuclear requirements into practical digital solutions.

  • Champion good engineering practices, contributing to technical decisions, code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD and secure development while sharing knowledge and supporting other engineers.

  • Support products in real‑world environments, contributing to demonstrations and pilot deployments, troubleshooting issues and continuously improving performance, reliability, usability and security.



About you


We’re looking for someone with strong full stack engineering foundations who enjoys combining hands‑on development with collaboration, technical leadership and problem‑solving. You don’t need to have worked with every technology or industry area we use. What matters is that you bring the depth of experience and engineering judgement needed to make considered technical decisions, support others and help guide products from development into reliable real‑world use. You may thrive in this role if you:



  • Have strong experience developing modern full stack applications, with hands‑on knowledge of React, JavaScript and TypeScript and experience designing or integrating back‑end services and REST APIs.

  • Have experience developing and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure, alongside modern practices such as Git‑based source control, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • Have experience with mobile application deployment, ideally using Capacitor for Android and/or iOS, or bring transferable experience with comparable technologies.

  • Understand software architecture, application security and maintainable engineering practices, and are comfortable making and communicating thoughtful technical decisions.

  • Have experience integrating different sources of data, documents, models or workflows. Experience with FME, CAD, BIM, GIS, asset information or common data environments would be particularly valuable.

  • Enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines, translating complex user or business needs into practical technical solutions and explaining your thinking clearly to both technical and non‑technical colleagues.

  • We’d also welcome experience or an interest in XR, augmented or mixed reality, spatial computing, digital twins or real‑time platforms such as Unity, NVIDIA Isaac Sim or Unreal Engine. These are valuable additions, but we don’t expect one person to bring experience in every area.

  • Knowledge of containerisation, infrastructure as code, SaaS products or configurable enterprise platforms could also be useful, as could an interest in emerging technologies such as computer vision, AI, robotics, IoT and 3D visualisation.

  • Experience within nuclear, construction, infrastructure or another regulated or safety‑critical environment can be valuable, but we’re equally interested in relevant experience from other sectors and the different perspectives you could bring.

  • Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is collaborative, thoughtful and curious, who enjoys sharing their knowledge and helping others develop, and who wants to build high‑quality digital products that make a meaningful difference to how complex projects are delivered.



Rewards & benefits


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.



Security clearance


This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance. We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong – a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability. As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to offering an interview to all applicants who have a disability and meet the essential criteria. If you would like to be considered under this commitment, please let us know at the application stage.



Worker Type


Employee Job Type Regular At AtkinsRéalis, we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world‑class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences. Created by the integration of long‑standing organizations dating back to 1911, AtkinsRéalis is a world‑class engineering services and nuclear company dedicated to engineering a better future for our planet and our people. We create sustainable solutions that connect people, data and technology to transform the world’s infrastructure and energy systems. We deploy global capabilities locally to our clients and deliver unique end‑to‑end services across the whole life cycle of an asset including consulting, advisory & environmental services, intelligent networks & cybersecurity, design & engineering, procurement, project & construction management, operations & maintenance, decommissioning and capital. The breadth and depth of our capabilities are delivered to clients in strategic sectors such as Engineering Services, Nuclear and Capital.



News and information


News and information are available at Atkinsrealis or follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Summit Director, Technical Consulting
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Shape the Future of Treasury & Capital Markets Technology

As the Summit Director, Technical Consulting, you will be the senior technical leader within our Professional Services organization, driving architecture excellence, technical delivery, and customer success across Summit implementations, upgrades, cloud migrations, and transformation programs.

This is a highly visible, customer-facing leadership role that blends strategic advisory, solution architecture, delivery governance, and team leadership. You will partner with clients, consultants, architects, and delivery teams to deliver innovative solutions that help financial institutions maximize the value of their Summit investment.

What You'll Do

Lead Technical Strategy & Architecture

  • Serve as the technical authority for Summit solutions and architecture.
  • Define technical standards, best practices, and delivery governance.
  • Lead the design and review of complex architectures, integrations, and platform transformations.
  • Provide guidance on cloud adoption, modernization, scalability, security, and performance.

Drive Customer Success

  • Act as a trusted advisor to technology and business stakeholders.
  • Lead architecture workshops, technical roadmaps, and strategic transformation discussions.
  • Help clients solve complex treasury, risk, and capital markets challenges.
  • Provide executive-level technical leadership during critical project phases.

Oversee Delivery Excellence

  • Govern technical quality across implementations, upgrades, migrations, and managed services engagements.
  • Support project planning, estimates, risk management, and issue resolution.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, supportable, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues.

Build High-Performing Teams

  • Mentor and develop technical consultants, architects, and engineers.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support hiring, capability development, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Drive the development of reusable assets, accelerators, and delivery frameworks.

Support Business Growth

  • Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales teams on strategic opportunities.
  • Contribute to proposals, solution design, customer presentations, and technical assessments.
  • Promote thought leadership and innovation within the Summit practice.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in treasury, capital markets, banking technology, or financial services software.
  • Deep expertise delivering and architecting Summit solutions.
  • Proven leadership of complex implementations, upgrades, migrations, or transformation programs.
  • Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and customer-facing experience.
  • Track record of leading distributed technical teams and driving successful customer outcomes.

Technical Expertise

  • Summit architecture, integrations, and technical frameworks.
  • APIs, enterprise integrations, and data migration.
  • Oracle, SQL, Unix/Linux, and modern integration technologies.
  • Performance tuning, release management, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Cloud, automation, CI/CD, and modern engineering practices.

Business Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

  • Treasury Management
  • Cash & Liquidity Management
  • Capital Markets
  • Derivatives Processing
  • Risk Management
  • Collateral Management
  • Accounting & Regulatory Reporting
  • Funding & Balance Sheet Management

Key Success Factors

You are:

  • A strategic technical leader who can influence executives and delivery teams alike.
  • A trusted advisor who combines deep Summit expertise with business understanding.
  • Passionate about developing people, improving delivery quality, and driving innovation.
  • Comfortable balancing architecture leadership, client engagement, practice development, and commercial growth.

Success will be measured through customer satisfaction, delivery excellence, technical quality, team development, business growth, and the continued expansion of the Summit consulting practice.




Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Software Engineer - Turkey
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.

What you will do:

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.

  • Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.

  • Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.

Requirements

  • Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity

  • Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.

    Location

    This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Turkey, however there is a preference for candidates to be based out of Ankara. Fluency in English and Turkish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

title: Senior Financial Data Analyst | S3 | CFO | Milton Keynes | Internal Mobility
description:
Senior Financial Data Analyst | S3 | CFO | Milton Keynes | Internal MobilityCountry: United Kingdom

IT STARTS HERE


Santander () is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organisation, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.

This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.


THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE


Finance is looking for a Senior Data Analyst based out of Milton Keynes.


This role is on a fixed term contract until 31/12/2027.


This role is a 0.25 FTE.


We are looking for an experienced senior data professional who understands data management best practices and has a proven track record of delivering solutions at the interface between Technology, Finance and business teams.

The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of financial reporting, including profitability, balance sheet and key financial and non-financial metrics, together with a detailed understanding of the relevant golden data sources used within the organisation.


The role requires someone who understands the wider banking environment and is comfortable delivering through others, including direct experience of people management.


The successful candidate must also have experience of managing complex projects and data deliveries, including identifying and managing risks, resolving delivery issues and escalating effectively to Director and Executive level where required.


We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:


  • Designing and implementing new data-driven processes using recognised golden data sources.
  • Developing new metrics, reporting and insightful management information to support the understanding and explanation of Santander UK performance.
  • Ensuring the team operates effectively and in accordance with the Bank's internal policies and relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensuring data and reporting solutions are fit for purpose, appropriately controlled, documented and sustainable.
  • Identifying, managing and resolving data quality and data ownership issues with data owners and key stakeholders to maintain consistency, completeness and accuracy.
  • Working collaboratively across Finance, Technology and other business areas to establish and communicate an accurate and consistent single view of performance based on agreed data sources and methodologies.
  • Managing delivery across multiple stakeholders, priorities and dependencies, escalating material risks and issues where appropriate.
  • Leading and developing team members, managing performance and conflict effectively, and ensuring delivery through others.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING


Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.


The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Professional experience:

  • Proven experience working with AWS and Athena, including the delivery of production-quality data and reporting solutions (Required)
  • Degree level educated (Required)
  • Experience in people-management, including managing performance, resolving conflict and delivering outcomes through others (Required)
  • Experience of financial reporting, including management information profitability, business drivers and key metrics (Required)
  • Solid numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate and explain complex financial information (Required)
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and good PowerPoint and presentation skills (Required)
  • Experience of working with senior stakeholders, including the ability to communicate effectively at Director and Executive level (Required)
  • Experience of data governance, data quality and control principles (Required)
  • Spanish (Preferred)
  • Background in risk reporting metrics (Preferred)

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT


At Santander, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.


Here, recognition goes beyond pay. It’s about the pride you feel in your work, the impact you have on customers and communities, and the opportunities you have to grow and thrive — personally and professionally.


Salary Range:
£53,500.00 - £80,250.00 per annum (depending on experience)

This salary range represents the expected remuneration for the role. Annual salary is based on a standard 35-hour working week. Actual salary offered will depend on skills, experience, qualifications and location.

  • Competitive rewards that reflect the real impact you make and the value you bring.
  • Wellbeing that goes beyond work — we work with a range of wellbeing partners across our 4 pillars of wellbeing (physical, mental, social and financial) to give you access to a suite of apps, discounted gym and fitness access, weekly online classes, flexible healthcare and mental health support.
  • Support for every life stage — from menopause and pregnancy to parenthood and beyond, with enhanced family leave, childcare options and tailored wellbeing support.
  • Time to give back through volunteering opportunities that let you make a difference in the communities we serve.
  • Global growth opportunities to shape your career, learn new skills and explore what’s possible across our international network.


Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.


LOCAL COMPLIANCE


At Santander, we’re proud to be an inclusive organisation that provides equal opportunities for everyone — regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.


We want our people to thrive — at work and at home — while delivering the best outcomes for our customers and supporting each other to grow.


To make this possible, our roles are site-based with a hybrid working pattern, where colleagues are expected to attend the office at least 12 days per month (pro-rata for part-time roles).


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen office location.


WHAT TO DO NEXT


If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

Please contact Robert Talbot– Robert.talbot@santander.co.uk

title: Multinational Client Advisor Graduate
description:
Company:

title: IT Service Management Director
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Role Purpose

Owns the end-to-end IT service management framework across Incident, Request and Change Management, ensuring the Service Desk and underpinning ITSM processes deliver a consistently reliable service to the business. Accountable for operational readiness for Day 1 and sustained SLA performance thereafter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously improve the Incident, Request and Change Management processes across Enterprise IT.

  • Lead the Service Desk function, ensuring resourcing, tooling and escalation paths meet agreed service levels.

  • Define and maintain ITSM standards, workflows and toolset configuration in line with industry best practice.

  • Chair the Change Advisory Board, balancing delivery velocity against operational risk.

  • Establish and report SLA and OLA performance, driving corrective action where targets are missed.

  • Lead major incident management, including communications, root cause analysis and lessons learned.

  • Coordinate with Technology Operations and Applications teams to ensure consistent incident and change practice across all towers.

  • Own problem management, ensuring recurring issues are identified, tracked and permanently resolved.

  • Define and validate service management readiness criteria ahead of Day 1 cutover.

  • Own the service catalogue and ensure it reflects current business-facing services.

  • Manage the relationship with the Service Desk supplier, including contract performance reviews.

Key Accountabilities

  • Accountable for the overall health and performance of the Incident, Request and Change Management processes.

  • Accountable for Service Desk performance against agreed SLAs.

  • Accountable for the integrity and accuracy of the ITSM toolset and associated data.

  • Accountable for service management readiness at Day 1 cutover.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Substantial experience leading IT Service Management functions within a large enterprise environment.

  • Demonstrable track record of running Incident, Request and Change Management at scale.

  • Strong command of ITIL processes and ITSM tooling configuration.

  • Experience leading Service Desk teams, whether in-house, outsourced or hybrid.

  • Proven ability to operate under pressure during major incidents, with clear and confident stakeholder communication.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging at senior executive level.

  • Experience supporting operational readiness for a major business transformation or carve-out.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience of Service Management within a regulated or financial services environment.

  • Exposure to supplier-managed Service Desk transitions.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or an equivalent enterprise ITSM platform.

Qualifications

  • ITIL v4 Foundation, minimum; Managing Professional stream desirable.

  • Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

Key Stakeholders

  • Head of Enterprise IT and wider Enterprise IT leadership team.

  • Technology Operations Lead and Applications Lead.

  • Business unit leaders and end users.

  • Service Desk and ITSM tooling suppliers.

Success Measures

  • SLA and OLA targets consistently met or exceeded across Incident and Request Management.

  • Change success rate maintained above agreed threshold with minimal unauthorised changes.

  • Service Desk customer satisfaction scores meet or exceed target.

  • Major incidents managed to resolution within target timescales, with completed lessons-learned actions.

  • Service management processes and tooling fully operational and validated ahead of Day 1.




Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

title: Medication Aide - Full Time - NOC
description:
Our senior living community is currently seeking a Medication Aide to join our team of dedicated professionals who want to make a difference in the lives of our residents, their families and our community. We are guided by our CAPLICO Core Values:

Celebration

Accountability

Passion for Learning

Love One Another

Intelligent Risk Taking

Customer Second (Employee First!)

Ownership

If these core values resonate deeply with your own moral compass and you meet the requirements below, then you should apply.

About the Opportunity

The Medication Aide administers prescribed medications and treatments to residents who need assistance in accordance with state regulatory stipulations and requirements for safe administration. Observes the resident taking the medication, notes effects including any unexpected or adverse effects, correctly documents the required information in the residents’ medication administration records, communicates any concerns or observations with the Wellness Director, Wellness Coordinator or designated personnel. The Medication Aide also supports residents with activities of daily living including personal hygiene, socialization, cognition, and physical health. Encourages resident independence, supports resident choice and preserves resident dignity through professional conduct and interactions.

Critical Success Factors

  • Successful completion of medication assistance training in compliance with the state’s regulatory requirements and facility requirements.
  • Maintains up-to-date medication certification requirements according to state regulations.
  • Compassionate and empathetic in personal interactions.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Self-supervising, self-motivating; willing to collaborate and work as a team member.
  • Adaptable and flexible; highly organized with ability to manage multiple demands/tasks concurrently. Demonstrates problem solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior direct care experience preferred.
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Current CPR certification required.
  • Meets age requirements according to facility policy and state regulations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

The individual must be able to work the hours specified. title: Principal Solutions Architect, Travel and Hospitality
description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service and unmatched technology. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow


What if your architecture became the industry blueprint for agentic AI? As a Principal SA embedded with a Fortune 500 technology leader, you'll architect, design, and build multi-agent systems at massive scale while advising C-Suite executives on AI transformation.

You'll serve as trusted technical advisor to an industry leader that is actively reshaping the traveler experience using AI and data. You will be the technical counterpart to customer executives who speak fluent AI and expect their AWS Solutions Architect to match that depth and push the conversation further.

Our customers are:

- Deploying specialized AI agents across every stage of the traveler journey — from inspiration to booking to in-trip support
- Building MCP-based and agents-as-tools infrastructure to build intelligent workflow
- Leveraging frontier foundation models for real-time inference, fine-tuning, and agentic orchestration

What Makes This Role Different

This role:
- Shapes the technical agenda for the account and operates at the C-Suite level
- Builds net-new architectures that become the reference
- Focuses on business outcomes
- Influences company-wide AI strategy
- Spans GenAI, ML platforms, agentic systems, data, and infrastructure

Key job responsibilities
- Build: create prototypes, reference implementations, and production-ready architectures that prove the value of new AI capabilities at scale
- Serve as the trusted technical voice, shaping the industry-level conversation on AI
- Access the full power of AWS: engage specialist teams, applied science resources, and product groups to deliver outcomes that no single team could achieve alone
- Pioneer new patterns: the solutions you build define how the industry approaches agentic AI, model orchestration, and intelligent automation
- Mentor the next generation: develop Solutions Architects who can operate at this altitude and complexity
- Define a transformational, agentic customer experience platform for global travelers

A day in the life
This is a builder role. You will:

- Architect agentic AI systems: design multi-agent orchestration frameworks, model fine-tuning pipelines, and real-time inference platforms that serve hundreds of millions of users
- Prototype and prove: build working POCs that demonstrate the art of the possible, turning executive vision into deployable architectures in days, not quarters
- Shape AI product strategy: sit in the room where roadmaps are set, influencing not just how but what gets built, both at the customer and within AWS
- Drive the technical relationship: own the end-to-end technical strategy for the customer

About the team

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Front of House Porter
description:
Front of House Porter

The Princess Grace Hospital, 42-52 Nottingham Pl, London W1U 5NY

Full time, 40 hours per week

Various shifts between 0630 and 2030, Monday- Sunday, working 5 days out of 7 to include alternate weekends

Permanent

£30,784 per annum + excellent benefits


We’re looking for a Porter to join our Front of House team based at The Princess Grace Hospital. Working within one of the UK’s leading private healthcare facilities, you’ll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day running of the hospital while helping to deliver an exceptional experience for patients, visitors and colleagues.

This is a varied and hands-on role where no two days are the same. You’ll support departments across the hospital with portering, security, patient transport and logistics duties, helping to ensure services run safely, smoothly and efficiently at all times.

As a Porter you’ll provide professional support across the hospital environment, assisting patients and visitors while maintaining high standards of customer service and operational excellence. From supporting emergency response teams and managing waste streams, to transporting patients and assisting with deliveries across site, your work will make a real difference to the overall patient journey. You’ll become part of a collaborative and supportive team where professionalism, compassion and teamwork are valued every day.

Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Other’s may think this is just a role in our Front of House team, but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.


What you’ll do:

  • Taking patients and visitors to their rooms
  • Transferring patients between hospital departments
  • Delivery of mail, equipment and materials
  • Hospital blood rounds
  • Collection and disposal of refuse (including clinical waste and sharps)
  • Assist in managing Medical Gas
  • Assisting the undertakers’ team
  • Medicine and fluid delivery/ storage
  • Carry out security/fire patrols of all internal and external Hospital Buildings, and to ensure all incidents are recorded in the correct manner

What you’ll bring:

  • Physically fit, able to lift heavy items when required
  • Previous experience in a similar role is essential
  • Excellent communication and customer skills
  • Knowledge of Health and Safety procedures

Why HCA UK?

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.

By caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Porter you’ll be eligible for:

  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.

Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

  • Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
  • Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
  • Honesty, integrity and fairness: - We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
  • Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments

We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer - UK Health Security Agency - G7
description:
Location

Core HQs - London, Liverpool, Leeds, Birmingham or Scientific Campuses - Colindale, Porton and Chilton

About the job Job summary

The UKHSA Development and Operations team leads the digital transformation of UKHSA to make it a more data driven, customer focused, digital organisation. We do this by delivering services which meet and maintain the Government Digital Service (GDS) Digital by Default Service Standard.

DevOps Engineers at UKHSA work collaboratively with developers and stakeholders such as Data Scientists and Public Health officials to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions that support the agency's mission and critical public health services. We employ modern best practices to deliver projects quickly, safely, and cost-effectively.

As a Lead DevOps Engineer you will manage a small team, acting as technical product owner and contributing to the development of strategic direction. You will be a recognised expert in modern development standards and systems integration, bringing deep technical knowledge to lead the sharing of good practice, coach and mentor colleagues, and develop medium to long term strategies for our DevOps toolchains and platforms.

Job description

  • Acting as technical product owner & developing medium to long term strategies for product lines & our CI/CD toolchain estate
  • Apply expert knowledge of modern development standards to support complex projects & programmes, leading others in applying these standards consistently across teams
  • Lead the sharing of knowledge & best practices across the DevOps engineering team, providing technical leadership and guidance through coaching and mentoring
  • Establish & maintain systems integration standards and procedures across the service product life cycle, ensuring practitioners adhere to them and managing resources to ensure effective integration delivery
  • Provide expert-level service support - identifying, locating and fixing complex service faults - and advise others on different methodologies and types of service support
  • Design solutions & services with security controls included, specifically engineered to mitigate security threats, applying practitioner-level information security skills across the teams you lead
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process optimisation opportunities across DDO
  • Design & assure business-critical systems, review technical solutions to ensure effective, scalable and cost-efficient outcomes
  • Champion user-centred design, representing user needs & promoting the use of research to inform decisions
  • Manage service components to ensure delivery against business objectives & key performance indicators (KPIs).

Role Purpose

  • As a Lead DevOps Engineer, you will shape UKHSA's DevOps strategy & act as technical product owner for product lines within Digital Development and Operations. You'll be a recognised technical leader, give expert knowledge of modern development standards & systems integration to promote quality, consistency & good practice.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring, and develop medium- to long-term strategies for DevOps toolchains, CI/CD pipelines & platforms. You'll have experience designing highly available cloud services, particularly on AWS, and implementing CI/CD and infrastructure automation using technologies such as Ansible and Terraform. Working across AWS and Azure, you will develop and support services and infrastructure through to production.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify & apply modern development standards to support complex projects & programmes across the teams you lead.
  • Act as technical product owner to develop medium to long term strategies for product lines and our CI/CD toolchain estate.
  • Contribute to development of UKHSA's DevOps strategic direction
  • Technical leadership & guidance.
  • Establish, maintain systems integration standards and procedures across the service and development lifecycle
  • Coordinate resources, integration testing and build activities to ensure effective integration
  • Diagnose & resolve complex service faults using advanced technical and diagnostic expertise.
  • Advise teams on service support approaches and methodologies
  • Design secure solutions with controls proportionate to mitigate security threats & risks.
  • Ensure teams apply appropriate security standards throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Design complex systems that impact the organisation,
  • Review system designs to ensure effective technology selection, resource use and integration across systems.
  • Design, develop, test & document medium‑to‑high complexity programs and scripts
  • Identify process optimisation opportunities contribute to the implementation of solutions.
  • Manage service components to ensure they meet business needs and KPIs.
  • Champion user-centred design by advocating for user research, representing user needs, and helping teams prioritise and understand user requirements.
  • Lead collaborative prototyping, developing and refining design patterns.

This list is not exhaustive

Person specification

Essential Criteria

  • Expert-level modern development standards, systems integration and service support, leading others in development standards across complex programmes; establishing integration standards across the product lifecycle; diagnosing and resolving complex service faults and advising on support methodologies.
  • Practitioner-level information security, systems design and programming - designing solutions with security controls to mitigate threats; designing medium-complexity systems; coding and documenting programs or scripts of medium-to-high complexity.
  • Practitioner-level user focus - working with user researchers, championing user-centred approaches and guiding teams in prioritising user needs.
  • Experience with cloud automation technologies (Ansible, Terraform) and implementing CI/CD platforms (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) using repeatable deployment patterns.
  • Experience acting as technical product owner for a project team or product line, contributing to medium to long term technical strategy.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical boundaries, with the ability to represent complex engineering decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  • Degree in computer science or equivalent, with a genuine passion for DevOps, cloud automation and version control (Git).

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience with containerisation technologies (e.g. Docker) and Kubernetes-based container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Understanding of RESTful Web Services.
  • Familiarity with the GDS Service Standard and Technology Code of Practice.
  • Contributing to DevOps or platform strategy at programme or organisational level.
  • Experience in a government, public health or regulated environment.

title: Director, USG Capture Management
description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Director, USG Capture Management

This position is responsible for helping secure US Government contracts, partnering with the Business Development (BD) team to transition opportunities into winning captures. The Director, USG Capture Management, will be responsible for leading the end-to-end capture lifecycle, from early-stage opportunity identification and strategy development through proposal submission and post-award transition.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the federal procurement process, a technical background with experience with satellite systems and their missions, and a proven track record of winning complex space programs. The capture manager will serve as an orchestrator, bringing together engineers, pricing, and proposal managers to develop compelling, compliant, and highly competitive offerings. The position involves regular exchanges with Astranis senior management, program management, engineering, operations, and legal teams. This position will report to the Senior Director of USG Sales and Solutions Engineering: Gilbert Tseng.

Role

  • Capture Strategy & Planning: Lead the development and execution of comprehensive capture plans for targeted US Government opportunities. Define win strategies, key discriminators, win themes, and value propositions.
  • Business Development Collaboration: Work closely with BD partners to evaluate opportunities and ensure alignment with the Astranis’s growth and product objectives. Develop and provide actionable intelligence on customer pain points, budgets, and acquisition strategies.
  • Competitive Intelligence: Conduct competitive assessments, including Black Hat reviews and Price-to-Win (PTW) analysis. Anticipate competitor strategies and develop counter-strategies to position the company favorably.
  • Teaming Strategy: Identify, negotiate, and establish strategic partnerships to build effective coalitions and solutions.
  • Reviews & Milestone Management: Guide opportunities through the internal executive review processes. Present compelling business cases, risk assessments, and resource requirements to senior leadership to secure Bid/No-Bid decisions.
  • Proposal Leadership and Guidance: Lead the transition from the capture phase to the proposal phase. Work with the Proposal Manager in translating capture strategies into proposal themes with compliant, persuasive proposal narratives. Participate in color team reviews in addition to authorship of proposal sections.

Requirements

  • B.S. or B.A. in engineering or hard science
  • At least 8+ years of experience in engineering, program management, corporate strategy, or USG sales/business development
  • Federal-level capture/proposal management and/or government acquisition experience
  • Broad knowledge of government space community, commercial space industry, associated organizations and on-going programs
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed, up to 25% of time
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • US Citizen or Green Card Holder

Bonus

  • Working knowledge of satellites, space science and weather systems / architectures and missions
  • Eligible to obtain a TS/SCI Security Clearance
  • Less than 5 years since previously active TS//SCI Security Clearance
  • Based in the National Capital Region (NCR) or San Francisco

What we offer:
All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and the level and scope of the position.

title: Summit Senior Business Consultant, Front Office
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Help Shape the Future of Treasury & Capital Markets

Join Teciem as a Summit Senior Business Consultant, Front Office and work with leading financial institutions to optimize and transform their Treasury and Capital Markets operations.

As part of Teciem's Global Professional Services team, you will contribute to Summit implementation, upgrade, migration, and transformation programs, helping clients improve trading workflows, strengthen risk management processes, and maximize the value of their Summit investment.

This role is ideal for a consultant with strong Front Office and Capital Markets expertise who enjoys working closely with clients, solving complex business challenges, and growing their consulting career within a collaborative, high-performing environment.

What You'll Do

Deliver Front Office Solutions

  • Support the analysis, design, configuration, and implementation of Summit Front Office solutions.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into effective functional designs and system configurations.
  • Participate in client workshops and solution design sessions.
  • Support testing, user acceptance activities, go-live, and post-production support.
  • Contribute to successful project delivery across multiple workstreams.

Support Business & Trading Transformation

Work with clients across areas such as:

  • Treasury Management
  • Capital Markets Trading
  • Fixed Income Products
  • Foreign Exchange (FX)
  • Money Markets
  • Trade Capture & Lifecycle Management
  • Market Risk Management
  • Valuation & Pricing
  • Liquidity & Funding Management
  • Derivatives Processing
  • Position & Exposure Management

Build Strong Client Relationships

  • Work closely with Front Office, Treasury, Risk, and Operations teams to understand business needs and objectives.
  • Provide functional recommendations and industry best practices.
  • Support issue resolution and continuous process improvement.
  • Deliver a high level of customer service and stakeholder engagement.

Contribute to Team Success

  • Collaborate with functional, technical, and delivery teams across global projects.
  • Share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the development of project deliverables, templates, and best practices.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior consultants when appropriate.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Treasury, Capital Markets, Banking, or Financial Services.
  • Experience working on Summit projects or similar Treasury and Capital Markets platforms.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, business transformations, or operational change initiatives.
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Consulting experience is advantageous.

Functional Expertise

Knowledge of several of the following areas:

  • Front Office Operations
  • Treasury Trading
  • Foreign Exchange (FX)
  • Fixed Income Products
  • Money Markets
  • Derivatives
  • Trade Lifecycle Management
  • Market Risk Management
  • Valuation & Pricing
  • Liquidity Management
  • Funding Operations
  • Capital Markets Business Processes

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong business analysis and requirements gathering skills.
  • Experience with functional solution configuration and testing.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, or data analysis techniques is advantageous.
  • Understanding of software implementation and project delivery methodologies.

What Makes You Successful

  • Customer-focused with strong relationship management skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic consulting environment.
  • Collaborative team player with a continuous learning mindset.
  • Comfortable working with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to leverage AI and automation tools responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and knowledge sharing.



Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

  • Preferred: Have knowledge in or be able to learn/perform Nutrition Focused Physical Examinations.
  • Preferred: Familiar with and able to navigate and electronic medical record.


JOB SUMMARY
The registered dietitian is a member of an interdisciplinary team who is responsible for providing quality medical nutritional therapy to patients. Responsibilities will include communicating relevant information to other team members, food services, and medical staff and providing education to staff, patients/families and others as needed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to tolerate up to four hours of consecutive work.
  • Position requires occasional periods of walking, standing and prolonged sitting.
  • Occasional need to initiate body positional changes to access equipment, materials and files from high and low areas.
  • Ability to lift or carry objects up to ten pounds continuously, twenty pounds frequently, fifty pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to push/pull greater than sixty pounds is required occasionally.
  • Fine manipulation is required for writing and computer usage, as well as for some types of patient care techniques.
  • Intact vision needed for observation of patient's non-verbal responses and skin assessment.
  • Must be able to initiate and interpret communication with patient and others.


COGNITIVE DEMANDS

  • Job requires independent problem identification. Abstract reasoning and adaptability to new situations, changing environments and information and quick decision-making are required. A high degree of selective attention, and/or concentration in the presence of noise/distraction is necessary.
  • Job requires legibility, spelling and abbreviation accuracy, and logical sentence/paragraph organization. A working knowledge and familiarity with professional/medical terms and definitions is required.
  • Job requires a high level of communication skill including expression of abstract/complex ideas, use of negotiation and active listening and an ability to dialogue with multiple parties.
  • Job requires the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide with all units of measure, and the ability to perform these operations with common and decimal fractions. To compute ratio, rate, percent and accurately use equations.
  • Job requires an ability to comprehend abstractions and to make inferences. A working knowledge and familiarity with professional (e.g., medical) terms and definitions and ability to interpret lab values is required.


WORK DEMANDS

  • Job requires primarily working indoors with an occasional need to be outdoors.
  • Job requires working regularly around many others, continuously with others and occasionally in a crowded space.
  • Schedule fluctuation is occasionally unpredictable due to census, documentation requirements or program development.
  • There may be occasional exposure to odors, fluctuation in temperature and hazards associated with food preparation, storage and delivery.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Assesses the nutritional status of patients and develops appropriate individualized nutrition care plan.
  • Completes documentation of all patient assessments, interventions, education, interdisciplinary communication and patient outcome accurately and on time. .
  • Considers medical, physical, psychological, environmental, age level, and developmental, cultural, ethnic, religious, and language needs in planning and carrying out nutritional interventions.
  • Monitors effectiveness of nutrition care plan and makes appropriate recommendations and changes as needed.
  • Coordinates nutrition care with food services and provides guidance, education, and direction to dietetic technician(s) and food and nutrition employees when appropriate. .
  • Provides education, training and supervision of support staff, volunteers, paraprofessional or other disciplines as appropriate.
  • Plans for discharge/education needs and provides necessary materials, referrals and resources.
  • Attends team meetings to share patient data and goals and communicates with team members to develop and implement an interdisciplinary plan of care.
  • Promotes continuous quality improvement and collects Quality Assurance/Compliance data.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
At Hospital for Special Care, we are committed to supporting the health, financial well-being, and professional growth of our team members. The wage range for this position is $32.00 to $47.00. Eligible employees may participate in a comprehensive benefits package that includes employer-subsidized medical and dental, vision insurance; a 403(b) retirement savings plan with an employer match of up to 6%; paid time off; employer-paid life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions; Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA); an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities; voluntary benefits, including pet insurance; employee wellness programs with access to our onsite fitness and aquatics center; an employee referral bonus program; and meaningful employee recognition and appreciation initiatives. Eligibility for certain benefits is based on scheduled hours worked.

Specs Inc. also provides Lens Studio, a full suite of advanced developer tools that powers immersive augmented reality experiences across Specs, Snapchat, and other services.


We’re looking for a Computational Imaging Engineer to join the SPECS team!


What you’ll do:

  • Develop image signal processing (ISP) pipelines for next generation computational imaging platforms
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across optics, sensors, computer vision, and compute teams
  • Influence key architectural decisions and drive consensus on critical trade-offs
  • Develop test methodologies and characterization plans for camera ISP performance
  • Lead root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for sensor performance issues

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge optics and camera systems for imaging, depth mapping, and biometric sensing
  • Knowledge of image quality and ISP pipelines
  • Skills with software development and data analysis (e.g., C++, MATLAB, Python, etc.)
  • Skills leveraging AI models to accelerate engineering workflows and software development
  • Ability to work independently and manage internal and external resources
  • Ability to consider system level impacts and tradeoffs in a highly constrained platform
  • Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work while meeting multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to collaborate and operate in a fast-paced cross-functional environment including engineering teams, vendors, suppliers, and outside resource management.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in optics, physics, electrical engineering, computer science or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in computational imaging for computer vision applications
  • Experience with computational imaging, computer vision, and machine learning for image processing
  • Experience developing and optimizing ISP and machine learning algorithms for camera products
  • Experience with non-traditional image sensors including: single photon detectors (e.g. SPADs, jots, SiPMs, etc.), event sensors, neuromorphic sensors, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD or master’s degree in optics, physics, electrical engineering, computer science or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in designing robust computer vision algorithms for consumer electronics platforms
  • Experience building camera systems for AR/VR, wearables, or mobile platforms
  • Experience developing end-to-end camera ISP pipelines designed for edge and/or distributed compute platforms
  • Experience developing for event based processing
  • Experience with depth mapping and direct time of flight (dTOF) depth measurement systems
  • Experience designing algorithms for pixel and sensor level logic

title: Credit Analyst III
description:
**If you are a current FIB employee, please apply through the Career Worklet in the Employee Portal.

This position may be located in Seattle, WA or our Spokane, WA Downtown branch.

What’s Important to You
We know your career is just one aspect of a meaningful, complex, and demanding life. That’s why we designed our compensation and benefits package to provide employees and their families with as much choice as possible.

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) in addition to paid federal holidays.
  • Student debt employer repayment program.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 6% match.
  • The health and happiness of the places we call home matter to us. Learn a little more about what we do for the communities we serve and why we want YOU to be a part of it.

We encourage you to apply. Reach for what you want and tell us why your work ethic and willingness to learn make you a natural fit for #TeamFirstInterstate.

SUMMARY
The Credit Analyst III is responsible for independently evaluating and underwriting complex commercial credits including Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Commercial and Industrial (C&I), Hospitality, Municipalities and a variety of other commercial credit types. This role involves gathering, analyzing, and interpreting personal and business financial statements, projections, and internal/external reports to assess creditworthiness, repayment capacity, and compliance with bank policies and federal regulations. Working in an independent capacity, this position partners closely with Commercial Relationship Managers to support new and existing loan relationships, emphasizing credit quality, risk mitigation, and portfolio performance. The Credit Analyst III exercises discretion and independent judgement with respect to evaluating credit risk, determining appropriate risk ratings, recommending credit structures, identifying policy exceptions, and advising management on credit-related business decisions. The role will also assist with the training, mentoring, and work review of Credit Analysts I and II.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reads, reviews, and understands various financial statements to include but not limited to; tax returns, balance sheets, profit and loss statements, agings, borrowing base certificates, debt schedules, equipment lists, credit bureau reports, rent rolls, lease agreements, and appraisals.
  • Prepares financial spreads for various types of commercial and real estate businesses, municipalities, non-profits, and individuals acting as direct obligation borrowers or guarantors.
  • Independently analyzes credit worthiness of commercial applicants and guarantors as appropriate by reviewing the loan application, spreading historical and projection based financial statements, calculating cash flows, leverage, and liquidity ratios, evaluating collateral, conducting research on the borrower(s) and key industries, and identifying risks.
  • Analyzes findings and authors a comprehensive report of analysis using a mix of data analysis (charts, formulas, graphs, etc.) and written narrative.
  • Exercises discretion and independent judgement in identifying, evaluating, and mitigating credit risk.
  • Determines appropriate risk ratings and develops recommendations regarding credit approval, modification, renewal, or denial.
  • Possesses proficiency relative to credit transactions and analytical skills sufficient to enable independent underwriting and evaluation of commercial requests for streamlined to complex requests with limited guidance from immediate manager.
  • Performs special projects related to credit administration, portfolio management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensures compliance to applicable regulations and keeps up to date with changes in federal regulations and FIB credit policy requirements.
  • Serves as an Anchor Analyst in the bank’s mentorship program, mentoring and developing junior analysts, sharing specialized credit expertise, and influencing underwriting quality and consistency throughout the organization.
  • Assists the Relationship Manager in the preparation of reports for quarterly monitoring of classified and criticized commercial relationships.
  • Completes financial performance metric covenant testing utilizing prepared financial spreads.
  • Portfolio management as assigned.
  • Participates in a quality control program that provides for the monthly review of general forms, spreads, and analysis with the provision of feedback and mentoring.
  • Participates in the production and development of training materials and assists with the delivery of training through various channels.
  • Partakes in a mentorship program with lower-level analysts to assist in guidance and the overall development of credit acumen.
  • Acts as a resource for Relationship Managers and other analysts for questions relating to Loan Policy, loan structuring, and underwriting recommendations.


QUALIFICATIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Strong organization and time management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal skills.
  • Able to develop and maintain internal and external relationships with individuals such as Relationship Managers, Credit Officers, and Risk Management Personnel.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment, set priorities, and establish and meet strict deadlines with the flexibility to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Self-motivated and possess the ability to assist with credit risk decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as an attention to detail.
  • Able to prioritize and work with others in an integrated way to achieve individual objectives and team results with flexibility to adapt to changing volumes, requirements, and areas of focus.
  • Possesses proficiency relative to credit transactions and analytical skills sufficient to enable underwriting of commercial requests for streamlined to complex requests, with limited guidance from immediate manager.Ability to make independent assessments and provide support for credit actions based on analysis and interpretation of Credit Policy.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Able to acclimate quickly to other programs.


EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, or related field preferred
  • 7-9 years of banking experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience required and
  • Experience with financial spread software required and
  • Commercial banking experience preferred


PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT
The physical demands and work environment are representative of those that must be met or encountered to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the company provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer.

  • Dexterity of hands/fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse - Frequently
  • Sitting - Frequently
  • Standing - Occasionally
  • Noise Level - Moderate
  • Typical Work Hours - M-F (8-5)
  • Regular and Predictable Attendance - Required


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
We offer a competitive total compensation package including base salary and benefits. The anticipated pay range for this position is $67,870 to $105,270 per year in Spokane and $74,040 to $114,840 in Seattle and depends on a variety of non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience, education, and geographic location. Additionally, this role is eligible to receive annual discretionary cash and stock bonuses. Benefits available for this position include, but are not limited to, medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability benefits and life insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, employee assistance program, 401(k), Paid Time Off (new hires accrue at .069 per hours worked which equates to approximately 18 days per year inclusive of paid sick time) and up to 11 paid Federal holidays.
