title: Senior Business Consultant, Sophis
description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.




Job Description – Functional Consultant, Sophis Invest

Keywords: Asset Management, Sophis, Managed Services, Functional, Finance

Teciem is looking for a Functional Consultant to join our Professional Services CoE team and help leading financial institutions get the most from Sophis and Sophis Invest. In this role, you will work on meaningful client projects, deepen your business and technical expertise, and contribute directly to the delivery of high-value services across the professional services team.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, working close to clients, and becoming a trusted expert on Sophis solutions. You will use your hands-on experience to improve customer satisfaction, support successful delivery, and build specialist expertise in a high-impact consulting environment.

Company and Business Unit background

Teciem offers a stimulating environment where you can challenge yourself, strengthen both your technology and business skills, and grow your career through real project exposure. You can expect development opportunities, recognition for your individual and team contribution, the chance to travel within Europe and beyond, and a collaborative atmosphere with supportive colleagues.

This is a unique opportunity to join a world-leading, multi-awarded company and work alongside some very strong professionals in our industry. You will be mentored by leading Sophis experts, contribute to major technology and business transformation initiatives, and play an integral role in shaping the next phase of our solutions and services.

Why join us: This role offers the opportunity to become a specialist in Sophis and Sophis Invest, work with high-profile financial services clients, collaborate with experienced consultants and technical experts, and contribute to projects that combine technology, finance, and client impact.

Summary

Reporting to the Lead Functional Consultant, the Functional Consultant will help clients implement, operate, and improve Sophis and Sophis Invest solutions. We are looking to fill multiple positions, each specializing in various aspects of the role:

  • Front Office & pricing
  • Or Middle office and settlement
  • Or Back Office / Operations
  • Or Accounting

The role combines delivery, solution design, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, including but not limited to:

- Analyze customers’ current business processes and scenarios.

- Specify, present and configure business processes and best practices for customers during Fusion Invest implementations

- Provide functional configuration, and work practices recommendations and/or solution suggest to customers during project implementations

- Support customers in functional requests or issues within the solution

- Be part of special assignments such as performance optimization or seamless integration

Core Competencies

· Customer centric and good customer management skills

· Solid interpersonal, communication and presentation skills

· Committed to providing excellent client service

· Troubleshooting and problem-solving mindset and investigation methodology

· Ability to manage priorities and manage time efficiently

· Flexibility and innovation openness

  • Ability and willingness to leverage company-approved AI technologies responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and knowledge sharing in daily work

· Team player

  • A strong desire to build domain knowledge, develop trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, and deliver high-quality outcomes with a practical, results-focused mindset

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

- Minimum 5 years experience

· A degree in computer science or equivalent work experience

  • Extensive market knowledge of capital markets, investment management, asset management and financial services in general.

· Knowledge of several financial processes (trading, back office, market making, reconciliation…) is a plus

· Previous experience or internship with a financial agent (software editor, bank, asset manager…) is a plus

· Outstanding relationship management and communication skills

· Regular user of MS Excel, and proficient technical skills in technologies such as SQL (on Oracle), XML/XSLT

· Understand the software development lifecycle (SDLC)

· Ability to travel and work on customers’ location when required




Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:

We select candidates based on skills, knowledge, qualifications, and experience and aim to support all our team members to reach their potential. At Forvis Mazars, we promote an environment in which you can grow your skills, belong to a team that values your ideas, and make an impact that matters.

This is a hybrid position based in Bangalore, India. No regular business travel is required for this role.

title: Thai Language Transcription Expert
description:
Join our team as an Independent Contractor for Project Lupin.

Project Lupin aims to help improve AI-powered speech recognition models.

In this project, participants contribute by checking and modifying the audio segmentation and transcription. The transcriptions generated will contribute to the development of improved AI-powered speech recognition models.

Project Benefits

  • Flexible hours – Work on your own schedule
  • Remote – Work from anywhere
  • Fair pay globally – Always above minimum wage in your market
  • Scalable earnings – The more you work, the more you earn

Task Summary

You will listen to real audio recordings and produce precise, verbatim transcripts — capturing not just what was said, but how it was said. That means every “uh,” every repeated word, and every trailing sentence matters. Your work will include:

  • Verbatim transcription with a target of 98%+ accuracy
  • Timestamping segments with less than 500ms deviation
  • Speaker labeling for conversations with 2 to 8 participants
  • Event annotation for non-speech elements (e.g., laughter, background noise, unintelligible audio)

Requirements

  • Native-level fluency in Thai, including familiarity with regional accents and informal speech
  • Strong listening comprehension and attention to detail.
  • Ability to produce verbatim transcriptions, including stutters, repetitions, and filler words.
  • Experience in transcription, annotation, or linguistics is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using browser-based tools (training will be provided).
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Access to a laptop or desktop computer (mobile devices are not supported).
  • Reliable availability for minimum 10+ hours per week.

Please Note

This project follows a first-come, first-served approach and operates with demographic quotas to ensure fair and balanced representation across all participant groups. As a result, some individuals may not receive a task assignment if their group has already been filled.

This role is a project-based opportunity with CrowdGen, where you will join the CrowdGen Community as an Independent Contractor. If selected, you will receive an email from CrowdGen regarding the creation of an account using your application email address. You will need to log in to this account and reset the password, complete the setup requirements, and proceed with your application for this project-based role.

Join us in shaping the future of voice AI. Your participation in Project Lupin will directly help improve how technology understands and responds to real human speech.

Job Description:

This recruitment will be used to fill one part-time (a maximum of 24 hours per week) Undergraduate Student Laboratory Assistant position for the Presley Lab at Oregon State University (OSU).

The Presley Lab is a wood biodeterioration laboratory in the Department of Wood Science and Engineering at Oregon State University. We study how wood decays and how to keep it from decaying. Our core question is a practical one: how do we extend the service life of utility poles and other in-service wood products by preventing decay caused by wood-rotting fungi?


To answer it, we work across natural durability, traditional and alternative chemical preservatives, and the environmental conditions that drive decay. That work draws on wood science, chemistry, and mycology, and it ranges from benchtop assays to long-term field trials. We also study the ecology of the fungal communities that colonize wood, so a student in our lab will see both the applied and the basic-science sides of the problem.


We are hiring a student laboratory assistant to join our team. The position is part-time (15–24 hours/week) during the Fall, Winter, and Spring terms. Students who are a good fit for the lab will have the opportunity to move to full-time (40 hours/week) work during the Summer term. Based on summer performance and available funding, part-time work (up to 24 hours/week) may continue through the following academic year.


The work is a mix of laboratory and field tasks. Field work makes up a larger share of the job during the summer months.


This is a hands-on position. You will learn sterile technique, fungal culturing, molecular identification, wood sample preparation, mechanical testing, and utility pole inspection, and you will contribute directly to ongoing graduate student and faculty research.

Position Duties

  • Operate common laboratory equipment, including microscopes, balances, fume hoods, laminar flow hoods, and data-collection systems, in support of project goals
  • Apply proper sterile techniques in a microbiology laboratory, prepare and sterilize samples and materials using an autoclave, prepare growth media for culturing fungi from wood/environmental samples, and isolate pure fungal cultures.
  • Prepare wood samples for testing, including cutting and grinding with power tools (band saw, chop saw, Wiley mill, etc.), wash glassware, perform general laboratory cleaning and maintenance, and run errands for the lab
  • Handle hazardous chemicals and materials (chemically treated wood, wood-treating formulations etc.)
  • Identify fungi using molecular methods = Extract, amplify, clean, and prepare DNA for sequencing from both pure cultures and environmental samples (wood and soil)
  • Maintain our field sites (mowing, string trimming, weed pulling, and similar site upkeep)
  • Sample and inspect in-service utility poles (decay assessments, increment coring, and related field measurements)

Transferable Skill Development

OSU is committed to ensuring students are prepared for success after graduation through intentional skill development as student employees. The competencies students develop while working at OSU are defined by the National Association of Colleges and Employers (NACE) as the essential skills employers seek in their hires. In this position, students learn and build vital career-readiness skills in the primary areas below:

  • Teamwork, Technology, Professionalism

    • Undergraduate international student: 12 credit hours per term*

    • Graduate international student officially admitted to Graduate School: 9 credit hours per term*


*International students may be allowed to carry fewer hours than specified above and still be considered “full-time” by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS). A reduced course load is approved by the Office of International Services (OIS), and must be provided to the Student Employment Center.


Required

  • Organized, with strong attention to detail

  • Able to problem-solve and work independently from written or verbal protocols
  • Eager to learn new laboratory methods and techniques

This position requires driving a University vehicle or a personal vehicle on behalf of the University; therefore, the incumbent must successfully complete a Motor Vehicle History Check, possess and maintain a current, valid driver's license in their state of residence, be determined to be position qualified and self-report convictions (as per Voluntary and Compulsory Driver Standards OSU Standard 125-155-0200) as per OSU Standard 576-056-0000 et seq.

title: Lead AI Engineer - Conversational AI & Semantic Search (Databricks / LangChain)
description:
We are seeking a Lead AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy an AI-powered chatbot/agent on Databricks, similar in architecture to an existing internal tool (LangGraph/LangChain orchestration + vector database semantic search) but applied to a new business use case. The ideal candidate can work independently, reverse-engineer/inherit concepts from prior implementations, and own the solution from prototype through production deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build a conversational AI / agentic application using LangChain and/or LangGraph, deployed on Databricks
  • Implement semantic search / retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using vector embeddings and a vector database (e.g., Databricks Vector Search, Chroma, Pinecone, FAISS)
  • Define and tune similarity-matching logic (embedding models, distance metrics, thresholding, ranking of "% match" style results)
  • Integrate with data sources (Databricks Unity Catalog tables, Delta Lake, APIs) to source and prepare the underlying knowledge base/corpus
  • Own the ML/LLMOps lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, versioning, deployment, and monitoring of the chatbot in production
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate a new use case into technical requirements
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented Python code and establish testing and CI/CD practices for the AI application
  • Ensure appropriate handling of data privacy, access control, and cost management (token usage, compute)

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software/ML engineering experience, with at least 1 year working directly with LLM-based applications
  • Proficiency in Python, including building, debugging, and refactoring production-grade code
  • Expertise in LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and/or LangGraph, including agent design, chains, tool calling, and state/memory management
  • Skills in vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search, including generating embeddings, indexing them in a vector store, and implementing similarity search or RAG retrieval
  • Familiarity with the Databricks platform, including notebooks, jobs, clusters, and Unity Catalog
  • Experience calling and prompt-engineering against LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Azure OpenAI
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with limited handoff documentation and ambiguous requirements
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps tooling such as MLflow, model/prompt versioning, and evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs
  • Background in API/backend development using FastAPI, Flask, or similar, for exposing the chatbot as a service
  • Familiarity with front-end/chat interface integration, wiring a backend agent to a chat UI

Benefits

  • Work on a flexible schedule remotely or from any of our comfortable offices or coworking spaces in Ukraine
  • Receive the necessary equipment to perform your work tasks

  • Gain experience in various business domains (Insurance, E-commerce, Healthcare, Finance, Travelling, Media, Artificial Intelligence, and more)

Job Summary:

Care Partners are responsible for meeting the basic needs of patients by providing skilled levels of bedside patient care under the direction of the Registered Nurse. Care Partners also perform clerical duties necessary to the functioning of the nursing unit.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES AND PERFORMANCE CRITERIA (% of Time)

Essential Functions: The following are essential job accountabilities and performance criteria:

1) General Patient Care:

Criteria

A) Carries out the patient’s plan of care as it relates to the patient’s physical needs under the direction of the Registered Nurse.

B) Delivers care requiring broad knowledge of aseptic technique, medical terminology and equipment.

C) Assists nurses and physicians with procedures.

D) Maintains knowledge of and operates equipment used in patient care safely.

E) Retrieves patient care items that are not routinely available on the unit.

F) Retrieves, recovers or follows up on patient care needs.

G) Completed unit clerical duties including the coordination of designated unit activities, transcription of orders, medical record maintenance and serving as a unit receptionist.

H) Prepares rooms prior to admissions and following discharges. Completes patient’s belongings list on admission and transfer.

I) Directs prompt and courteous attention to the needs of patients, families, and visitors.

J) Rounds with purpose.

K) Engages in service recovery activities referring unusual problems to Nurse Manager/ Designate.

L) Rounds after dietary trays are passed to ensure all meals are appropriate or as required for patient satisfaction /care needs.

M) Takes appropriate action when necessary including the resolution of issues related to late or wrong trays.

N) Feeds and sets up trays as needed.

O) Recognizes needs and initiates appropriate action in regard to maintaining supplies and equipment

P) Notifies appropriate department in order to maintain a clean safe environment (housekeeping, maintenance, dietary, etc.)

Q) Functions as a resource person to co-workers, patients/families, medical staff, and ancillary personnel.

2) Safety and Comfort

Criteria

A) Correctly places restraints; observes for constriction of circulation, changes to skin integrity, adequate breathing; knows when and how to change position; provides range of motion (ROM) and skin care, toileting, and opportunities for socialization.

B) Operates Cardiac Monitor i.e.

1. On/off switch

2. Alarms/stand-by

3. Obtaining strip

4. Lead placement

3) Vital Signs/Measurement

Criteria

A) Completes Point of Care Testing as approved by hospital and competency

B) Obtains vital signs including temperature

C) Measures abdominal girth

D) Weighs patients

E) Measures intake and output

4) Mobility and Exercise:

Criteria

A) Applies Pneumatic Air Stockings / Ted Hose

B) Ambulates, turns and positions patients.

5) Respiratory Care

Criteria

A) Assists with incentive spirometry and cough / deep breath.

B) Sets up oxygen therapy such as, nasal cannula or mask as directed by Registered Nurse.

C) Monitors pulse oximetry

D) Completes tracheostomy care

E) Performs suctioning

1. Oral

2. Tracheal: When the patient is assessed by the Registered Nurse to be stable.

6) Wound Care

Criteria

A) Places patient on specialty bed

B) Performs dressing changes (sterile and clean)

C) Cares for pin care site after assessment has been completed by the Registered Nurse. Assists in monitoring that traction weights are hanging freely and in good alignment.

7) Bowel and Bladder Elimination

Criteria

A) Administers enemas

B) Performs straight catheterization. Provides catheter care.

8) Hygiene

Criteria

A) Provides:

1. Hygiene and grooming daily

2. Mouth care (including dentures) at least twice/day.

3. Fresh water at 0800, 1600, 2400 and as needed

4. Perineal care

5. Toileting

9) Specimen Collection

Criteria

A) Obtains:

1. Midstream (clean-voided) urine specimen.

2. Timed urine specimen

3. Sterile urine specimen from an indwelling catheter

4. Urine specific gravity (5 South and 5 ICU only)

5. Urine pH

6. Expectorated sputum specimens

7. Blood specimens by venipuncture

8. Stool specimens

10) Clerical

Criteria

A) Answers phone within 3 rings identifying self, title and nursing unit. Does not keep person on hold for extended periods.

B) Provides directions to physicians, hospital personnel, and visitors to patient’s room.

C) Notifies the physician and nursing staff of new patient’s arrival to unit.

D) Assists in the receiving of articles brought to the nursing unit.

E) Answers pneumatic tube promptly and returns carriers to the appropriate area.

F) Prepares a daily worksheet and confirms all appointments concerning daily work (including blood work) and updates worksheet on each shift.

G) Verifies census sheet, maintains and updates as necessary.

H) Informs Admitting Department of all transfers, discharges, admissions, room changes, and deaths through the computer. Includes disposition of appropriate paperwork.

I) Informs staff/charge nurses / nurse manager of nursing unit activities: return of patients to the floor, physician stat orders, new admissions, etc.

J) Assist nursing staff and ancillary personnel to ensure appropriate and complete specimen labels/requisition orders.

K) Reports critical lab values to appropriate personnel.

L) Initiates and completes secretarial portion of the pre-op checklist.

M) Completes the administrative data screen for all new admissions and updates daily.

N) Assists the nursing staff with paperwork involved in the patient transfer and discharge procedure to include movement of medications.

O) Gives a full report to the oncoming person. (Leaves a written report if unable to give verbal). Informs the Charge Nurse if additional orders are left for the night shift.

P) Checks patient chart periodically throughout the shift for “stat”, flagged and un-flagged orders.

Q) Checks physician orders daily for unsigned verbal/telephone orders and places appropriate flag.

R) Enters orders into the computer accurately.

S) Calls departments to order tests, procedures, and consults which cannot be ordered through the computer.

T) Transcribes orders for tests/procedures/consults onto the TESTS/PROCEDURES section of the profile.

U) Ensures labels are correctly placed on all forms

V) Transcribes medication orders to the medication administration record accurately.

W) Places all physician orders in pharmacy bin. Faxes all physician orders to pharmacy during night shift.

X) Signs orders to indicate orders were taken off with date, time, signature and title

Y) Utilizes appropriate backup systems in the event of computer downtime.

Z) Ensures that stat and timed orders are transcribed promptly.

AA) Initiates and assembles charts

BB) Keeps chart in order; thins chart as needed and places in appropriate file.

CC) Obtains old charges from Medical Records through the computer.

B) Maintains a safe, clean, comfortable, and therapeutic environment for patients / families / employees in accordance to hospital standards.

1. Maintains clutter free environment.

2. Keeps personal conversations/background noise to a minimum.

10. Orientation competency (if new hire)

11. Unit Specific

E) Obtains report from Registered Nurse and informs nurse of changes in patient’s condition.

F) Communicates concerns or patient complaints to Registered Nurse and other team members as appropriate.

G) Documents all procedures and care concisely and legibly on chart forms according to chart form guidelines.

J) Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.

1. Provides prompt, respectful, courteous service.

B) Participates in additional learning experiences to increase competence including:

Standard (I understand that…)

Standard (I understand that…)

Expectations (So I will…)

  • Introduce myself to all my patients and family members.

title: Public Sector Hunter
description:
Vill du vara med och driva utvecklingen mot ett mer suveränt, säkert och europeiskt digitalt landskap?

Cleura söker nu en Public Sector Hunter, en kommersiellt driven och relationsorienterad affärsutvecklare som vill ta ansvar för att identifiera, utveckla och vinna nya affärer inom svensk offentlig sektor.

Om Cleura

Cleura är Det Europeiska Molnet, en svensk/europeisk molnleverantör med fokus på säker, compliant och suverän digital infrastruktur.

Cleuras molnplattformar bygger på öppen källkod och OpenStack och omfattar Public Cloud, Compliant Cloud och Private Cloud. Erbjudandet riktar sig bland annat till organisationer med höga krav på säkerhet, regelefterlevnad, dataskydd och kontroll över sin data.

För offentlig sektor är erbjudandet särskilt relevant i takt med att frågor kring digital suveränitet, säkerhet, datalagring, regelefterlevnad och beroendet av globala hyperscalers får allt större betydelse.

Nu vill vi ta nästa steg.

Om rollen

Som Public Sector Hunter får du ett tydligt kommersiellt ansvar för att utveckla Cleuras position och nykundsaffär inom svensk offentlig sektor.

Du kommer att arbeta med kommuner, regioner och myndigheter samt med det ekosystem av partners och leverantörer som påverkar hur offentlig IT utvecklas och upphandlas.

Din uppgift blir inte enbart att bearbeta befintliga leads. Du ska skapa marknad, bygga relationer, identifiera affärsmöjligheter och driva komplexa affärer från första kontakt till vunnen affär.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Identifiera och bearbeta nya strategiska kunder inom kommun, region och stat
  • Bygga långsiktiga relationer med CIO:er, IT-chefer, digitaliseringsansvariga, verksamhetsansvariga och andra relevanta beslutsfattare
  • Identifiera behov och affärsmöjligheter innan de blir formella upphandlingar
  • Driva komplexa och längre säljprocesser med flera beslutsfattare och intressenter
  • Navigera i offentlig upphandling och förstå hur ramavtal, avrop och upphandlingsstrategier påverkar affären
  • Utveckla Cleuras position hos strategiska kunder och skapa en tydlig pipeline
  • Arbeta nära Cleuras tekniska och kommersiella organisation för att utveckla rätt kundlösningar
  • Identifiera och utveckla affärer tillsammans med systemintegratörer, MSP:er, SaaS-bolag och andra strategiska partners
  • Bygga och utveckla relationer inom det offentliga IT-ekosystemet
  • Delta i kunddialoger, workshops och strategiska möten på både affärsmässig och teknisk nivå
  • Ansvara för hela den kommersiella processen från prospektering till avtal

Vi söker dig som kan offentlig sektor på riktigt

Vi söker dig som redan har erfarenhet av att göra affärer med offentlig sektor och förstår hur marknaden fungerar.

Du har sannolikt:

  • Minst 7–10 års relevant erfarenhet av försäljning mot offentlig sektor
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av affärer med kommuner, regioner och/eller statliga myndigheter
  • Ett etablerat nätverk inom svensk offentlig sektor
  • God förståelse för offentlig upphandling, LOU, ramavtal och avropsmodeller
  • Erfarenhet av längre och komplexa säljcykler
  • Erfarenhet av att sälja IT, molntjänster, infrastruktur, cybersäkerhet, managed services eller närliggande tjänster
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med större organisationer och flera beslutsnivåer
  • Förmåga att förstå både kundens verksamhetsbehov och den underliggande IT-infrastrukturen
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med partners och ekosystem, exempelvis systemintegratörer, konsultbolag eller andra teknikleverantörer

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av cloud, IaaS/PaaS, cybersäkerhet, dataskydd, digital suveränitet eller verksamhetskritisk IT.

Du är en Hunter, men du förstår att stora affärer byggs över tid

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara genuint nykundsorienterad

Du trivs med att öppna dörrar som inte redan står öppna. Du är uthållig och strukturerad och kan arbeta med en affär långt innan det finns en konkret upphandling.

Du vet samtidigt när det är dags att vara kommersiellt offensiv och när det är viktigare att bygga förtroende och position.

Du är bekväm med att själv driva dina affärer men förstår också värdet av att skapa rätt team runt kunden.

Du behöver därför kunna växla mellan:

Hunter → Relationsbyggare → Affärsutvecklare → Förhandlare → Partner

Du förstår det offentliga ekosystemet

Vad Cleura erbjuder

Hos Cleura får du möjlighet att arbeta med en produkt och en positionering som ligger mitt i några av de viktigaste frågorna inom svensk och europeisk IT: digital suveränitet, säkerhet, compliance och kontroll över data.

Du får arbeta med en modern molnplattform baserad på OpenStack och öppen källkod, tillsammans med ett växande ekosystem av partners och tekniska specialister.

Du blir en viktig del av Cleuras fortsatta expansion inom offentlig sektor och får ett stort eget mandat att påverka både kundstrategi och affärsutveckling.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi tror att du är:

  • Kommersiell och resultatorienterad
  • Nyfiken och affärsmässigt driven
  • Relationsskapande på senior nivå
  • Uthållig och strukturerad
  • Självgående med starkt eget driv
  • Trovärdig i dialog med seniora beslutsfattare
  • Prestigelös och bra på att samarbeta
  • Intresserad av teknik och samhällsutveckling
  • Trygg i komplexa affärer där vägen till avslut kan vara lång

Framför allt har du energin och erfarenheten att öppna nya dörrar inom offentlig sektor och förvandla relationer och marknadsinsikter till konkret affär.

Placering

Rollen är i första hand placerad i Stockholm/Solna, men vi är öppna för dialog kring annan placering för rätt person.

För den här rollen är närvaro och tillgänglighet i det svenska offentliga ekosystemet viktigare än exakt geografisk placering.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Låter det här som en roll för dig? Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Du kan ansöka till tjänsten fram till 1 november 2026.

Redo att ta nästa steg? Klicka då på knappen "Ansök till tjänsten" nedan för att skicka in din ansökan.

title: Senior Data Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Integration Engineer to build production data models and semantic layers that serve both business teams analyzing account health and pipeline velocity and autonomous AI agents running automated meeting preparation, account research, and relationship tracking through Snowflake Cortex and Snowflake Intelligence.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain production data models in dbt and Snowflake that track account health, engagement velocity, and customer intent signals
  • Combine structured records and unstructured interaction data (Gong call transcripts, emails, Salesforce CRM objects, and product usage telemetry) into clean account-level dimensions
  • Establish consistent modeling patterns, naming conventions, and metric definitions across GTM datasets
  • Build and maintain an enterprise semantic layer (such as the dbt Semantic Layer or MetricFlow) to eliminate conflicting metric calculations across business tools
  • Prepare clean, context-rich datasets structured for retrieval, search, and reasoning within Snowflake Cortex, Snowflake Intelligence, and internal AI agents
  • Design feature tables and context stores that power LLM agents for automated meeting prep, competitive intelligence, and account research
  • Manage metadata and data enrichment patterns so AI agents correctly interpret account stages, customer sentiment, and relationship history
  • Write automated tests, schema validations, and freshness monitors in dbt for both structured metrics and unstructured data transformations
  • Maintain data governance, role-based access controls (RBAC), and audit trails across sensitive sales pipeline and customer interaction data
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and governance teams to document data lineage and maintain clear dataset ownership
  • Work within an agile sprint cadence, contributing to backlog planning, design reviews, and technical standards
  • Deliver self-service data models and documentation that enable analysts and product teams to query data independently

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or data architecture roles
  • Proficiency in advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs, complex joins, analytical queries, and execution plan optimization
  • 3+ years of production dbt experience, including modular project structure, Jinja macros, custom tests, incremental models, and snapshots
  • Practical experience with Snowflake, including virtual warehouse sizing, query profile analysis, clustering keys, Time Travel, zero-copy cloning, and access control
  • Hands-on experience modeling B2B SaaS revenue and interaction data (Salesforce CRM, Gong, Marketo, or subscription billing data)
  • Understanding of Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions SCD 1/2/4, conformed dimensions) and semantic layer design
  • Daily comfort with Git workflows, branching strategies, code reviews, and automated CI test runs
  • Flexibility to use AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to speed up modeling work, test coverage, and documentation
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Practical experience or working familiarity with Snowflake Cortex AI functions (Cortex Search, LLM functions, embeddings)
  • Familiarity with vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for conversational text
  • Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation (Pandas), API extraction, or pipeline automation
  • Experience with metadata and lineage tools such as Alation, Collibra, DataHub, or dbt Docs
  • Experience designing data models for self-service consumption in Tableau, Looker, or Power BI

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs

title: Plant Operator III-Water
description:
Summary: Under supervision of the Water Treatment Plant Operations Supervisor, operates surface water treatment plant equipment to adequately supply a clean potable water that meets all State and Federal requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Regulates flows of raw water into treatment plant as determined by system demand without exceeding withdrawal permit requirements.
  • Performs all required process control analyses. Makes logical conclusions based on these analyses.
  • Monitors and maintains proper chemical levels in chemical feed equipment.
  • Regulates specified amounts of chemicals such as chlorine, alum, polymer, lime, phosphate, carbon, fluoride, potassium permanganate, etc. as determined by process control analysis to ensure compliance with all State and Federal water quality regulations.
  • Regulates flows through filters, equal to raw water flows to maintain proper filter levels for optimum filter performance.
  • Monitors filter head loss, turbidity and particle counts to determine proper filter backwash frequency and performs filter backwash procedures determined by Operations Supervisors, Water Production.
  • Maintains proper levels in clear-wells and storage tanks by monitoring and operation of SCADA system and equipment.
  • Calculates and enters data onto network server such as pump times, filter runs, chemicals used, psi, process control, rainfall, flow totals, etc.
  • Operates sludge siphon equipment at regular intervals as determined by Operations Supervisors, Water Production.
  • Cleans sedimentation basins and filter beds with fire hoses at regular intervals as determined by Operations Supervisors, Water Production.
  • Monitors equipment performance and reports any malfunctions to manager. Assist in repair of localized equipment and performs some minor repair.
  • Maintains calibration of chemical feeders. Prints calibration charts and places in the folder for ready access by all operators.
  • Responsible for maintenance of floors and building, taking out trash, unloading trucks, general cleaning of all equipment.
  • Makes continuous effort to improve operations and achieve plant optimization.
  • Regularly monitors and responds to treatment process changes by interpreting charts, graphs, gauges, meters and test results to determine treatment process requirements and meet water quality standards; informs supervisor, co-workers and other departments of potential problems and hazards.
  • Assists maintenance personnel in the inspection, consults on maintenance and repair of the treatment plants' equipment and facilities; performs basic preventive maintenance and servicing of equipment and facilities.
  • Calibrates, inspects and cleans chlorine residual meters, turbidity meters, particle counters and compliance instruments; maintains records of compliance instrument maintenance and calibration as required by state and federal regulations.

title: Leasing Coordinator
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Leasing Coordinator is responsible for supporting Leasing Department and FWR’s objectives, performance drivers and strategic initiatives. Additionally, the Leasing Coordinator is responsible for preparing financial analysis, leasing analysis, preparation of project reports, budget preparation/tracking, administrative duties and coordination with various levels of department strategy initiatives. The position provides a training platform with the expectation for advancement to a junior deal-making role.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for compiling and updating economic deal term analyses, letters of intent, renewal documents, pylon sign matrices, and other deal-specific documents.
  • Reviews and analyzes legal documents, such as leases, to determine Landlord’s ability to lease to prospective tenants.
  • Updates portfolio summary sheets on a quarterly basis.
  • Runs operational reports – lease profiles, sales, rent rolls, lease expiration reports, exclusives, and tenant types.
  • Strategizes with dealmaker to develop target prospect tenant lists for each center based on categories not yet served by the existing tenant base.
  • Assists in providing plans and property info to prospective tenants, as well as collection of tenant financial packages.
  • Provides market detail about tenant growth or contraction using available resources such as CreditIntel and Placer.
  • Gathers tenant financial information and provides to asset management; tracks and organizes documentation and reviews for accuracy and completeness.
  • Engages with listing broker team by maintaining listing agreements, processing commission invoices, directing brokers when brochures and site plans require updates, compiling market comp data, and tracking broker invoices and payments.
  • Attends industry events such as ICSC and webinars upon request.
  • Assists with compilation of deal package information and quality control in Salesforce/VTS software with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Prepares for annual budgeting by coordinating market comps, income summaries, project visuals, and option term research.
  • Schedules meetings with tenants, brokers, and leasing team members.
  • Performs administrative functions such as expense reimbursements and travel bookings.
  • Collaborates with marketing and leasing teams to assist in tenant outreach, providing tenants with information highlighting the features of the trade area, market, and space in order to convince prospective tenants.
  • Manages the lead-to-lease platform, including training and data support for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinates with the leasing team on special projects; development includes assisting with renewals, assignments, and learning FWR negotiation points.
  • Works with third-party landlord brokers, including tracking status of brokerage agreements.
  • Monitors periodicals and book ordering to ensure proper recording.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a finance-related field required.
  • 0-2 years of experience in leasing or related real estate discipline.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects at once with a high rate of accuracy and sense of urgency.
  • Ability to collaborate with multiple team members.
  • Strong analytical skills, highly proficient in Excel and able to create and manipulate financial investment analysis using that tool
  • Familiar with a variety of real estate industry concepts, practices, and procedures.
  • Familiar with Auto-CAD, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe PDF editor.

PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Use of a computer screen for extensive periods of time.
  • Occasional lifting up to 30 lbs.
  • Extended working hours and travel may be necessary.
  • May require the ability to remain in a stationary position

title: Senior Operations Analysis
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

The Senior Operations Analyst is a key operational excellence and business improvement resource responsible for driving process efficiency, regulatory compliance, system optimization, and continuous improvement across TransUnion Africa Operations. The role requires a highly analytical, quality-focused, and detail-oriented professional with strong administrative capabilities and a comprehensive understanding of consumer dispute regulatory requirements across South Africa, Botswana, Eswatini, Namibia, Kenya, Zambia, Rwanda, and Malawi.

The incumbent serves as the operations systems and process subject matter expert (SME), conducting advanced analysis of operational systems, processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), audit findings, regulatory observations, and business challenges. The role is responsible for proactively evaluating operational effectiveness, identifying process inefficiencies, performing root-cause analysis, and recommending practical solutions that enhance customer, user, and business outcomes.

A key responsibility is the review, development, maintenance, and governance of operational processes and SOPs to ensure alignment with business policies, regulatory obligations, control requirements, and operational standards. The Senior Operations Analyst partners with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product, Project, and Global Technology teams to translate business requirements into effective process improvements and system enhancements.

The role acts as the first point of investigation for operational system and process-related issues, conducting analysis and defining business requirements before engaging technical teams for development and implementation. The incumbent also leads user acceptance testing (UAT) activities, develops test scenarios and business test cases, and ensures operational readiness for system and process changes.

Additionally, the Senior Operations Analyst is expected to leverage data analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to identify operational improvement opportunities, reduce manual intervention, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve service delivery. Through proactive analysis and stakeholder collaboration, the role contributes significantly to operational excellence, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, and digital transformation initiatives across the Africa region.

Reporting to Sr Advisor Customer Support QA

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities


  • Operational analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct advanced analysis of operational processes, systems, controls, audit findings, and regulatory observations to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Perform root-cause analysis of operational issues and recommend effective corrective actions.
  • Proactively identify process inefficiencies, manual activities, system constraints, and operational bottlenecks affecting customer and business outcomes.
  • Drive process optimization initiatives that improve operational efficiency, service quality, customer experience, and productivity.
  • Process and SOP Governance
  • Review, develop, maintain, and enhance operational processes, SOPs, controls, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure all processes and SOPs align with business policies, operational standards, regulatory requirements, and control frameworks.
  • Support process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across operational functions.
  • Systems and Business Requirements Management.
  • Act as the Operations Systems and Process SME for business stakeholders.
  • Perform first-line investigations and business analysis of system and process issues before engagement with technical teams.
  • Gather, document, and manage business requirements, process flows, functional specifications, and operational change requests.
  • Collaborate with project and technology teams throughout the solution design, testing, and implementation lifecycle.
  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing activities for operational system enhancements and projects.
  • Develop business test cases, test scripts, test plans, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate test execution, defect management, and business sign-off activities.
  • Ensure solutions meet business requirements and operational expectations before implementation.
  • Compliance and Audit Support
  • Collaborate with the Operations Compliance Specialist to remediate audit findings, compliance observations, and regulatory requirements through process and system enhancements.
  • Ensure operational processes support compliance with consumer dispute regulations across all supported TransUnion Africa Operations.
  • Assist in evaluating control effectiveness and support ongoing compliance monitoring activities.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Track system enhancements, production issues, and defect remediation activities through to closure.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly reports on system changes, defect trends, operational improvements, and governance activities.
  • Provide management with insights and recommendations based on operational performance and analysis findings.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation, and digital technologies to improve operational performance.
  • Analyze repetitive, manual, and high-volume processes to determine automation opportunities.
  • Support business cases and requirements for technology-driven process improvements.
  • Promote innovation and continuous improvement through data-driven insights and technology enablement.

Required Knowledge And Experiences


  • Certification in Business Analysis, including experience in business management, information systems, project management and internal audit & risk.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent process improvement certification
  • 3+ years' experience in operational analysis, business analysis, process improvement, or operational excellence environments.
  • Proven experience in requirements gathering, SOP development, process optimization, UAT leadership, and systems analysis.
  • Experience supporting audit remediation, compliance initiatives, and operational transformation projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics, AI, and automation technologies to improve operational effectiveness and customer outcomes.
  • Experience investigating operational system and process issues and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  • Exposure to audit remediation, compliance monitoring, regulatory requirements, or control environments.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, including Operations, Compliance, Risk, Project, and Technology teams.
  • Experience supporting change initiatives and system implementations.
  • Understand generally accepted compliance principles and standards.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with office applications, and aptitude for learning new software and systems.
  • Intermediate excel skills (advantage)
  • Ability to create and present management reports.
  • Analytical and problem-solving attitude
  • Proactive, organized approach to multitasking
  • Strong time management

For positions based in South Africa, preference will be given to suitably qualified candidates from designated groups in line with the company’s Employment Equity plan and targets.

location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Location: New York,New York,United States

Job Title: Watchmaker

Reports to: Service Manager

Division: Retail, Rolex Flagship

OVERVIEW

The Watchmaker serves as the in-store technical authority for all aspects of mechanical performance, diagnostics, and service quality at the Rolex 5th Avenue flagship. This role provides expert evaluation, advanced technical intervention when required, and final quality assurance to ensure every timepiece meets Rolex’s exacting standards before being returned to the client. The Watchmaker supports Service and Client Advisors with authoritative technical insight, enhances the client experience through clear and confident communication, and upholds the highest levels of craftsmanship, precision, and brand integrity within the service environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Support & Technical Authority

· Serve as the in-store technical expert, supporting Client and Service Advisors by providing authoritative guidance on mechanical function, condition, and required services.

· Perform advanced technical assessments when a watch requires evaluation beyond the scope of a Technician, including diagnosing movement irregularities, complication performance, lubrication issues, escapement behavior, and abnormal rate deviation.

· When requested, participate in client-facing moments to explain technical findings, educate clients on proper care, and reinforce the brand’s high standards of craftsmanship and service.

Movement-Level Service Capability

· Execute complete mechanical overhauls in accordance with Rolex standards, including disassembly, inspection, cleaning, lubrication, reassembly, adjustment, and casing.

· Perform intermediate movement interventions as required.

· Conduct post-service regulation and precision adjustments using approved timing instrumentation.

In-Store Technical Work & Quality Control

· Oversee and perform advanced in-store maintenance tasks when required, including water-resistance testing using Rolex-approved equipment, case and bracelet preparation, and final functional checks.

· Carry out comprehensive quality control evaluations on watches serviced off-site or internally by Technicians, confirming compliance with Rolex quality control standards.

· Serve as the final technical sign-off for repairs prior to client delivery.

Technical Oversight & Team Collaboration

· Provide guidance to Technicians on diagnostic approach, proper tool usage, contamination avoidance, and brand-approved technical procedures.

· Support ongoing training efforts by sharing best practices, demonstrating proper techniques, and reinforcing Rolex service standards.

Tools, Equipment & Compliance

· Maintain personal and shared watchmaking tools in excellent condition, ensuring calibration accuracy and adherence to Rolex tooling requirements.

· Uphold a clean, organized, and secure workshop environment that meets Rolex safety, cleanliness, and process standards.

· Ensure all service actions follow Rolex-approved procedures, documentation rules, and quality guidelines.

· Monitoring parts usage, evaluating when parts must be replaced, and maintaining an organized and accurate inventory system to support efficient service workflows.

q

QUALIFICATIONS

· Formal watchmaking training (CW21, SAWTA, WOSTEP, or equivalent) or comparable professional bench experience; Rolex certification preferred or willingness to obtain.

· Strong technical proficiency in mechanical watch repair, diagnostics, regulation, and quality control, with a commitment to continuous development.

· Ability to deliver meticulous, detail-oriented work while adhering to Rolex service standards, tooling requirements, and documentation practices.

· Professionalism and confidence in occasional client-facing interactions, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly when needed.

· Collaborative mindset with a willingness to support, guide, and mentor Technicians, and contribute to a positive team culture.

· Flexibility to work a retail-aligned schedule and thrive in a fast-paced flagship environment while maintaining a high standard of craftsmanship.

Compensation: $80,000 - $110,000 commensurate upon experience

title: Clinical Documentation Specialist - First Reviewer (H)
description:
It's more than a career, it's a calling.

Job Summary:

Performs concurrent analytical reviews of clinical and coding data to improving physician documentation for all conditions and treatments from point of entry to discharge, ensuring an accurate reflection of the patient condition in the associated Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) assignments, case-mix index, severity of illness (SOI), and risk of mortality (ROM) profiling, and reimbursement. Facilitates the resolution of queries and educates members of the patient care team regarding documentation guidelines and the need for accurate and complete documentation in the health record, including attending physicians and allied health practitioners. Collaborates with coding professionals to ensure accuracy of diagnostic and procedural data and completeness of supporting documentation to determine a working and final DRG, SOI, and/or ROM.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Completes initial reviews of patient records and evaluates documentation to assign the principal diagnosis, pertinent secondary diagnoses, and procedures for accurate diagnosis review group (DRG) assignment, risk of mortality (ROM), and severity of illness (SOI). Maintains appropriate productivity level.
  • Conducts follow-up reviews of patients every to support and assign a working or final DRG assignment upon patient discharge, as necessary.
  • Queries physicians regarding missing, unclear, or conflicting health record documentation by requesting and obtaining additional documentation within the health record when needed. Identifies issues with reporting of diagnostic testing proactively. Enhances expertise in query development, presentation, and standards including understanding of published query guidelines and practice expectations for compliance.
  • Educates physicians and key healthcare providers regarding clinical documentation improvement and the need for accurate and complete documentation in the health record.
  • Attends department meetings to review documentation related issues. Conducts independent research to promote knowledge of clinical topics, coding guidelines, regulatory policies and trends, and healthcare economics.
  • Collaborates with coding to reconcile the DRG and resolves mismatches utilizing the escalation policy. Troubleshoots documentation or communication problems proactively and appropriately escalates.
  • Reviews and clarifies clinical issues in the health record with the coding professionals that would support an accurate DRG assignment, SOI, and/or ROM. Assists in the mortality review and risk adjustment process utilizing third-party models.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of complications, comorbidities, SOI, ROM, case mix, and the impact of procedures on the billed record. Imparts knowledge to providers and other members of the healthcare team. Maintains a level of expertise by attending continuing education programs.
  • Applies the existing body of evidence-based practice and scientific knowledge in health care to nursing practice, ensuring that nursing care is delivered based on patient’s age-specific needs and clinical needs as described in the department's scope of service.

title: Clinical Specialist Radiographer Diagnostic - MRI
description:
Role: Clinical Specialist Radiographer – MRI

Location: The Harley Street Clinic & The Princess Grace Hospital, Central London

Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week between Monday-Friday
Shift times: The service runs from 08:00am to 8:00pm and we can consider three, four or five day shift patterns

Contract type: Permanent

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience, plus fantastic benefits, including private healthcare.


We have an exciting opportunity for a Clinical Specialist MRI Radiographer to join our Imaging team across The Princess Grace Hospital and The Harley Street Clinic, currently rated “Outstanding” by the CQC. These prestigious sites are known for complex care, clinical depth and close multidisciplinary working. From advanced oncology imaging to specialist cardiology work, colleagues here support some of the most intricate patient pathways in private healthcare, delivering care with consistency, compassion and clinical confidence.


As a Clinical Specialist Radiographer in MRI, you’ll be part of a highly experienced team working across a large, dynamic campus environment. The department is equipped with nine Siemens MRI scanners, including three 3.0T and six 1.5T systems, supporting a broad and challenging caseload.

Day to day, you’ll combine expert clinical practice with leadership influence, supporting service delivery, shaping protocols and contributing to a five‑star patient experience.


At HCA UK we care about what you care about. We care that you want to deliver the very best care. We care that you want a career you can be proud of. We care that you want working conditions that support your health and wellbeing. Let us care for you and your career, the same way you do for others.


What you’ll do:

  • Provide a safe, effective and high‑quality MRI service, maintaining excellent clinical standards at all times
  • Work closely with Radiologists and Consultants to develop and review imaging protocols and patient pathways
  • Support the day‑to‑day running of the MRI service, identifying and implementing service improvements with the line manager
  • Contribute to patient scheduling and administrative processes to ensure timely, accurate reporting
  • Support the orientation and development of colleagues, sharing specialist knowledge and expertise

What you’ll bring:

  • HCPC registration as a Radiographer
  • Extensive post‑graduate MRI experience, ideally gained within the UK
  • Strong understanding of MRI clinical governance, safety and protocol development
  • Competent in IV cannulation
  • The confidence to work at specialist level within a complex clinical environment

Why HCA UK?
Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.


We believe that by caring for our colleagues, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Clinical Specialist Radiographer within MRI you’ll be eligible for:


  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values
At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.


Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:


  • Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
  • Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
  • Honesty, integrity and fairness: We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
  • Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments
We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

Clear Sky Touch är en unik kvalitetsprodukt med en av marknadens bästa garantier och är en portabel luftrenare med flera funktioner. Den har funnits på marknaden i över 25 år och säljs idag i 49 länder över hela världen.

title: Staff Network Systems Engineer - Network Automation & DevOps
description:
Job Description

Ireland, Dublin

Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview

We're looking for a Staff Network Systems Engineer to help drive the transition of our global network infrastructure from manually managed and inconsistent configurations to a standardised, version-controlled and increasingly automated operating model.

This hands-on staff-level individual contributor will establish Infrastructure as Code practices, reusable automation, automated validation and safe delivery pipelines. The role will reduce configuration drift, make changes repeatable and auditable, and help the wider team adopt modern software-engineering practices.

Working across network engineering, security, architecture and platform teams, you'll help frame and influence technical direction, create practical standards and guardrails, and remain actively involved in enterprise network engineering and operational delivery.

What you'll be doing:
  • Assess the network estate, toolchain and operational workflows; identify sources of configuration variance, manual effort and change risk; and help define a phased modernisation roadmap.
  • Establish the Infrastructure as Code operating model, including the authoritative source of truth, configuration standards, source control, peer review, testing, release governance and secure handling of credentials.
  • Build reusable automation using object-oriented or comparable programming languages such as Python and Go (Golang), together with Terraform, Ansible, APIs and configuration-management tooling.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines with automated linting, testing, intended-state validation, drift detection, policy checks, approvals, controlled rollout and reliable rollback patterns.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture and security teams to translate network intent into version-controlled implementations and influence reference architectures, standards, lifecycle plans and service roadmaps.
  • Lead the safe migration of existing services into the automated model while remaining hands-on during complex delivery, business-as-usual operations, critical changes, troubleshooting and major incidents.
  • Participate in technical authority and design-review forums, mentor engineers, and ensure automation becomes a sustainable team capability rather than knowledge held by a single specialist.
What we are looking for:
  • A strong track record of modernising network infrastructure through automation or Infrastructure as Code in a large, complex production environment.
  • Strong software-engineering skills in object-oriented or comparable programming languages such as Python and Go (Golang), including maintainable code, structured data, API integration, testing, error handling and documentation.
  • Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible or comparable tooling, including reusable, idempotent automation components and controlled infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of Git, pull-request workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release controls, policy enforcement and secrets management.
  • Deep enterprise networking knowledge across routing, switching, wireless, resilient design, network access control and secure remote connectivity, together with advanced Juniper Mist, EX Series and Junos experience or equivalent platform expertise.
  • Expert troubleshooting and engineering judgement, with experience supporting operational delivery, complex changes, major incidents and root-cause improvement.
  • Staff-level influence and communication skills, including shaping technical direction across teams, building consensus, contributing to governance forums and developing other engineers.
  • Network APIs and data models, including REST, NETCONF, RESTCONF, JSON, YAML and YANG-based workflows.
  • GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, automated policy enforcement, artefact management and developer enablement.
  • Azure or AWS networking, enterprise authentication, Zero Trust principles and network observability platforms.
  • Architecture governance, technical authority panels, strategic vendor engagement and globally delivered service operations.
  • High-availability gaming, digital-media, creative or similarly demanding production environments.
Work Expectations and Measures of Success

This is a staff-level role combining hands-on engineering with technical leadership across a global network environment. You'll build production automation, guide others and remain engaged with operational delivery. The objective is to establish an engineering system the team can operate and improve over time while maintaining secure, resilient and supportable network services.

Success will be demonstrated through:
  • Increased coverage of network infrastructure managed through version-controlled automation.
  • Reduced configuration drift, manual intervention, operational toil and dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
  • Shorter and more predictable change lead times, with improved auditability, validation and rollback confidence.
  • Lower change-failure rates, maintained service reliability and faster recovery from configuration-related incidents.
  • Sustained adoption of automation standards, modules and delivery practices across the wider engineering team.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

Use of AI in Recruiting

We use artificial intelligence and other automated tools to assist with certain aspects of our recruiting process, including reviewing applications and supporting candidate evaluation. For example, we use Greenhouse's AI-powered Talent Matching tool to compare information in your application against job-related qualifications and criteria established by our recruiting team. More information about Greenhouse , including about its features and its Privacy Policy, may be found at its website. These tools assist our recruiting team and do not make hiring decisions.

title: CONTROLLER
description:
Job Position: Controller

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Department: Finance

Classification: Exempt (Non-Overtime Eligible)

PCI Overview


For over 50 years, PCI Group has provided mission-critical communications to businesses where data security, accuracy and compliance are essential. As a family-owned business, PCI provides customers fast, secure, and cost-effective transactional communications like invoices, statements, and checks, that are fully compliant with federal regulations including HIPAA, HITRUST, FISMA and SOC 1 and SOC 2 and PCI DSS.

Summary:


The Controller oversees all accounting, reporting and financial systems activities and partners with the CFO, Operations, IT and the Owner to strengthen and integrate processes, controls and systems.


The Controller leads day-to-day accounting operations, supervises a team of five (accounts payable, accounts receivable, inventory and procurement) and owns the Company’s financial systems, including Oracle NetSuite.


This role is part of the Company’s finance succession plan and is expected to grow into the Chief Financial Officer position.

Primary Responsibilities


  • Oversee all accounting activities, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, postage, inventory, general ledger, payroll, monthly close and reporting, in compliance with U.S. GAAP. Lead procurement, including vendor management, strategic sourcing and pricing to keep adequate supplies on hand for production.
  • Finance Systems – Administer NetSuite and supporting integrations and applications, including updates and enhancements.
  • Automation and AI – Lead automation and AI adoption across accounting workflows (e.g., reconciliations, invoice processing, forecasting) with appropriate controls and data security.
  • Ensure proper controls and compliance are in place and operating as designed.
  • Financial Planning & Analysis – Lead the annual budget, forecasts, variance analysis and KPI reporting.
  • Cash Management – Forecast cash flow and manage working capital, banking relationships and postage funding.
  • Audit and Tax – Lead the annual external audit or review and coordinate tax compliance with outside advisors.
  • Cost Accounting – Maintain cost models and customer/job profitability analysis to support pricing decisions.
  • Team Leadership – Recruit, coach and develop the finance team; build bench strength and accountability
  • Executive Communication – Present results and recommendations to the CFO, Owner and leadership team
  • Strategic Support – Partner with the CFO on capital planning, pricing, lender relationships, insurance and due diligence
  • Performs other duties as required

Required Skills and Abilities


  • Proficient with finance systems, preferably Oracle NetSuite, and supporting systems and applications. Understanding and use of SQL would be a preference.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation tools and their practical use, risks and governance in finance
  • Advanced Excel and BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI)
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, internal controls and month-end close best practices
  • Proven leadership skills, with a track record of building, coaching and retaining high-performing teams and leading through change
  • Strategic, analytical and adaptable thinker
  • Strict adherence to ethical standards
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, including presenting to the Owner, executives and lenders
  • Strong time management, prioritization and delegation skills
  • Strong business acumen and a strategic mindset, with the interest and capacity to grow into the Chief Financial Officer role


Education and Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance and at least 8 years of progressive accounting experience, including 3 or more years in a Controller or similar senior management accounting position with direct supervision of staff. CPA strongly preferred; MBA a plus. NetSuite, external audit and inventory-intensive industry experience preferred.

Physical Demands


  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Regularly required to sit for long periods of time; frequent hearing and talking required. Extensive keyboarding. May be required to lift up to 40 lbs.


Note: PCI Group retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of this position at any time.
