title: Public Saftey Officer
description:
Department:

Department of Public Safety - Cascades

Special Instructions to Applicants:

When applying you will be required to attach the following electronic documents:

1) A resume/CV; and

2) A cover letter indicating how your qualifications and experience have prepared you for this position.


Starting salary will be commensurate with skills, education, and experience.


For additional information please contact:

Johana Hernandez

johana.hernandez@osucascades.edu

Job Summary:

Oregon State University-Cascades is seeking a Campus Safety Officer. This is a full time (1.00 FTE), 12-month, professional faculty position. This position is located in Bend, Oregon.


The mission of the Department of Public Safety is to provide a safe campus for students, faculty, staff and visitors of Oregon State University Corvallis and Cascades campus’; to facilitate Oregon State University’s mission and goals; and to provide these services with the highest standards of professionalism.

Building on 150 years as Oregon’s land grant institution, Oregon State University serves the state, the nation and the world as a premier 21st-century research university.

MISSION—As a land grant institution committed to teaching, research, and outreach and engagement, Oregon State University promotes economic, social, cultural, and environmental progress for the people of Oregon, the nation, and the world.

We will be welcoming and foster belonging and success for all. We are a diverse community, defined by the rich palette of cultures we share, and we will strive to eliminate achievement gaps among sub-groups of students and inequities in the advancement of faculty and staff.

We will foster the personal success of each member of the university community and instill a commitment to serve Oregon, the nation, and the world.

OSU is building an organizational culture founded on the values of inclusion, mutual respect, good physical and mental health, collaboration, and humility, so that people from every background are welcomed and thrive, our community is diverse, and our leadership advances both excellence and innovation.


The OSU Department of Public Safety will support and emulate the mission, core values and goals as outlined in OSU’s Strategic Plan for 2024-2030, “Prosperity Widely Shared”, by providing for a safe campus for students, faculty, staff, and visitors that facilitates Oregon State University’s educational, research, and community service goals; and to provide these services with the highest standards of inclusivity, transparency and accountability.


Key Responsibilities:


Security Patrol Services


  • Patrol parking lots, buildings, and grounds; report criminal activities as observed to campus law enforcement personnel for investigation. Provide building access.
  • Patrol inside buildings to ensure no unauthorized persons remain inside and no doors or windows are left unsecured. Check persons in buildings for faculty or staff ID or student after-hours passes as appropriate, find unauthorized persons and escort from building.
  • Report any suspicious persons or circumstances found in buildings and on university property.

Public Safety Services

  • Enforce all university rules and regulations within guidelines and limitations established by the university and public safety administration.
  • Impound abandoned bicycles on campus.
  • Provide safe student and staff escorts on campus; render assistance to students, staff, faculty, and visitors as requested. Perform unlocks of buildings when required and motorist assists (jump-starts).
  • Perform any other duties as may be assigned by a supervisor.
  • Provide special security of Radiation Center and other buildings under contract.
  • Respond to calls for service for assistance including but not limited to minor criminal investigations, fire alarms, intrusion alarms, and accidents.
  • Provide transports for students with minor injuries and illnesses to the Student Health Center (Corvallis campus). Assist as needed with ambulance calls and medical assists within scope of training.
  • Write factual reports on security and accident incidents on campus.
  • Report all risk management problems noted while on patrol.

General Public Safety Assistance

  • Assist law enforcement personnel in presentation of crime prevention programs and projects on campus. Perform security audits for departments and buildings on request.
  • Participate in quality and continuous improvement activities as an integral part of the Department of Public Safety positions. All employees are expected to exercise good customer service communication skills. Actively participate in orientation and committee activities as required.
  • Attend required training to maintain department standards in job related duties.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Must be able to follow policies and directives
  • Must be able to critically think and solve problems
  • Must be willing and able to work in a professional manner to embrace and promote diversity
  • Must be able to speak clearly and to be understood using a two-way radio system
  • Must be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing
  • Must be willing to attend and successfully complete work-related training if offered
  • Must successfully pass a comprehensive background assessment that includes: criminal history check; driving record review; medical examination; psychological evaluation; drug screening; National fingerprint CJIS check and an inclusive appraisal of work history;

Nuclear Regulatory Commission, 10 CFR 73.2 (a)(1) defines a background check as: Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) criminal history records check (including verification of identity based on fingerprinting), employment history, education, and personal references.

Individuals engaged in activities subject to regulation by the commission in writing of an intent to file an application for licensing, certification, permitting, or approval of a product or activity subject to regulation by the Commission are required under 73.57 to conduct fingerprinting and criminal history records checks before granting access to Safeguard Information.


A background check must be sufficient to support the trustworthiness and reliability determination so that the person performing the check and the Commission have assurance that granting individuals’ access to Safeguards Information does not constitute an unreasonable risk to the public health and safety or the common defense and security.


This position is designated as a critical or security-sensitive position; therefore, the incumbent must successfully complete a criminal history check and be determined to be position qualified as per University Standard: 05-010 et seq. Incumbents are required to self-report convictions and those in youth programs may have additional criminal history checks every 24 months.


This position requires driving a university vehicle or a personal vehicle on behalf of the university; therefore, the incumbent must successfully complete a motor vehicle history check, possess and maintain a current, valid driver’s license in their state of residence, be determined to be position qualified and self-report convictions as per University Policy 05-030.



Preferred Qualifications

  • One year of full-time (or full-time equivalent) experience in a security, military or similar position in which contemporary knowledge and techniques in security and property protection were applied.

Working Conditions/Schedule:

Working Conditions/Schedule
• Work outside in various weather conditions. Vehicle patrol, foot patrol, bicycle patrol.
• Must be able to work any shift, any day, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
• Required to wear department designated uniforms and equipment while on duty.
• May be required to work extended hours due to emergency situations or increased workload on a temporary basis.
• Must be able to walk/stand for extended periods of time.
• This position is deemed essential and the incumbent may be expected to report to work during inclement weather, emergency and other university work curtailments or closures.

Salary Range:

$27.32- $37.41

Anticipated Start Date:

2026-11-30

Anticipated End Date:


When applying, please keep in mind this posting will close at 11:59 pm the night before the posted "end date". Applications MUST be submitted prior to this deadline.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability, protected veteran, and other protected status.


OSU will conduct a review of the National Sex Offender Public website prior to hire.

OSU is a fair chance employer committed to inclusive hiring. We encourage applications from candidates who bring a wide range of lived experience including involvement with the justice system. If this position has “critical or security-sensitive” responsibilities and/or driving duties and you are selected as a finalist, your initial job offer will be contingent upon the results of a job-related pre-employment check (such as a background check, motor vehicle history check, sexual misconduct reference check, etc.). Background check results do not automatically disqualify a candidate. Take a look at our Background Checks website including the for candidates section for more details. If you have questions or concerns about the pre-employment check, please contact OSU’s Employee and Labor Relations team at employee.relations@oregonstate.edu.

title: Communications Specialist
description:

Provides education to the public, both adults and children, on a variety of water industry topics. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; moving mechanical parts; fumes or airborne particles; and outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

Applications for this position will not be accepted after 5:00 p.m. on Friday, October 16th, 2026.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to take phone calls regarding the status of an application. You will be contacted if you are selected to be interviewed. We appreciate your interest in HCWA!

Henry County Water Authority is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Contract type: Full time, permanent

Salary: £DOE

Reports to: Head of Product Engineering

About Us

Ntegra is a dynamic, forward-thinking digital engineering practice that partners with global businesses to deliver impactful digital solutions. You'll tackle complex projects across a diverse range of global industries, delivering meaningful results. If you're passionate about technology and want to make an impact, join us to develop your career in a supportive, innovation-driven environment. Learn more about our work at .

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Product Engineering team. This is a hands-on technical role initially focused on leading the development of modern web applications across multiple client projects. You'll help shape technical architecture, contribute directly to code and collaborate closely with Agile teams to deliver secure and maintainable software solutions.

Our projects primarily utilise React and TypeScript for front-end development with varied back-end technologies including Python, Node.js, .NET and Ruby. You'll benefit from robust DevOps support, established delivery processes and the autonomy to shape how we approach and deliver projects.

Over time, as trust and familiarity grow, you'll progress into a leadership role with responsibility for mentoring and managing a small team of developers. We're looking for someone who thrives on problem-solving, is passionate about developing talent and enjoys adapting their expertise to new domains and technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical delivery, shaping project architecture and delivery strategies
  • Lead backlog shaping and estimation activities, ensuring consistently high-quality code through code reviews and testing practices
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers and delivery leads to deliver secure, maintainable systems
  • Participate in workshops, demos and discussions with internal teams and clients
  • Contribute to the development of internal delivery standards and team culture
  • Take on line management responsibilities as the role matures, including conducting 1:1s, providing performance feedback and supporting career development.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills, including front-end development with React and back-end experience with Node.js or similar frameworks
  • Working knowledge of Python with a willingness to engage across varied tech stacks
  • Experience with Azure and cloud-native development practices
  • Proficiency with both relational and NoSQL databases
  • Familiarity with microservice architectures and common integration patterns
  • Hands-on experience delivering in an Agile/Scrum environment
  • Proven use of CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab)
  • Confident communicator experienced in collaborating directly with clients and internal delivery teams
  • Ability to support teammates, lead development ceremonies and actively contribute to QA and testing processes
  • Willingness and ability to undergo a Security Clearance (SC) application if not a current holder

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • A Computer Science, Software Development or related degree
  • Exposure or interest in additional frameworks/languages (.NET, Ruby on Rails, Go) or willingness to learn new technologies
  • Experience with secure coding practices and awareness of software assurance principles
  • Active SC clearance

Our Offer

At Ntegra, we offer an inspiring and inclusive work environment, where your expertise will be valued and your ideas will have a real impact. We’re a truly flexible organisation, remote-first by default, and give our people the autonomy to shape their roles with the support of an experienced team. Join our talented and passionate team and build a rewarding, long-term career in digital engineering.

Our benefits include:

  • Private medical insurance through Vitality, including rewards, discounts and wellness benefits
  • 25 days holiday (rising with service) plus option to purchase up to 5 extra days
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Peer-recognition bonus scheme
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Generous dental, optical and hearing coverage
  • Birthday and work anniversary gifts
  • Support for charitable initiatives throughout the year
  • Dedicated personal development budget to support continuous learning and professional growth

Your Application

If this job sounds interesting to you, even if you don’t meet all the listed requirements, we’d love to hear from you. If your CV seems like a good match, someone from our team will be in touch to set up a screening call.

We’re committed to inclusivity and are happy to provide any adjustments or support throughout your application.

We do not use recruitment agencies and only accept direct applications.

As a proud member of Mars Veterinary Health, we form the world’s largest and most comprehensive network of emergency and specialty veterinary care . Across our nationwide hospitals, we combine advanced medical science, world-class clinical talent, and a deep commitment to the Five Principles of Mars: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom .


This is a hybrid positions with opportunity to sit in any of our four offices:

  • Tampa, Florida (preferred)
  • New York, New York
  • Vancouver, Washington
  • Los Angeles, California

We are dedicated to elevating the veterinary profession by investing in our people, advancing clinical research, pioneering training programs, and providing sustainable veterinary excellence when pets need it most.


Position Overview

The Vice President of Clinical Affairs (VPCA) provides executive leadership over the clinical capabilities, programs, and infrastructure that advance medical quality, patient safety, clinician development, scientific contribution, and workforce readiness across BluePearl.


Leading through a high-performing team of Clinical Affairs directors and cross-functional partners, the VPCA establishes enterprise vision, governance, and execution across:

  • House Officer and Clinical Training Programs (Internships, Residencies, EmERge™)
  • ER and Specialty Development, Telehealth, and Continuing Education
  • Medical Quality, Patient Safety, and Clinical Governance
  • Clinical Science, Research, and Scientific Publications
  • National Blood Banking and Stewardship Initiatives
  • The BluePearl Clinical Training Center

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

1. Enterprise Clinical Strategy & Organizational Leadership

  • Translate clinical strategy into prioritized, scalable roadmaps and sustainable delivery models aligned with hospital operations.
  • Lead, mentor, and empower a team of Clinical Affairs Directors, building bench strength, accountability, and cross-functional influence.
  • Partner with the Senior Leadership Team, Operations, P&O, Finance, and Mars Veterinary Health colleagues to integrate clinical excellence into core business strategy.
  • Champion data-driven decision-making, using balanced KPIs to demonstrate clinical, workforce, and organizational value.

2. Training, Education & Workforce Development

  • Direct strategic expansion and financial sustainability for House Officer programs (internships and residencies) and the flagship EmERge™ training program.
  • Partner across Mars Veterinary Health banners to pioneer globalized curricula and shared learning models.
  • Foster high-impact relationships with veterinary colleges, university deans, and external organizations (e.g., U.S. military / VET-TRAUMA) to develop joint residency and training pathways.
  • Oversee hands-on wet labs (ultrasound, endoscopy, ER procedures), CE partnerships (including VetGirl), and scalable telehealth/clinical-support platforms.

3. Medical Quality, Patient Safety & Clinical Governance

  • Lead the national rollout and adoption of evidence-based quality initiatives, clinical practice guidelines, and care protocols.
  • Foster a transparent, proactive Culture of Safety, expanding patient-safety event reporting and structured organizational learning.

4. Clinical Science, Blood Banking & Sustainability

  • Partner with the Mars Veterinary Health Science Team to establish robust research infrastructure, mentorship, and publication support for trainees and clinicians.
  • Drive operational maturation, growth, and waste reduction for BluePearl’s community blood banking programs.
  • Champion sustainability and stewardship initiatives, including antimicrobial stewardship, hospital pilots, and anesthetic-gas recapture programs.

5. Clinical Training Center & Resource Optimization

  • Provide executive oversight, capital allocation, and scheduling governance for the dedicated Clinical Training Center.
  • Streamline operating models and eliminate system bottlenecks so clinical teams can focus on patient care and education.

Starting salary; $172,000.00


What You’ll Bring (Qualifications & Experience)
Education & Credentials

  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM / VMD) from an accredited institution (Required).
  • AVMA-recognized Board Certification in a clinical veterinary specialty (Preferred).
  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), Public Health (MPH), Education, or a related field (Preferred).

Experience & Capabilities

  • 8+ years of progressive, senior leadership experience in the veterinary or healthcare industry (Required).
  • Proven track record leading leaders, developing high-performing teams, and driving organizational succession planning.
  • Demonstrated expertise translating high-level medical strategy into operational execution across multi-site or matrixed organizations.
  • Strong background in veterinary clinical education, house officer programs, medical quality/patient safety, or clinical research.
  • Experience building academic-private partnerships or working in academic veterinary medicine (Preferred).
  • Familiarity with veterinary practice management software (e.g., ezyVet, Instinct) and collaboration tools (e.g., Smartsheet) (Preferred).

Why Work for BluePearl?

  • Competitive Executive Compensation & Total Rewards
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and parental leave benefits.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) with company match and executive retirement planning.
  • Health and well-being resources to assist with stress management, mental health awareness, compassion fatigue, burnout, communication, and conflict management skills
  • Unmatched Professional Resources: Access to BluePearl University, over 2,000 peer-reviewed medical journals, and continuing education allowances.
  • Pet Care Perks: Generous pet healthcare discounts and Trupanion pet insurance benefits .
  • Global Network: Boundless growth and development opportunities across the global Mars Veterinary Health network.

description:
Job Description

Part Time Evening Trash Collector – Valet Trash Porter | Osprey, FL 34229

Got a pickup truck and a free evening? Turn it into steady weekly income. Community Concierge Services is hiring part time Trash Collectors (Porters) to run doorstep valet trash routes at an apartment community in Osprey, FL 34229. This evening job pays $250–$300 per week depending on your assigned route - and most nights you're done in about 1 hour 30 minutes.

What makes this side hustle different:

Quick shifts, real pay – routes average about 1 hour 30 minutes per evening, $250–$300/week

A schedule you can plan around – Sundays beginning at 6PM, Monday through Thursday beginning at 7PM, until your route is complete

Paid training – no prior experience needed to start

Paid holidays and a clear path to advancement for reliable porters

Each evening, you'll arrive at your assigned apartment community and collect bagged trash and recycling that residents set outside their doors. Expect plenty of stairs and steps - this is an active, on-your-feet role. You'll load the bags into the bed of your truck, drive them to the property's compactor or dumpsters, and head home. Simple, repeatable, and done before most people finish their evening TV show.

Requirements to apply:

Open-bed pickup truck for hauling collected trash on the property

Smartphone with an active data plan for check-ins and route updates

Physical ability to carry up to 50 lbs unassisted and handle stairs nightly

Dependable evening availability on a set weekly schedule: Sunday from 6PM, Monday–Thursday from 7PM, until completion

This gig work is a great fit if you're searching for:

A part time job, evening or night job, second job, weekend-friendly side gig, or extra income after your 9-to-5. Popular with students, retirees, rideshare and delivery drivers, landscapers, tradespeople, and anyone in Osprey with a truck who wants consistent weekly pay without long hours.
